exercises.title: 21s Bicep Curl
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a straight or curved bar evenly and stand tall. Bring your shoulders back, squeeze your glutes, and take a breath.
2. Curl the weight halfway (to the point where your wrists align with your elbows) for seven repetitions.
3. Immediately start curling the bar from the halfway point to the top (where your wrists are a couple of inches higher than your elbows) for another seven repetitions.
4. Finish by doing seven complete repetitions from full arm extension to the top position, breathing steadily as you do.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 均匀握住直杆或曲杆，站直。肩部后收，夹紧臀部，吸气。
2. 将重量弯举到一半（手腕与手肘齐平）做七次。
3. 随即从半程位置继续弯举到顶端（手腕高于手肘几英寸），再做七次。
4. 最后从手臂完全伸展到顶端位置做七次完整动作，过程中保持均匀呼吸。

exercises.title: Ab Scissors
exercises.how_to:
1. Sit on an exercise mat, lean back, and place your hands on the floor and to your sides for balance.
2. Engage your abs and raise your feet several inches off the floor while keeping your knees extended.
3. Take a breath and cross your legs by bringing the right one over the left. Immediately uncross them and move the left leg over the right.
4. Keep alternating until you get tired, breathing steadily as you do reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 坐在训练垫上，身体后仰，双手撑于身体两侧地面以保持平衡。
2. 收紧腹部，保持膝盖伸直将双脚抬离地面几英寸。
3. 吸气，右腿交叉到左腿上方。随即分开，再将左腿交叉到右腿上方。
4. 持续交替直至疲劳，过程中保持均匀呼吸。

exercises.title: Ab Wheel
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab an ab wheel and get down on your knees.
2. Lean forward and place the ab wheel on the floor while holding it firmly with both hands.
3. Engage your abs and take a breath.
4. Roll the ab wheel forward as you extend your body.
5. Move forward as much as your ab strength allows and roll the wheel back to the starting position. Exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双手握住健腹轮，跪于地面。
2. 身体前倾，双手紧握健腹轮置于地面。
3. 收紧腹部，吸气。
4. 向前滚动健腹轮，同时伸展身体。
5. 在腹部力量允许的范围内尽可能向前，然后将健腹轮滚回起始位置。呼气。

exercises.title: Arnold Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of light dumbbells and sit on a gym bench with an upright back support.
2. Lift the dumbbells and rest them on your thighs.
3. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and take a breath.
4. Thrust the dumbbells and bring them to your sides.
5. Take a breath and press the dumbbells to an overhead position as you breathe out.
6. Lower the dumbbells slowly as you rotate your wrists in, breathing in on the way down. You should end up with the dumbbells in front of your chin and palms facing your body.
7. Press again, rotating your wrists to complete the repetition with your palms facing forward.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿起一对轻哑铃，坐在靠背直立训练凳上。
2. 举起哑铃，放在大腿上。
3. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，吸气。
4. 将哑铃向上提起，置于身体两侧。
5. 吸气，呼气时将哑铃推至头顶位置。
6. 缓慢放下哑铃，同时手腕内旋，下降过程中吸气。最终哑铃应位于下巴前方，掌心朝向身体。
7. 再次推起，同时旋转手腕，以掌心朝前完成这次动作。

exercises.title: Around The World
exercises.how_to:
1. Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
2. Position the dumbbells over your upper thighs with your arms straight and palms facing down.
3. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and breathe in.
4. Slowly move the dumbbells from your upper thighs to behind your head in an arc motion, keeping your arms straight. Breathe out.
5. Immediately move the weights from behind your head to the starting position in an arc as you breathe in. While doing so, twist your wrists to have your palms facing down at the starting position.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 仰卧于平板凳上，双手各持一只哑铃。
2. 手臂伸直，掌心朝下，将哑铃置于大腿上方。
3. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，吸气。
4. 保持手臂伸直，将哑铃以弧线动作从大腿上方缓慢移至头后。呼气。
5. 吸气，随即以弧线将哑铃从头后移回起始位置。过程中转动手腕，使掌心在起始位置朝下。

exercises.title: Assisted Pistol Squats
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand next to a squat rack and grab it with one hand for balance.
2. Lift one foot off the floor and raise the leg a few inches forward. Keep your opposite foot firmly planted on the floor.
3. Engage your abs, bring your shoulders back, and take a breath.
4. Squat by bending your knee and moving the opposite leg forward, keeping the foot off the floor.
5. Descend as much as possible and push through the heel to lift yourself as you exhale.
6. Once finished training one leg, support yourself on the opposite foot and perform the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站在深蹲架旁，单手扶架保持平衡。
2. 抬起一只脚离地，向前抬起几英寸。另一只脚牢牢踩实地面。
3. 收紧腹部，肩部后收，吸气。
4. 屈膝下蹲，同时另一条腿向前移动，脚保持离地。
5. 尽可能下蹲，呼气时以脚跟发力起身。
6. 一条腿训练完成后，换另一只脚支撑，完成相同次数的动作。

exercises.title: Back Extension (Hyperextension)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set yourself up on a back extension machine. Have your hips and thighs against the pad and your ankles locked on the foot brace.
2. Engage your abs, cross your arms in front of your chest, and take a breath.
3. Lower yourself by bending at the hips and move down until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings and glutes.
4. Engage your buttocks and lower back to raise your torso to the top position, pausing for a moment and exhaling.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在背部伸展器械上就位。髋部和大腿贴紧靠垫，脚踝卡在脚托上。
2. 收紧腹部，双臂交叉于胸前，吸气。
3. 以髋部屈曲使身体下降，直到腘绳肌和臀部有拉伸感。
4. 收紧臀部和下背将躯干抬起至最高位置，稍作停留并呼气。

exercises.title: Back Extension (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Sit on a back extension machine with your buttocks against a pad.
2. Place the foot pad just over your feet.
3. The top pad should be against your upper back.
4. Adjust the load on the machine and cross your arms in front of your chest.
5. Take a breath, engage your abs, and push the top pad backward by engaging your lower back muscles. Breathe out.
6. Lean forward to the starting position as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 坐在背部伸展器械上，臀部贴紧靠垫。
2. 将脚垫压在脚上方。
3. 上方靠垫应抵住上背。
4. 调整器械重量，双臂交叉于胸前。
5. 吸气，收紧腹部，以下背肌群发力将上方靠垫向后推。呼气。
6. 吸气，前倾回到起始位置。

exercises.title: Back Extension (Weighted Hyperextension)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set yourself up inside a back extension bench. Have your heels secured against a pad and your hips against another pad.
2. Bend forward and grab a weight plate off the floor or have a training partner hand it to you.
3. Extend your body and take a breath.
4. Bend your body at the hips while keeping your shoulders back and spine neutral. Move down as much as your muscle flexibility allows.
5. Extend your body by engaging your posterior chain and exhale near the top.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在背部伸展凳上就位。脚跟卡紧靠垫，髋部贴紧另一块靠垫。
2. 身体前倾，从地面拿起杠铃片，或让训练伙伴递给你。
3. 伸展身体，吸气。
4. 以髋部屈曲身体，同时保持肩部后收、脊柱中立。在肌肉柔韧性允许的范围内尽可能下降。
5. 以后侧链发力伸展身体，在接近最高点呼气。

exercises.title: Ball Slams
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand tall with your feet in a comfortable stance and your toes pointing slightly out.
2. Hold a medicine ball in both hands, keeping it at stomach level.
3. Engage your midsection, bend your knees slightly, and thrust the medicine ball overhead. Your arms should be straight, and the ball should be directly overhead for balance.
4. Inhale and use your upper body muscles to accelerate the ball down and slam it as hard as you can just in front of your body. Breathe out.
5. Bend your knees enough to pick up the ball while keeping your spine neutral.
6. Breathe in and repeat the sequence.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站直，双脚以舒适的站距分开，脚尖略微朝外。
2. 双手持药球，置于腹部高度。
3. 收紧核心，略微屈膝，将药球举过头顶。手臂应伸直，药球位于头顶正上方以保持平衡。
4. 吸气，以上肢肌肉发力加快下砸，在身体正前方用尽全力将球砸向地面。呼气。
5. 保持脊柱中立，屈膝拾起药球。
6. 吸气，重复以上流程。

exercises.title: Band Pullaparts
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a looped or open-ended resistance band with handles on both ends. The band should offer moderate resistance.
2. Extend your arms in front of your body and have your palms neutral (facing one another).
3. Take a breath and pull the band apart, bringing your arms to the sides while keeping them straight. Exhale.
4. Bring your arms together as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 握住环形或两端带把手的开口弹力带。弹力带应提供中等阻力。
2. 双臂在身体前方伸直，掌心相对（中立握）。
3. 吸气，将弹力带向两侧拉开，手臂保持伸直移至身体两侧。呼气。
4. 吸气，将双臂合拢。

exercises.title: Battle Ropes
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab the pair of battle ropes.
2. Bend your knees and lean forward slightly while keeping your spine neutral.
3. Take a breath and move one arm up to shoulder level while bringing the opposite one down to your knees.
4. Immediately move both arms in the opposite direction, changing their position.
5. Alternate your arms at a steady tempo, breathing regularly as you do.
6. Go for as long as possible until you feel a deep burn in your upper back and shoulders.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双手各握住一根战绳。
2. 屈膝，略微前倾，同时保持脊柱中立。
3. 吸气，一只手臂抬至肩部高度，另一只手臂下压至膝盖位置。
4. 随即双臂反向移动，交换位置。
5. 以稳定的节奏交替摆动双臂，过程中保持规律呼吸。
6. 尽可能长时间坚持，直到上背和肩部出现强烈灼烧感。

exercises.title: Bear Crawl
exercises.how_to:
1. Get down on your knees and hands. Your hands should be shoulder-width apart.
2. Engage your abs and lift your knees off the ground.
3. Breathe in and start moving forward on your hands and feet while keeping your knees in the air.
4. Bring your right arm and left knee forward, then your left arm and right knee forward.
5. Continue alternating and breathe steadily as you move forward.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 俯身跪地，双手撑地。双手间距与肩同宽。
2. 收紧腹部，将膝盖抬离地面。
3. 吸气，双手双脚向前移动，膝盖保持离地。
4. 右臂与左膝向前移动，然后左臂与右膝向前移动。
5. 持续交替向前移动，保持均匀呼吸。

exercises.title: Behind the Back Curl (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the pulleys at around mid-thigh height, attach handles, and select the load.
2. Grab the handles one by one and stand so the pulleys are behind you.
3. Take a couple of steps forward to lift the weights off their stacks and allow the weight to pull your elbows behind your torso.
4. With your chest out, lean your torso slightly forward and stagger your stance (one foot forward, the other one back).
5. Breathe in, engage your abs, and curl until your wrists are at elbow level. Squeeze your biceps and exhale.
6. Slowly extend your arms, allowing the handles to travel behind your body, and breathe in.
7. Repeat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将滑轮调至大腿中部高度，装上把手，并选择重量。
2. 依次握住把手，站位使滑轮位于身后。
3. 向前走几步将重量从配重片拉起，让重量将手肘拉向躯干后方。
4. 挺胸，躯干略微前倾，前后错开站位（一只脚在前，另一只脚在后）。
5. 吸气，收紧腹部，弯举至手腕与手肘同高。挤压肱二头肌并呼气。
6. 缓慢伸展手臂，让把手移向身体后方，同时吸气。
7. 重复。

exercises.title: Behind the Back Wrist Curl (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Place a loaded barbell or EZ bar on the floor and stand in front of it.
2. With your arms to your sides and palms facing back, squat, and grab the bar evenly. Keep your back straight.
3. Push through your heels and squat up, lifting the bar behind your body.
4. Take a breath and flex your wrists to curl the barbell without moving your elbows or arms. Breathe out at the top.
5. Extend your wrists as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将装有杠铃片的杠铃或 EZ 杠放在地上，站在其前方。
2. 双臂垂于体侧，掌心朝后，下蹲并均匀握住杠铃。保持背部挺直。
3. 脚跟发力蹲起，将杠铃提至身后。
4. 吸气，屈腕向上弯举杠铃，肘部和手臂保持不动。在顶端呼气。
5. 吸气，同时伸展手腕。

exercises.title: Belt Squat (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Load the machine appropriately and put on the weight belt.
2. Step on the platform and hook the belt’s chain to the machine’s lever via a carabiner.
3. Stand tall and grab the handles or horizontal bar in front.
4. Position your feet at a comfortable width for squats with your toes pointing slightly out.
5. Bring your chest out, engage your abs, and unrack the weight. You can hold onto the bar or handles in front of you for balance.
6. Breathe in and descend until your thighs are roughly parallel to the bar.
7. Pause briefly and push through your heels to extend your knees, exhaling at the top.
8. Breathe in and repeat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 为器械加上合适的重量，并系好负重腰带。
2. 站上踏板，用登山扣将腰带的链条挂到器械的杠杆上。
3. 站直，握住前方的把手或横杆。
4. 双脚以舒适的宽度站开，脚尖略微外展，呈深蹲站姿。
5. 挺胸，收紧腹部，解开重量。可以扶住身前的横杆或把手保持平衡。
6. 吸气下蹲，直到大腿大致与杠平行。
7. 稍作停顿，脚跟发力伸直膝盖，在顶端呼气。
8. 吸气，重复动作。

exercises.title: Bench Dip
exercises.how_to:
1. Face away from a sturdy gym bench, plyo box, or chair.
2. Lean back and place your hands flat on the object's edge.
3. Straighten your legs and support your lower body on your heels. Your torso should be upright.
4. Engage your abs, take a breath, and descend by bending your elbows.
5. Move down until your elbows form a 90-degree angle and pause for a moment.
6. Extend your arms and exhale near the top.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 背对稳固的训练凳、跳箱或椅子。
2. 后仰，双手平放在物体边缘。
3. 伸直双腿，用脚跟支撑下半身。躯干保持直立。
4. 收紧腹部，吸气，屈肘下降。
5. 下降至肘部呈 90 度角，稍作停顿。
6. 伸直手臂，在接近顶端时呼气。

exercises.title: Bench Press (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Lie on the bench.
2. Extend your arms and grab the bar evenly, having your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
3. Bring your shoulder blades back and dig them into the bench.
4. Arch your lower back and plant your feet flat on the floor.
5. Take a breath, unrack the bar, and bring it over your chest.
6. Inhale again and lower the barbell to your lower chest, tapping it slightly.
7. Hold for a moment and press the bar until your elbows are straight. Exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 仰卧在平板凳上。
2. 伸直手臂，双手略宽于肩，均匀握住杠铃。
3. 肩胛骨后收，抵住凳面。
4. 下背略拱起，双脚平踩地面。
5. 吸气，解开杠铃，将其移至胸部上方。
6. 再次吸气，将杠铃下放至下胸，轻轻触碰。
7. 停顿片刻，推起杠铃直至手臂伸直。呼气。

exercises.title: Bench Press (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
1. Place a flat gym bench in the middle of a double cable machine.
2. Adjust the load on both weight stacks, position the pulleys low, and attach handles.
3. Grab both handles and sit on the bench while keeping your arms close to your body.
4. Lie back carefully and bring your arms to your sides without flaring your elbows.
5. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and take a breath.
6. Push both handles up and in, tapping your knuckles at the top as you exhale.
7. Lower the weights carefully until your elbows are at torso level, and breathe in.
8. Once finished, bring your arms in, get up slowly, and release both handles.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将平板凳放在双柱绳索器械中间。
2. 调整两侧配重片的重量，将滑轮调至低位并装上把手。
3. 握住两个把手坐在凳上，手臂贴近身体。
4. 小心后仰躺下，双臂移至体侧，肘部不要外展。
5. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，吸气。
6. 将两个把手向上向内推，在顶端双手相触时呼气。
7. 缓慢下放重量，直到肘部与躯干同高，同时吸气。
8. 完成后收拢手臂，慢慢起身，松开两个把手。

exercises.title: Bench Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells, sit on a flat gym bench, and place both weights on top of your thighs.
2. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, take a breath, and flex your arms.
3. Kick both dumbbells up with your thighs as you lie back.
4. With your arms straight and dumbbells over your chest, dig your shoulder blades into the bench and place your feet flat on the floor.
5. Take another breath and lower both dumbbells to your sides. Keep your elbows somewhat tucked.
6. Lower the weights until your elbows are at torso level.
7. Press both dumbbells to the starting position, bringing them together as you exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿一对哑铃，坐在平板凳上，将哑铃放在大腿上方。
2. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，吸气，屈臂。
3. 后仰躺下的同时，用大腿将两个哑铃向上顶起。
4. 手臂伸直，哑铃位于胸部上方，肩胛骨抵住凳面，双脚平踩地面。
5. 再次吸气，将两个哑铃下放至体侧。肘部稍微内收。
6. 继续下放，直到肘部与躯干同高。
7. 将两个哑铃推回起始位置，靠拢时呼气。

exercises.title: Bench Press (Smith Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Place a flat gym bench in the middle of a Smith machine.
2. Adjust the bar to a height where you can grab and unrack it from a lying position.
3. Lie on the bench and position your lower chest directly underneath the bar.
4. Grab the bar with an even overhand grip.
5. Bring your shoulders back and dig the balls of your feet into the floor.
6. Take a breath and unrack the bar.
7. Lower the bar until it taps your chest and press it to the top as you exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将平板凳放在史密斯机中间。
2. 将杠铃调到仰卧时能握住并解开的高度。
3. 仰卧在凳上，下胸位于杠铃正下方。
4. 以正握均匀握住杠铃。
5. 肩部后收，前脚掌踩实地面。
6. 吸气，解开杠铃。
7. 下放杠铃至轻触胸部，再推至顶端，同时呼气。

exercises.title: Bench Press - Close Grip (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the barbell at a height where you can reach it from a lying position.
2. Lie on the bench and position your head underneath the bar.
3. Reach up and grab the bar with an even, overhand grip. Your hands should be shoulder-width apart.
4. Bring your shoulder blades back and draw your feet back and toward the bench, digging the balls of your feet into the floor.
5. Engage your body, unrack the bar, and bring it over your chest.
6. Breathe in and lower the barbell to your lower chest.
7. Press the bar to the top position and exhale.
8. Once finished, bring the barbell over the rack and rest it gently.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将杠铃架设在仰卧时能够到的高度。
2. 仰卧在凳上，头部位于杠铃下方。
3. 向上伸手，以正握均匀握住杠铃。双手应与肩同宽。
4. 肩胛骨后收，双脚向凳的方向收拢，前脚掌踩实地面。
5. 绷紧身体，解开杠铃，将其移至胸部上方。
6. 吸气，将杠铃下放至下胸。
7. 将杠铃推至顶端位置，呼气。
8. 完成后，将杠铃移至架子上方并轻轻放下。

exercises.title: Bench Press - Wide Grip (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the barbell at a height where you can grab it from a lying position.
2. Lie on the bench and position yourself so that the bar is directly over your forehead.
3. Reach up and grab the bar with an overhand grip. Start with your hands shoulder-width apart, and gradually increase your grip width.
4. Retract your shoulder blades and dig them into the bench.
5. Bring your feet back and in toward the bench, digging the balls of your feet into the floor.
6. Engage your upper body, unrack the barbell, and bring it over your chest.
7. Take a breath and lower the barbell to the bottom (lower chest, nipple line).
8. Tap your torso and push the bar back to the top, squeezing your triceps, shoulders, and pectorals. Exhale near the top.
9. Once finished, bring the bar back over the safety pins and rack it.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将杠铃架设在仰卧时能握住的高度。
2. 仰卧在凳上，使杠铃位于额头正上方。
3. 向上伸手，以正握握住杠铃。双手先从与肩同宽开始，再逐渐加宽握距。
4. 肩胛骨后收，抵住凳面。
5. 双脚向凳的方向收拢，前脚掌踩实地面。
6. 绷紧上半身，解开杠铃，将其移至胸部上方。
7. 吸气，将杠铃下放到底（下胸、乳头连线处）。
8. 轻触躯干后将杠铃推回顶端，收紧肱三头肌、肩部和胸肌。接近顶端时呼气。
9. 完成后，将杠铃移回安全挂钩上方并放回架上。

exercises.title: Bent Over Row (Band)
exercises.how_to:
1. Take an open-ended resistance band with handles on both sides.
2. Step over the middle of the band with both feet.
3. Grab both handles and lean forward while keeping your spine neutral. The band should offer some tension even with your arms fully extended. You can increase or decrease the tension by having your feet closer or wider apart.
4. Bring your shoulders back and take a breath.
5. Pull both ends of the band up and in until your elbows are at torso level. Exhale at the top.
6. Extend your arms as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 取一条两端带把手的开口弹力带。
2. 双脚踩住弹力带中间。
3. 握住两个把手，保持脊柱中立并前倾。即使手臂完全伸直，弹力带也应保留一定张力。双脚靠拢或分开可增加或减小张力。
4. 肩部后收，吸气。
5. 将弹力带两端向上向内拉，直到肘部与躯干同高。在顶端呼气。
6. 吸气，同时伸直手臂。

exercises.title: Bent Over Row (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand in front of a loaded barbell with your feet in a comfortable stance and toes pointing slightly out.
2. Lean forward by hinging at the hip and keep your spine in a neutral position.
3. Grab the barbell with an even overhand grip.
4. Engage your abs and lift the bar several inches off the floor.
5. With your shoulders back and midsection tight, take a breath and row the barbell.
6. Lift the bar until it taps your stomach and hold the position for a moment as you exhale.
7. Lower the bar slowly.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站在装有杠铃片的杠铃前，双脚以舒适的宽度站开，脚尖略微外展。
2. 以髋部为轴前倾，保持脊柱中立。
3. 以正握均匀握住杠铃。
4. 收紧腹部，将杠铃提离地面数英寸。
5. 肩部后收、核心绷紧，吸气并划船。
6. 将杠铃拉至轻触腹部，保持姿势片刻并呼气。
7. 缓慢下放杠铃。

exercises.title: Bent Over Row (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells and stand tall.
2. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and lean forward while keeping your back straight. Your torso should be as parallel to the floor as possible.
3. Have your arms straight and hanging down with your wrists neutral (facing one another).
4. Take a breath and row both dumbbells until your elbows are at torso level. Exhale at the top.
5. Lower the weights, breathing in on the way down.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿一对哑铃站直。
2. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，保持背部挺直前倾。躯干尽量与地面平行。
3. 手臂伸直自然下垂，手腕保持中立（相对）。
4. 吸气，将两个哑铃划起，直到肘部与躯干同高。在顶端呼气。
5. 下放哑铃，下放过程中吸气。

exercises.title: Bent Over Row (Smith Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the bar at mid-thigh height and add your weight.
2. Stand close to the bar, almost pressing your thighs against it. Your feet should be hip-width apart.
3. Grab the bar with an overhand grip - palms facing back. Have your hands roughly shoulder-width apart.
4. Breathe in, engage your abs, and unrack the bar.
5. Lower the bar to mid-shin height by leaning your torso forward and pushing your buttocks back. Your spine should remain in a neutral position.
6. Take another breath and pull the bar in one fluid motion while keeping your torso at the same angle.
7. Exhale at the top as you squeeze your back muscles.
8. Slowly lower the bar until your arms are straight and breathe in on the way down.
9. Repeat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将杠铃调到大腿中部高度并加上重量。
2. 靠近杠铃站立，大腿几乎贴住它。双脚与髋同宽。
3. 以正握握住杠铃，掌心朝后。双手大致与肩同宽。
4. 吸气，收紧腹部，解开杠铃。
5. 上身前倾、臀部后推，将杠铃下放至小腿中部高度。脊柱保持中立。
6. 再次吸气，保持躯干角度不变，流畅地将杠铃拉起。
7. 在顶端呼气，同时收紧背部肌肉。
8. 缓慢下放杠铃直到手臂伸直，下放过程中吸气。
9. 重复动作。

exercises.title: Bicep Curl (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Pick the bar up and hold it with a grip slightly wider than your hips. Your arms should be straight, with your palms facing forward.
2. Straighten your back, bring your chest out, take a breath, and curl the barbell, exhaling at the top. Don’t use body swinging and momentum to lift the bar; only your bicep strength.
3. Lower the bar slowly as you breathe in, extending your arms and stretching your biceps.
4. Repeat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿起杠铃，握距略宽于髋部。手臂伸直，掌心朝前。
2. 挺直背部，挺胸，吸气并弯举杠铃，在顶端呼气。不要靠身体摆动和惯性抬起杠铃，只靠肱二头肌发力。
3. 吸气，缓慢下放杠铃，伸直手臂并拉伸肱二头肌。
4. 重复动作。

exercises.title: Bicep Curl (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
1. Attach a straight bar to a low cable pulley.
2. Set the load on the weight stack at the appropriate amount.
3. Lean forward and grab the straight bar evenly with your palms facing up.
4. Stand up and step back (if necessary) to lift the weight from its stack.
5. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and have your elbows to your sides.
6. Take a breath and curl the weight, keeping your elbows steady.
7. Lift the weight until your wrists are slightly higher than your elbows and exhale.
8. Lower the weight slowly, breathing in on the way down.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将直杆装到低位绳索滑轮上。
2. 在配重片上设置合适的重量。
3. 前倾，掌心朝上均匀握住直杆。
4. 站起并后退（如有需要），将重量提起离开配重片。
5. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，肘部贴近体侧。
6. 吸气并弯举重量，肘部保持稳定。
7. 将重量举至手腕略高于肘部，然后呼气。
8. 缓慢下放重量，下放过程中吸气。

exercises.title: Bicep Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells and stand tall with your feet in a comfortable stance and shoulders retracted.
2. Have your wrists pointing forward and your arms extended.
3. Take a breath and curl both dumbbells simultaneously. Lift the weights until your wrists are slightly higher than your elbows and exhale.
4. Extend your arms slowly and breathe in on the way down.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿一对哑铃站直，双脚以舒适的宽度站开，肩部后收。
2. 手腕朝前，手臂伸直。
3. 吸气，同时弯举两个哑铃。将重量举至手腕略高于肘部，然后呼气。
4. 缓慢伸直手臂，下放过程中吸气。

exercises.title: Bicep Curl (Machine)
exercises.title_zh: 固定器械肱二头肌弯举
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the correct load on the machine and adjust your seat’s height.
2. Sit down and grab the handles by your sides.
3. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and take a breath.
4. Bend one arm to lift the handle. Curl until your hand is slightly higher than your elbow, and breathe out.
5. Extend your arm slowly as you breathe in.
6. Bend your opposite arm in the same way.
7. Keep alternating until you finish the set.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在器械上选择合适的重量，并调整座椅高度。
2. 坐下，握住体侧的把手。
3. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，吸气。
4. 弯曲一侧手臂抬起把手。弯举至手略高于肘部，然后呼气。
5. 吸气，缓慢伸直手臂。
6. 以同样方式弯曲另一侧手臂。
7. 持续交替，直到完成该组。

exercises.title: Bicep Curl (Suspension)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab the pair of handles attached to a suspension training kit.
2. Walk your feet forward to lean your body back to some degree.
3. Extend your body, squeeze your glutes, and bring your shoulders back.
4. Take a breath and bend your arms to lift your body.
5. Bend your arms until your elbows are at slightly more than a 90-degree angle, and breathe out.
6. Extend your arms slowly, lowering your body to the starting position as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 握住悬吊训练器上的两个把手。
2. 双脚向前走，使身体向后倾斜一定角度。
3. 身体绷直，收紧臀部，肩部后收。
4. 吸气，屈臂将身体拉起。
5. 屈臂至肘部略大于 90 度角，然后呼气。
6. 吸气，缓慢伸直手臂，将身体放回起始位置。

exercises.title: Bicycle Crunch
exercises.how_to:
1. Lie on the floor, lift your legs off the floor, and bend your knees at a 90-degree angle.
2. Place your fingertips behind your head or neck.
3. Take a breath, engage your midsection, and crunch, bringing your right elbow to your left knee. Exhale.
4. Extend your body as you breathe in.
5. Crunch again, taking your left elbow to your right knee. Exhale again.
6. Keep alternating until you complete the set.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 仰卧在地面上，双腿抬离地面，膝盖弯曲呈 90 度角。
2. 指尖放在头或颈后。
3. 吸气，收紧核心，卷腹使右肘靠近左膝。呼气。
4. 吸气，同时舒展身体。
5. 再次卷腹，使左肘靠近右膝。再次呼气。
6. 持续交替，直到完成该组。

exercises.title: Bicycle Crunch Raised Legs
exercises.how_to:
1. Lie on the floor, lift your legs off the ground, and extend them in the air.
2. Place your fingertips behind your head or neck.
3. Take a breath, engage your midsection, and crunch your upper body.
4. Twist your upper body, bringing your right elbow to your left leg. Simultaneously bend your left knee and get it closer to the opposite elbow.
5. Hold for a moment as you breathe out.
6. Extend your body and breathe in.
7. Take your left elbow to your right knee.
8. Keep alternating until you complete the set.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 仰卧在地面上，双腿抬离地面并在空中伸直。
2. 指尖放在头或颈后。
3. 吸气，收紧核心，卷起上半身。
4. 扭转上半身，使右肘靠近左腿。同时弯曲左膝，让它靠近对侧肘部。
5. 保持片刻并呼气。
6. 舒展身体并吸气。
7. 使左肘靠近右膝。
8. 持续交替，直到完成该组。

exercises.title: Bird Dog
exercises.how_to:
1. Get down on all fours. Have your shoulders, elbows, and wrists aligned and your knees directly under your hips. Keep your hands flat on the floor.
2. Engage your abs and take a breath.
3. Extend your right leg back and up, aligning it with your torso. At the same time, extend your left arm and raise it forward. Exhale.
4. Bring your arm and leg to the starting position as you breathe in.
5. Extend your opposite limbs.
6. Keep alternating between opposite limbs until you complete the set.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 跪撑于地面。肩、肘、腕成一直线，膝盖位于髋部正下方。双手平放地面。
2. 收紧腹部，吸气。
3. 向后上方伸直右腿，与躯干成一直线。同时向前伸直并抬起左臂。呼气。
4. 吸气，将手臂和腿收回起始位置。
5. 换另一侧手脚伸展。
6. 持续交替对侧手脚，直到完成该组。

exercises.title: Box Jump
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand in front of a plyometric box or a flat gym bench.
2. Have your feet close and your spine neutral.
3. Take a breath and descend into a quarter squat as you bring your arms back.
4. Immediately jump by pushing through your heels and swinging your arms forward.
5. Exhale as you land on the bench or box.
6. Step off and breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站在跳箱或平板凳前。
2. 双脚靠拢，脊柱保持中立。
3. 吸气，双臂后摆，同时下蹲至四分之一蹲。
4. 脚跟发力并向前摆臂，立即起跳。
5. 落在凳子或跳箱上时呼气。
6. 走下跳箱并吸气。

exercises.title: Box Squat (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the barbell at the appropriate height and position a plyometric box behind you.
2. Unrack the bar as you would for standard squats and take a couple of steps back. The box should be a few inches away from your heels.
3. Take a breath and descend into a squat.
4. Move down until your buttocks touch the box.
5. Hold the position for a moment and push through your heels to squat up. Exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将杠铃调到合适高度，并在身后放一个跳箱。
2. 像做标准深蹲那样解开杠铃，后退几步。跳箱应距离脚跟数英寸。
3. 吸气，下蹲。
4. 下蹲直到臀部触到跳箱。
5. 保持片刻，脚跟发力蹲起。呼气。

exercises.title: Boxing
exercises.how_to: (Hevy provides no How-to steps for this entry.)
exercises.how_to_zh: （Hevy 未提供此动作的分步说明。）

exercises.title: Bulgarian Split Squat (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Face away from a flat gym bench or plyometric box.
2. Grab the barbell, lift it overhead, and position it behind your neck, on top of your trapezius muscle.
3. Extend one leg back, placing the foot on the bench.
4. Bring your shoulders back, engage your midsection, and take a breath.
5. Descend by bending your front knee.
6. Go down until your front thigh is almost parallel to the floor.
7. Hold the bottom position for a moment and push through your heel to extend your leg as you exhale.
8. Do the desired number of reps, switch legs, and match the rep count for your other leg.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 背对平板凳或跳箱。
2. 握住杠铃，举过头顶，置于颈后斜方肌上方。
3. 一条腿向后伸展，把脚搭在凳上。
4. 肩部后收，收紧核心，吸气。
5. 弯曲前腿膝盖下蹲。
6. 下降至前侧大腿几乎与地面平行。
7. 在最低点保持片刻，脚跟发力伸直腿部，同时呼气。
8. 完成目标次数后换腿，另一条腿做相同的次数。

exercises.title: Bulgarian Split Squat (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Face away from a flat gym bench.
2. Grab a pair of dumbbells and extend one leg back, placing the foot on the bench.
3. Bring your shoulders back, engage your midsection, and take a breath.
4. Squat by bending your front leg.
5. Descend until your front thigh is almost parallel to the floor.
6. Hold the bottom position for a moment and push through your heel to extend your leg as you exhale.
7. Do the desired number of reps, switch legs, and match the rep count for your other leg.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 背对平板凳。
2. 拿一对哑铃，一条腿向后伸展，把脚搭在凳上。
3. 肩部后收，收紧核心，吸气。
4. 弯曲前腿下蹲。
5. 下降至前侧大腿几乎与地面平行。
6. 在最低点保持片刻，脚跟发力伸直腿部，同时呼气。
7. 完成目标次数后换腿，另一条腿做相同的次数。

exercises.title: Burpee
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand tall with your feet in a comfortable stance, arms to your sides, and gaze directed forward.
2. Take a breath, lean forward and bend your knees to place your hands flat on the floor, just in front of your feet.
3. Kick your legs back to extend your body into a push-up position. Your shoulders, hips, knees, and ankles should be aligned.
4. Inhale and perform a push-up, descending until your face is an inch or two from the floor (optional). Exhale as you extend your arms.
5. Kick your legs forward to bring your feet just behind your hands as you breathe in.
6. Extend your body and perform a vertical jump as you raise your arms above your head. Exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站直，双脚以舒适的宽度站开，手臂垂于体侧，目视前方。
2. 吸气，前倾屈膝，双手平放在脚前的地面上。
3. 双腿向后蹬出，使身体伸展成俯卧撑姿势。肩、髋、膝、踝应在一条直线上。
4. 吸气做一个俯卧撑，下降至面部离地一两英寸（可选）。伸直手臂时呼气。
5. 吸气，双腿向前收回，使双脚落在双手后方。
6. 身体伸展，双臂举过头顶，垂直起跳。呼气。

exercises.title: Burpee Broad Jumps
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Breathe in, lean forward, place your hands in a comfortable push-up position, and kick your legs back to extend your body.
3. Perform a push-up, touching your chest to the floor.
4. Push yourself up and kick your feet forward, landing them close to your hands.
5. Stand up and perform a double-leg jump as you breathe out.
6. Immediately take another breath and drop down for the next push-up.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站直，双脚与肩同宽。
2. 吸气，前倾，双手撑在舒适的俯卧撑位置，双腿向后蹬出使身体伸展。
3. 做一个俯卧撑，胸部触地。
4. 撑起身体，双腿向前收回，落在靠近双手的位置。
5. 起身双脚起跳，同时呼气。
6. 立即再次吸气，下俯准备下一个俯卧撑。

exercises.title: Burpee Over the Bar
exercises.how_to:
1. Place a barbell on the ground and stand perpendicular to it.
2. Get down into a high plank position.
3. With your body straight and shoulders, elbows, and wrists aligned, take a breath and do a push-up. Push yourself back to the high plank position as you exhale.
4. Kick your feet forward and stand up.
5. Jump laterally over the barbell as you breathe out again.
6. Get down to a high plank position again, breathe in, and perform another push-up.
7. Stand up and jump laterally over the barbell again, repeating the sequence.
8. Keep jumping over the bar until you're finished.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将杠铃放在地面上，侧身站在杠铃旁。
2. 下蹲撑成高平板姿势。
3. 身体绷直，肩、肘、腕成一直线，吸气做一个俯卧撑。呼气时撑回高平板姿势。
4. 双腿向前收回并站起。
5. 再次呼气，同时侧向跳过杠铃。
6. 再次撑成高平板姿势，吸气，做下一个俯卧撑。
7. 站起并再次侧向跳过杠铃，重复该循环。
8. 持续跳过杠铃，直到完成。

exercises.title: Butterfly (Pec Deck)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the load on the pec deck machine.
2. Adjust the seat height so you can grab the handles and have the pads in front of your chest.
3. Sit down, grab the handles, and bring your shoulders back.
4. Engage your abs and take a breath.
5. Flex your chest muscles to bring the handles from your sides to in front of your torso as you breathe out.
6. Bring your arms to your sides as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在蝴蝶机上选择重量。
2. 调整座椅高度，使你能握住把手，且挡垫位于胸前。
3. 坐下，握住把手，肩部后收。
4. 收紧腹部，吸气。
5. 收缩胸肌，将把手从体侧收到躯干前方，同时呼气。
6. 吸气，将手臂收回体侧。

exercises.title: Cable Core Pallof Press
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the load on the cable machine.
2. Place the pulley at chest height and attach a handle.
3. Grab the handle with both hands and stand sideways.
4. Bring your shoulders back, squeeze your glutes, and engage your midsection.
5. Take a breath and press the handle forward, fully extending your arms and exhaling.
6. Pause for a moment and bring the handle to your body as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在绳索器械上选择重量。
2. 将滑轮调至胸部高度并装上把手。
3. 双手握住把手，侧身站立。
4. 肩部后收，收紧臀部，绷紧核心。
5. 吸气，将把手向前推，手臂完全伸直并呼气。
6. 停顿片刻，吸气，将把手收回身体。

exercises.title: Cable Crunch
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a rope attachment with both hands and have your thumbs facing up.
2. Kneel, lean forward, and position the rope behind your head. Keep your hands close to your neck.
3. Once in position, engage your midsection.
4. Initiate the crunch by taking a breath and flexing your abs. Focus on crunching your torso instead of simply moving at the hips.
5. Hold for a moment as you exhale.
6. Slowly raise your torso to bring yourself to the starting position as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双手握住绳索把手，拇指朝上。
2. 跪下，前倾，将绳索置于头后。双手靠近颈部。
3. 到位后绷紧核心。
4. 吸气并收缩腹部，开始卷腹。专注于卷起躯干，而不是只在髋部移动。
5. 保持片刻并呼气。
6. 吸气，缓慢抬起躯干回到起始位置。

exercises.title: Cable Fly Crossovers
exercises.how_to:
1. Adjust the load on the pair of weight stacks inside the cable crossover machine.
2. Set the pulleys in the highest position and attach handles on both.
3. Grab the handles one at a time and position yourself in the middle between the two pillars.
4. Bring your arms to your sides and take a half step forward to lift the weights from their stacks.
5. Engage your abs, bring your shoulders back, and inhale.
6. Bring your arms in and down, meeting your knuckles in front of your hips. Exhale.
7. Hold for a moment and bring your arms to your sides as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 调整绳索交叉器械两侧配重片的重量。
2. 将两个滑轮调至最高位置并装上把手。
3. 依次握住两个把手，站到两根立柱中间。
4. 手臂置于体侧，向前迈半步，将重量提起离开配重片。
5. 收紧腹部，肩部后收，吸气。
6. 手臂向内向下合拢，在髋部前方双手相触。呼气。
7. 保持片刻，吸气，将手臂收回体侧。

exercises.title: Cable Pull Through
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load on a single or double cable machine station.
2. Set the pulley in the lowest position and attach a handle or rope.
3. Face away from the cable machine, lean forward, grab the attachment, and hold it between your legs.
4. Take a step or two forward to lift the weight from its stack.
5. Engage your abs and take a breath.
6. Hinge at the hips, leaning your torso forward while keeping your back neutral.
7. Lean forward until your torso is roughly parallel to the floor and extend your body by driving your hips forward. Exhale as you stand tall.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在单柱或双柱绳索器械上选择合适的重量。
2. 将滑轮调至最低位置，装上把手或绳索。
3. 背对绳索器械，前倾，握住连接件并夹在双腿之间。
4. 向前走一两步，将重量提起离开配重片。
5. 收紧腹部，吸气。
6. 以髋部为轴，上身前倾，背部保持中立。
7. 前倾至躯干大致与地面平行，然后髋部前顶使身体站直。站直时呼气。

exercises.title: Cable Twist (Down to up)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load on the cable machine.
2. Place the pulley in the lowest position and attach a handle to it.
3. Grab the handle with both hands, keeping your wrists neutral (facing one another).
4. Take a step away from the cable machine and stand sideways with your feet wide enough to create a stable base.
5. With the handle at your waist and arms straight, engage your abs and take a breath.
6. Pull the cable diagonally and upward across your body, twisting your torso and exhaling.
7. Hold for a second and rotate your torso to the starting position as you breathe in.
8. Once finished training one side, turn your body 180 degrees and do the same number of reps for the other side.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在绳索器械上选择合适的重量。
2. 将滑轮调至最低位置并装上把手。
3. 双手握住把手，手腕保持中立（相对）。
4. 远离绳索器械迈一步，侧身站立，双脚分开以形成稳定的支撑。
5. 把手位于腰部、手臂伸直，收紧腹部，吸气。
6. 将绳索沿对角线向上拉过身体，扭转躯干并呼气。
7. 保持一秒，吸气，将躯干转回起始位置。
8. 一侧练完后，身体转 180 度，另一侧做相同的次数。

exercises.title: Cable Twist (Up to down)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load on the cable machine.
2. Place the pulley in the highest position and attach a handle to it.
3. Grab the handle with both hands, keeping your wrists neutral (facing one another).
4. Take a step away from the cable machine and stand sideways.
5. With the handle at shoulder level and arms straight, engage your abs and breathe in.
6. Pull the cable diagonally across your body, twisting your torso and exhaling.
7. Rotate your body to the starting position as you breathe in.
8. Once finished, turn your body 180 degrees and do the same number of reps for the other side.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在绳索器械上选择合适的重量。
2. 将滑轮调至最高位置并装上把手。
3. 双手握住把手，手腕保持中立（相对）。
4. 远离绳索器械迈一步，侧身站立。
5. 把手位于肩部高度、手臂伸直，收紧腹部，吸气。
6. 将绳索沿对角线拉过身体，扭转躯干并呼气。
7. 吸气，将身体转回起始位置。
8. 完成后，身体转 180 度，另一侧做相同的次数。

exercises.title: Calf Extension (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load on the calf extension machine.
2. Sit down and grab the handles by your sides.
3. Place the balls of your feet on the footplate. Your legs should be straight.
4. Take a breath and flex your ankles to push the plate away as you exhale.
5. Hold for a moment and allow your ankles to bend as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在小腿伸展器械上选择合适的重量。
2. 坐下，握住体侧的把手。
3. 前脚掌踩在踏板上。双腿保持伸直。
4. 吸气，绷脚踝将踏板推开，同时呼气。
5. 保持片刻，吸气，让脚踝弯曲。

exercises.title: Calf Press (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Load a leg press machine and sit down.
2. Raise your legs and place the balls of your feet at the edge of the footplate.
3. Bring your shoulders back and grab the handles by your sides.
4. Extend your knees to unrack the weight.
5. Flex your ankles to press the platform away from yourself and hold for a moment as you breathe out.
6. Allow your ankles to bend and stretch your calves as you breathe in.
7. Once finished, turn the handles you’re holding to secure the weight.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 为腿举器械加上重量并坐下。
2. 抬起双腿，前脚掌踩在踏板边缘。
3. 肩部后收，握住体侧的把手。
4. 伸直膝盖，解开重量。
5. 绷脚踝将踏板推离身体，保持片刻并呼气。
6. 吸气，让脚踝弯曲并拉伸小腿。
7. 完成后，转动所握的把手将重量锁定。

exercises.title: Chest Dip
exercises.how_to:
1. Grip a parallel bar slightly outside shoulder-width level.
2. Bring your shoulders back and engage your abs.
3. Raise yourself and stand over the dip bar with your elbows fully extended.
4. Tilt your body forward.
5. Take a breath and dip by bending at the elbows. Maintain your body’s position as you move down.
6. Lower yourself until you feel a good pectoral stretch (generally to the point where your elbows are at a 90-degree angle).
7. Push yourself back to the top, exhaling at the top.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双手略宽于肩握住双杠。
2. 肩部后收，收紧腹部。
3. 撑起身体，手臂完全伸直支撑在双杠上方。
4. 身体前倾。
5. 吸气，屈肘下降。下降过程中保持身体姿势。
6. 下降至胸肌有明显拉伸感（通常到肘部呈 90 度角）。
7. 撑回顶端，在顶端呼气。

exercises.title: Chest Dip (Assisted)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the correct weight on the chest dip machine.
2. Grab the pair of handles and place your knees over the pads.
3. Extend your arms, bring your shoulders back, and squeeze your abs.
4. Take a breath and lower yourself by bending your elbows.
5. Descend until your elbows are at roughly 90 degrees, and push yourself back to the top as you exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在双杠臂屈伸器械上选择合适的重量。
2. 握住两个把手，膝盖跪在挡垫上。
3. 伸直手臂，肩部后收，收紧腹部。
4. 吸气，屈肘下降。
5. 下降至肘部约 90 度，然后撑回顶端并呼气。

exercises.title: Chest Dip (Weighted)
exercises.how_to:
1. Attach a weight plate to yourself via a special belt.
2. Step on the platform and grab the parallel bars while keeping your arms straight and close to your body.
3. Bring your shoulders back and down, engage your abs, and squeeze your glutes.
4. Take your feet off the platform to suspend yourself in the air.
5. Lean forward slightly.
6. Take a breath and lower yourself by bending your elbows. Keep your shoulder blades retracted and your body steady.
7. Descend until your elbows form a 90-degree angle and hold for a moment.
8. Press yourself back to the top, extending your arms fully and exhaling.
9. Take another breath and repeat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 用专用腰带将杠铃片固定在身上。
2. 踏上踏板，双手握住双杠，手臂伸直并贴近身体。
3. 肩部后收下沉，收紧腹部，夹紧臀部。
4. 双脚离开踏板，使身体悬空。
5. 身体略微前倾。
6. 吸气，屈肘下放身体。保持肩胛骨后收，身体稳定。
7. 下放至肘部呈 90 度，稍作停顿。
8. 用力撑起回到顶端，手臂完全伸展并呼气。
9. 再次吸气，重复动作。

exercises.title: Chest Fly (Band)
exercises.how_to:
1. Take an open-ended resistance band with handles on both ends.
2. Anchor the band on something sturdy (e.g., a squat rack).
3. Turn away from the anchor point and grab both handles, keeping them close to your body.
4. Take a couple of steps forward to lengthen the band and bring your arms to your sides without flaring your elbows.
5. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and take a breath.
6. Move your arms forward and tap your knuckles in front of your chest while keeping your elbows slightly bent. Breathe out.
7. Bring your arms to the sides as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 取一条两端带握把的阻力带。
2. 将阻力带固定在牢固的物体上（如深蹲架）。
3. 背对固定点，双手握住两个握把，贴近身体。
4. 向前走几步拉长阻力带，双臂置于身体两侧，肘部不要外展。
5. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，吸气。
6. 双臂向前移动，在胸前轻碰指关节，肘部保持微屈。呼气。
7. 吸气，双臂回到身体两侧。

exercises.title: Chest Fly (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of light dumbbells and sit on the edge of a flat gym bench.
2. Place the weights on your thighs and lie back, keeping the dumbbells close to your body.
3. Extend your arms and position the dumbbells over your chest with your palms facing one another.
4. Plant your feet on the floor and bring your shoulders back.
5. Take a breath.
6. Lower your arms to your sides until they align with your torso.
7. Bring your arms in, tapping the dumbbells over your chest as you exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 取一对轻哑铃，坐在平板凳边缘。
2. 将哑铃放在大腿上，仰卧躺下，保持哑铃贴近身体。
3. 手臂伸直，将哑铃举于胸部上方，掌心相对。
4. 双脚踩实地面，肩部后收。
5. 吸气。
6. 双臂向两侧下放，直至与躯干平行。
7. 呼气，双臂内收，在胸部上方让哑铃相碰。

exercises.title: Chest Fly (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load and adjust the seat height. The machine’s handles should be at chest level when you sit.
2. Sit down, bring your shoulders back, and reach to the sides to grab the handles.
3. Engage your abs and take a breath.
4. Squeeze your chest and bring your arms in, tapping your knuckles lightly in front of your chest as you breathe out.
5. Bring your arms to your sides, feeling your chest muscles stretch. Breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的配重并调整座椅高度。坐下时器械握把应与胸部同高。
2. 坐下，肩部后收，向两侧伸手握住握把。
3. 收紧腹部，吸气。
4. 夹紧胸肌，双臂内收，呼气时在胸前轻碰指关节。
5. 双臂回到身体两侧，感受胸肌拉伸。吸气。

exercises.title: Chest Fly (Suspension)
exercises.how_to:
1. Face away from the anchor point of your suspension kit and grab both handles.
2. Straighten your arms, raise them in front of your body, and engage your abs.
3. Walk your feet back enough to lean your body forward. Support yourself with your arms.
4. Take a breath and slowly bring your arms to your sides, lowering yourself and stretching your pectorals.
5. Extend your arms to your sides as much as your strength allows, hold for a moment, and bring them in, raising yourself in the process.
6. Tap your knuckles at the top position and exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 背对悬吊带的固定点，双手握住两个握把。
2. 手臂伸直，向前抬起，收紧腹部。
3. 双脚向后走，使身体前倾。用双臂支撑身体。
4. 吸气，双臂缓慢向两侧打开，身体下放，拉伸胸肌。
5. 在力所能及的范围内将双臂向两侧展开，稍作停顿，然后内收并撑起身体。
6. 在顶端位置让指关节相碰，呼气。

exercises.title: Chest Press (Band)
exercises.how_to:
1. Take an open-ended resistance band with handle attachments.
2. Anchor the band on something sturdy at chest height. A squat rack can work.
3. Face away from the anchor point and grab both handles, raising your arms high and keeping your elbows tucked.
4. Take a couple of steps forward to stretch the band and create some tension.
5. Bring your shoulders back, stagger your stance, engage your midsection, and take a breath.
6. Press the band forward and extend your arms fully as you exhale.
7. Bend your arms, bringing your knuckles to the sides of your chest, as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 取一条带握把的阻力带。
2. 将阻力带固定在胸部高度牢固的物体上，深蹲架即可。
3. 背对固定点，双手握住两个握把，双臂抬高，肘部收紧。
4. 向前走几步拉长阻力带，形成一定张力。
5. 肩部后收，前后开立站稳，收紧核心，吸气。
6. 呼气，将阻力带向前推出，手臂完全伸展。
7. 吸气，屈臂，让指关节回到胸部两侧。

exercises.title: Chest Press (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load on the machine.
2. Adjust the seat height. The handles should be slightly below your lower chest when you sit down.
3. Sit down, grab the handles, bring your shoulders back, and engage your abs. Have your feet flat on the floor.
4. Take a breath and press until your arms extend fully. Exhale.
5. Bend your arms slowly as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在器械上选择合适的配重。
2. 调整座椅高度。坐下时握把应略低于下胸。
3. 坐下，握住握把，肩部后收，收紧腹部。双脚平放地面。
4. 吸气，向前推至手臂完全伸展。呼气。
5. 吸气，缓慢屈臂还原。

exercises.title: Chest Supported Incline Row (Dumbbell)
exercises.title_zh: 哑铃胸部支撑上斜划船
exercises.how_to:
1. Set an adjustable gym bench at an incline of 30 to 45 degrees.
2. Grab a pair of dumbbells and position yourself on the bench with your stomach and chest on the back support.
3. Have your arms extended and hanging straight down.
4. Bring your shoulders back, squeeze your glutes, and engage your abs.
5. Rotate your wrists out so your knuckles face forward.
6. Take a breath and row the dumbbells as high as possible in one fluid motion. Exhale at the top.
7. Lower the weights slowly, breathing in on the way down.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将可调凳调至 30 至 45 度的上斜角度。
2. 取一对哑铃，俯卧在凳上，腹部和胸部贴住靠背垫。
3. 双臂伸直，自然下垂。
4. 肩部后收，夹紧臀部，收紧腹部。
5. 手腕向外旋转，使指关节朝前。
6. 吸气，以流畅的动作将哑铃尽可能高地划起。顶端呼气。
7. 缓慢下放哑铃，下放过程中吸气。

exercises.title: Chest Supported Reverse Fly (Dumbbell)
exercises.title_zh: 哑铃胸部支撑反向飞鸟
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of light dumbbells and position yourself face down on an incline gym bench.
2. Keep your body straight and support yourself on the balls of your feet.
3. Your arms should be straight and vertical, with your palms facing one another.
4. Bring your shoulders back and take a breath.
5. Lift the dumbbells to your sides and back, stopping when you feel tension in the posterior of your shoulders. Exhale.
6. Hold for a moment and bring your arms down slowly as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 取一对轻哑铃，俯卧在上斜凳上。
2. 保持身体挺直，用前脚掌支撑。
3. 双臂伸直下垂，掌心相对。
4. 肩部后收，吸气。
5. 将哑铃向两侧和后方抬起，感到肩后束发力时停止。呼气。
6. 稍作停顿，吸气，双臂缓慢下放。

exercises.title: Chest Supported T Bar Row
exercises.title_zh: 胸部支撑 T 杠划船
exercises.how_to:
1. Add weight to the bar.
2. Get on the machine and position your chest and stomach on the pad, and your feet on the platform.
3. Reach forward and grab both handles with an overhand grip - palms facing down.
4. Unrack the bar and bring it to the middle.
5. Breathe in and pull the bar in one fluid motion, squeezing your upper back and breathing out.
6. Slowly extend your arms as you breathe in.
7. Repeat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在杠铃上加负重。
2. 上器械，将胸部和腹部贴住靠垫，双脚踩在踏板上。
3. 向前伸手，用正握（掌心向下）握住两个握把。
4. 解开杠铃，将其移至中间位置。
5. 吸气，以流畅的动作拉动杠铃，夹紧上背并呼气。
6. 吸气，缓慢伸直手臂还原。
7. 重复动作。

exercises.title: Chest Supported Y Raise (Dumbbell)
exercises.title_zh: 哑铃胸部支撑 Y 字举
exercises.how_to:
1. Set a gym bench at a 45-degree incline.
2. Grab a pair of light dumbbells and sit down with your chest and stomach against the back support and arms hanging straight down.
3. Take a deep breath and lift the dumbbells forward and up in one fluid motion, exhaling at the top.
4. Lower the weights to the starting position as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将训练凳调至 45 度上斜。
2. 取一对轻哑铃，坐下，胸部和腹部贴住靠背垫，双臂自然垂于体侧。
3. 深吸气，以流畅的动作将哑铃向前上方举起，顶端呼气。
4. 吸气，将哑铃下放回起始位置。

exercises.title: Chin Up
exercises.how_to:
1. Reach up and grab a pull-up bar with a double underhand grip (palms facing back). Your hands should be shoulder-width apart or slightly closer.
2. Retract your shoulders, engage your abs, squeeze your glutes, and cross your lower legs, lifting your feet off the floor.
3. Take a breath and pull yourself up in one fluid motion. Aim to have your chin over the bar at the top. Exhale.
4. Lower yourself slowly and breathe in. Don’t rest your feet on the floor.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 向上伸手，以反握（掌心朝向自己）握住引体向上杆。双手与肩同宽或略窄。
2. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，夹紧臀部，小腿交叉，双脚离地。
3. 吸气，以流畅的动作将身体拉起。顶端尽量让下巴超过横杆。呼气。
4. 吸气，缓慢下放身体。双脚不要触地休息。

exercises.title: Chin Up (Assisted)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load on the machine.
2. Reach up and grab the bar with a double underhand grip (palms facing back). Have your hands shoulder-width apart.
3. Place your knees on top of the machine pad.
4. Bring your shoulders back, squeeze your glutes, and engage your abs.
5. Take a breath and pull yourself up in one fluid motion, exhaling at the top.
6. Lower yourself slowly, extending your arms fully. Breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在器械上选择合适的配重。
2. 向上伸手，以反握（掌心朝向自己）握住横杆。双手与肩同宽。
3. 双膝跪在器械的托垫上。
4. 肩部后收，夹紧臀部，收紧腹部。
5. 吸气，以流畅的动作将身体拉起，顶端呼气。
6. 吸气，缓慢下放身体，手臂完全伸直。

exercises.title: Chin Up (Weighted)
exercises.how_to:
1. Attach a weight plate to yourself with a special weight belt.
2. Reach up and grab a pull-up bar with a double underhand grip (palms facing back).
3. Retract your shoulders, engage your abs, squeeze your glutes, and cross your lower legs, lifting your feet off the floor.
4. Take a breath and pull yourself up in one fluid motion as you breathe out.
5. Lower yourself slowly, extending your arms fully, and breathe in. Don’t rest your feet on the floor.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 用专用负重腰带将杠铃片固定在身上。
2. 向上伸手，以反握（掌心朝向自己）握住引体向上杆。
3. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，夹紧臀部，小腿交叉，双脚离地。
4. 吸气，以流畅的动作将身体拉起，同时呼气。
5. 缓慢下放身体，手臂完全伸直，吸气。双脚不要触地休息。

exercises.title: Clamshell
exercises.how_to:
1. Lie on one side with your legs stacked, knees bent, bottom shoulder at 90 degrees, and the forearm flat on the floor for balance. You can wrap a mini looped resistance band over your thighs for additional resistance.
2. Maintain a neutral spine and breathe in.
3. Raise your top knee while keeping your feet together. The movement should resemble a clamshell opening.
4. Lift your knee as much as possible in one fluid motion and exhale.
5. Lower your knee to the bottom as you breathe in.
6. Once finished, flip to your other side and do the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 侧卧，双腿叠放，屈膝，下方手臂肩部呈 90 度，前臂贴地保持平衡。可在大腿上方套一条迷你环形阻力带以增加阻力。
2. 保持脊柱中立，吸气。
3. 双脚保持并拢，抬起上方膝盖。动作如蚌壳张开。
4. 以流畅的动作尽可能抬高膝盖，呼气。
5. 吸气，将膝盖下放还原。
6. 完成后换另一侧，做相同次数。

exercises.title: Clap Push Ups
exercises.how_to:
1. Get down on all fours and extend your body into a push-up position. Your body should be straight, and your shoulders, elbows, and wrists should be aligned.
2. Bring your shoulders back and squeeze your buttocks.
3. Take a breath and lower yourself by bending your elbows.
4. Descend until your face is an inch or two from the floor and hold for a moment.
5. Push yourself as explosively as possible, lifting your hands off the floor. Breathe out.
6. Immediately bring your hands together and clap before planting them on the floor.
7. Breathe in as you lower yourself.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 跪撑后伸直身体成俯卧撑姿势。身体保持挺直，肩、肘、腕成一直线。
2. 肩部后收，夹紧臀部。
3. 吸气，屈肘下放身体。
4. 下放至面部距离地面一两英寸，稍作停顿。
5. 尽可能爆发性地撑起，双手离地。呼气。
6. 双手立即并拢击掌，然后撑回地面。
7. 吸气，下放身体。

exercises.title: Clean
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand in front of a loaded barbell with your shins a couple of inches away. Your feet should be hip-width apart with toes pointed slightly out.
2. Bend down and grab the barbell with an even, overhand grip. Have your knees against the crease of your elbows.
3. Bring your chest out to put your back in a neutral position. Your hips should be slightly higher than your knees.
4. Initiate the first pull by deadlifting the barbell off the floor as you press your heels into the ground. Make the initial pull powerful to generate momentum for the next part of the lift.
5. Once the barbell travels above your knees, keep driving your hips forward as you begin pulling the weight in a straight vertical line. The entire sequence should happen in one smooth motion.
6. As the barbell travels up, squat, catch it, and have it land over your shoulders and upper chest. Maintain a firm grip on the barbell, and keep your elbows pointing forward.
7. As the barbell lands in a front rack position, dip a few extra inches until your thighs are parallel to the floor and squat to the top, straightening your knees fully and exhaling.
8. Lower the barbell slowly and hinge at the hip to maintain a neutral spine. Breathe in as the bar moves down or before initiating the next rep.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站在装有杠铃片的杠铃前，小腿距杠铃约两英寸。双脚与髋同宽，脚尖略微外展。
2. 俯身，用等宽正握握住杠铃。让膝盖抵住肘窝。
3. 挺胸，使背部保持中立位。髋部应略高于膝盖。
4. 脚跟蹬地，将杠铃拉离地面，开始第一次发力。初次上拉要爆发有力，为后续动作积蓄惯性。
5. 当杠铃超过膝盖后，持续向前顶髋，同时沿垂直直线拉起杠铃。整个动作应连贯流畅。
6. 杠铃上升时下蹲接杠，使其落于肩部和上胸位置。握紧杠铃，肘部朝前。
7. 杠铃落到前架位后，再下蹲几英寸，直至大腿与地面平行，然后起身站直，膝关节完全伸直并呼气。
8. 缓慢下放杠铃，以髋部铰链动作保持脊柱中立。杠铃下放过程中或开始下一次动作前吸气。

exercises.title: Clean Pull
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand in front of a barbell. Your feet should be hip-width apart and the barbell should be over the mid-foot.
2. Lean forward and grab the barbell with an even overhand grip.
3. Bring your shoulders back to straighten your back, lower yourself to the bar, and pull the slack off the barbell.
4. Take a breath and initiate the pull by digging your heels into the floor.
5. Extend your hips and knees while maintaining a neutral back position.
6. As the barbell travels up, extend your knees and hips.
7. Once the barbell goes over your knees, initiate the second stage by forcefully pressing your heels into the floor as if you were trying to do a vertical jump.
8. As the barbell continues moving up, drive your hips forward, fully extending your knees and hips.
9. Immediately shrug your shoulders and pull upward until the bar goes slightly above your waist. Exhale forcefully.
10. Lower the barbell slowly by first bringing your glutes back. Keep your chest out and back straight. Breathe in on the way down or before initiating the next rep.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站在杠铃前。双脚与髋同宽，杠铃位于脚掌中部上方。
2. 俯身，用等宽正握握住杠铃。
3. 肩部后收以挺直背部，身体下沉贴合杠铃，拉紧杠铃的空隙。
4. 吸气，脚跟蹬地开始上拉。
5. 伸展髋部和膝盖，同时保持背部中立。
6. 杠铃上升时，伸展膝盖和髋部。
7. 杠铃超过膝盖后，用力将脚跟压向地面，如同做垂直起跳，进入第二阶段。
8. 杠铃继续上升时，向前顶髋，完全伸展膝盖和髋部。
9. 立即耸肩并向上提拉，直至杠铃略高于腰部。用力呼气。
10. 先向后送臀，缓慢下放杠铃。保持挺胸、背部挺直。下放过程中或开始下一次动作前吸气。

exercises.title: Clean and Jerk
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand in front of a loaded barbell with your shins a couple of inches away. Your feet should be hip-width apart, with toes pointed slightly out.
2. Bend down and grab the barbell with an even, overhand grip. Have your knees against the crease of your elbows.
3. Bring your chest out to put your back in a neutral position. Your hips should be slightly higher than your knees.
4. Initiate the first pull by deadlifting the barbell off the floor as you press your heels into the ground. Make the initial pull powerful to generate momentum for the next part of the lift.
5. Once the barbell travels above your knees, keep driving your hips forward as you begin pulling the weight in a straight vertical line. The entire sequence should happen in one smooth motion.
6. As the barbell travels up, squat, catch it, and have it land over your shoulders and upper chest. Maintain a firm grip on the barbell, and keep your elbows pointing forward.
7. As the barbell lands in a front rack position, dip a few extra inches until your thighs are parallel to the floor and squat to the top, straightening your knees fully and breathing out.
8. Take another breath, dip slightly, and jerk the bar, bringing it over your head, extending your elbows and knees.
9. Lower the barbell to your shoulders and breathe out.
10. Bring the bar to the floor while keeping your back neutral. Breathe in on the way down or before initiating the next rep.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站在装有杠铃片的杠铃前，小腿距杠铃约两英寸。双脚与髋同宽，脚尖略微外展。
2. 俯身，用等宽正握握住杠铃。让膝盖抵住肘窝。
3. 挺胸，使背部保持中立位。髋部应略高于膝盖。
4. 脚跟蹬地，将杠铃拉离地面，开始第一次发力。初次上拉要爆发有力，为后续动作积蓄惯性。
5. 当杠铃超过膝盖后，持续向前顶髋，同时沿垂直直线拉起杠铃。整个动作应连贯流畅。
6. 杠铃上升时下蹲接杠，使其落于肩部和上胸位置。握紧杠铃，肘部朝前。
7. 杠铃落到前架位后，再下蹲几英寸，直至大腿与地面平行，然后起身站直，膝关节完全伸直并呼气。
8. 再次吸气，微微屈膝预蹲，用力上挺杠铃至头顶，同时伸直肘部和膝盖。
9. 将杠铃下放至肩部，呼气。
10. 保持背部中立，将杠铃放回地面。下放过程中或开始下一次动作前吸气。

exercises.title: Clean and Press
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand in front of a loaded barbell with your shins a couple of inches away. Your feet should be hip-width apart, with toes pointed slightly out.
2. Lean forward and grab the barbell with an even, overhand grip. Have your knees against the crease of your elbows.
3. Bring your chest out to put your back in a neutral position. Your hips should be slightly higher than your knees.
4. Initiate the first pull by deadlifting the barbell off the floor as you press your heels into the ground. Make the initial pull powerful to generate momentum for the next part of the lift.
5. Once the barbell travels above your knees, keep driving your hips forward as you begin pulling the weight in a straight vertical line. The entire sequence should happen in one smooth motion.
6. As the barbell travels up, squat, catch it, and have it land over your shoulders and upper chest. Maintain a firm grip on the barbell and keep your elbows pointing forward.
7. As the barbell lands in a front rack position, dip a few extra inches until your thighs are parallel to the floor and squat to the top, straightening your knees fully and exhaling.
8. Take another breath and press the bar straight up, bringing your head back to avoid bumping your nose or chin. Exhale again.
9. Lower the bar to your shoulders before returning it to the starting position.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站在装有杠铃片的杠铃前，小腿距杠铃约两英寸。双脚与髋同宽，脚尖略微外展。
2. 俯身，用等宽正握握住杠铃。让膝盖抵住肘窝。
3. 挺胸，使背部保持中立位。髋部应略高于膝盖。
4. 脚跟蹬地，将杠铃拉离地面，开始第一次发力。初次上拉要爆发有力，为后续动作积蓄惯性。
5. 当杠铃超过膝盖后，持续向前顶髋，同时沿垂直直线拉起杠铃。整个动作应连贯流畅。
6. 杠铃上升时下蹲接杠，使其落于肩部和上胸位置。握紧杠铃，肘部朝前。
7. 杠铃落到前架位后，再下蹲几英寸，直至大腿与地面平行，然后起身站直，膝关节完全伸直并呼气。
8. 再次吸气，将杠铃垂直向上推起，头部后移以免碰到鼻子或下巴。再次呼气。
9. 将杠铃下放至肩部，然后放回起始位置。

exercises.how_to: (Hevy provides no How-to steps for this entry.)
exercises.how_to_zh: （Hevy 未提供此动作的分步说明。）

exercises.title: Concentration Curl
exercises.how_to:
1. Take a light dumbbell and sit on a flat gym bench.
2. Spread your legs wide and place the dumbbell between your legs.
3. Reach down and grab the weight with your right hand.
4. Lift the weight off the floor and place the right tricep (upper arm) against your inner leg.
5. Keep your chest out and body stable, take a breath, and straighten your arm.
6. Curl the dumbbell until your wrist is higher than your elbow. Keep your upper arm in the same position against your inner leg. Squeeze your muscle at the top as you breathe out.
7. Lower the dumbbell slowly and extend your elbow entirely as you breathe in.
8. Once finished, do the same number of reps for your other arm.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 取一只轻哑铃，坐在平板凳上。
2. 双腿分开，将哑铃放在两腿之间。
3. 俯身用右手握住哑铃。
4. 将哑铃提离地面，右臂肱三头肌（上臂）贴住大腿内侧。
5. 挺胸，身体保持稳定，吸气，手臂伸直。
6. 弯举哑铃直至手腕高于肘部。上臂始终贴住大腿内侧。顶端夹紧肌肉并呼气。
7. 吸气，缓慢下放哑铃，肘部完全伸直。
8. 完成后换另一只手臂，做相同次数。

exercises.title: Cross Body Hammer Curl
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells and stand tall.
2. Have your feet in a normal stance, arms to your sides, and palms facing your body.
3. Bring your shoulders back, squeeze your buttocks, and take a breath.
4. Curl one dumbbell across your body and in front of your chest as you breathe out.
5. Extend your arm as you breathe in.
6. Curl the other dumbbell and alternate until you finish the set.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 取一对哑铃，站直。
2. 双脚自然站立，双臂垂于体侧，掌心朝向身体。
3. 肩部后收，夹紧臀部，吸气。
4. 呼气，将一侧哑铃向身体另一侧弯举至胸前。
5. 吸气，伸直手臂还原。
6. 换另一侧哑铃弯举，交替进行直至完成本组。

exercises.title: Crunch
exercises.how_to:
1. Lie on the floor, bend your knees, and place your feet flat on the floor.
2. Bring your arms up and place your fingertips behind your head.
3. Engage your abs and take a breath.
4. Crunch by bending your torso, lifting your shoulder blades several inches off the floor. Exhale at the top.
5. Lower yourself slowly and breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 仰卧于地面，屈膝，双脚平放地面。
2. 抬起双臂，指尖置于脑后。
3. 收紧腹部，吸气。
4. 弯曲躯干做卷腹，将肩胛骨抬离地面几英寸。在最高点呼气。
5. 缓慢下降并吸气。

exercises.title: Crunch (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load.
2. Sit down on the machine. Secure your ankles on the bottom pads, have the middle pad against your lower back, and position your chest on the top pad.
3. Grab the handles for support.
4. Take a breath and flex your abs to push the top pad forward. Exhale.
5. Release as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的配重。
2. 坐到器械上。脚踝固定在下方的垫子上，中间靠垫贴住下背，胸部靠在顶部靠垫上。
3. 握住握把以支撑身体。
4. 吸气，收紧腹肌将顶部靠垫向前推。呼气。
5. 吸气，还原。

exercises.title: Crunch (Weighted)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a weight plate and lie on the floor.
2. Position the weight over your chest.
3. Bring your legs together, bend your knees, and plant your feet on the floor.
4. Take a breath and engage your abs to crunch your torso, lifting your shoulder blades several inches off the floor. Breathe out.
5. Lower your torso to the floor as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 取一片杠铃片，仰卧于地面。
2. 将杠铃片置于胸部上方。
3. 双腿并拢，屈膝，双脚踩实地面。
4. 吸气，收紧腹肌卷起躯干，使肩胛骨离地数英寸。呼气。
5. 吸气，将躯干下放回地面。

exercises.title: Curtsy Lunge (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand.
2. Engage your abs, bring your shoulders back, and take a breath.
3. Bring your right leg back in a semi-circle, crossing your left leg.
4. Plant the ball of the foot on the floor and descend into a lunge.
5. Descend until your back knee almost touches the floor.
6. Push through your front heel to extend your leg and bring the right leg to its starting position as you exhale.
7. Inhale again and perform the same motion with the opposite leg.
8. Alternate between the left and right leg until you’re done.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双手各持一只哑铃，站直。
2. 收紧腹部，肩部后收，吸气。
3. 右腿向后划半圆，交叉跨过左腿。
4. 前脚掌落地，下蹲成弓步。
5. 下蹲至后侧膝盖几乎触地。
6. 呼气，前脚脚跟发力蹬起，伸直腿部，右腿回到起始位置。
7. 再次吸气，换另一侧腿做相同动作。
8. 左右腿交替进行直至完成。

exercises.title: Cycling
exercises.how_to: (Hevy provides no How-to steps for this entry.)
exercises.how_to_zh: （Hevy 未提供此动作的分步说明。）

exercises.title: Dead Bug
exercises.how_to:
1. Place an exercise mat on the ground and lie down.
2. Lift your feet off the floor and bend your knees at a 90-degree angle.
3. Lift your arms over your chest.
4. Engage your abs to maintain a spinal curve, and take a breath.
5. Extend your left leg, bringing the foot an inch or two away from the floor.
6. Simultaneously extend your right arm back, bringing the hand close to the floor (optional). Breathe out.
7. Bring your arm and leg to the starting position as you breathe in.
8. Extend your opposite arm and leg.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在地上铺好训练垫，仰卧。
2. 双脚离地，屈膝呈 90 度。
3. 双臂抬起置于胸部上方。
4. 收紧腹肌以保持脊柱弧度，吸气。
5. 伸直左腿，使脚距离地面一两英寸。
6. 同时右臂向后伸展，使手贴近地面（可选）。呼气。
7. 吸气，将手臂和腿收回起始位置。
8. 伸展对侧手臂和腿。

exercises.title: Dead Hang
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand underneath a pull-up bar.
2. Reach up and grab the bar with an even overhand grip.
3. Lift your feet off the floor and keep your legs together.
4. Relax your shoulders and midsection, supporting yourself on grip strength.
5. Hang for as long as possible, breathing regularly as you do.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站在引体向上杆下方。
2. 向上伸手，用等宽正握握住横杆。
3. 双脚离地，双腿并拢。
4. 放松肩部和核心，依靠握力支撑身体。
5. 尽可能长时间悬垂，期间保持均匀呼吸。

exercises.title: Deadlift (Band)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab an open-ended resistance band with handles on both sides.
2. Step over the band, keeping your feet a few inches apart.
3. Straighten your body, bring your shoulders back, and engage your abs.
4. Take a breath and hinge at the hip to lean forward.
5. As you move down, bend your knees to maintain a neutral spine position.
6. Move down as much as you can––ideally, until your hands are several inches off the floor.
7. Hold for a moment and extend your body by driving your hips forward.
8. Exhale near the top.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 取一条两侧带握把的阻力带。
2. 跨站在阻力带上，双脚相距几英寸。
3. 身体挺直，肩部后收，收紧腹部。
4. 吸气，以髋部为轴向前俯身。
5. 下放过程中屈膝，保持脊柱中立。
6. 尽可能下放——理想情况下至双手离地数英寸。
7. 稍作停顿，向前顶髋伸展身体。
8. 接近顶端时呼气。

exercises.title: Deadlift (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand in front of a loaded barbell.
2. The bar should be over mid-foot, your shins should be an inch or two from the bar, and your feet should be hip-width apart, with toes pointing slightly out.
3. Lean forward and grab the bar with a double overhand grip.
4. Bend your knees to position your shins against the bar. Simultaneously, retract your shoulders to straighten your back.
5. Take a breath.
6. Initiate the pull by digging your heels into the floor.
7. Lift the bar in a straight vertical line, keeping it close to your body.
8. As the bar passes your knees, begin to extend your legs and drive your hips forward to complete the repetition.
9. Begin the descent by driving your buttocks back and keeping your back neutral.
10. Lower the barbell in the same vertical line, exhaling near the bottom.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站在装有杠铃片的杠铃前。
2. 杠铃应位于脚掌中部上方，小腿距杠铃约一两英寸，双脚与髋同宽，脚尖略微外展。
3. 俯身，用双正握握住杠铃。
4. 屈膝使小腿贴住杠铃。同时后收肩部以挺直背部。
5. 吸气。
6. 脚跟蹬地开始上拉。
7. 沿垂直直线拉起杠铃，使其贴近身体。
8. 杠铃过膝后，开始伸腿并向前顶髋，完成动作。
9. 向后送臀开始下放，保持背部中立。
10. 沿同一条垂直直线下放杠铃，接近底部时呼气。

exercises.title: Deadlift (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Have your feet hip-width apart, and position a pair of dumbbells parallel to them. When seen from the top, the front weight plate of each dumbbell should align with your mid-foot.
2. Bend forward and grab the dumbbells while keeping your arms straight.
3. Bring your chest out without lifting the dumbbells to put your back into a neutral position.
4. Take a breath and initiate the lift by pressing through your heels as you engage your upper body and legs.
5. Lift the dumbbells in a straight vertical line, moving them to your sides.
6. Extend your hips and knees simultaneously, especially as the dumbbells pass the knees, and continue up until you’re standing. Breathe out at the top.
7. Begin the descent by breaking at the hips and pushing your buttocks back—lower the weights in the same straight line.
8. Breathe in as the weights move down or before initiating the next rep.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双脚与髋同宽，将一对哑铃平行置于脚边。从上方看，每只哑铃的前侧配重片应与脚掌中部对齐。
2. 俯身，保持手臂伸直握住哑铃。
3. 不要提起哑铃，挺胸使背部处于中立位。
4. 吸气，脚跟发力，上半身和腿部协同用力开始上拉。
5. 沿垂直直线拉起哑铃，使其来到身体两侧。
6. 同时伸展髋部和膝盖，尤其在哑铃过膝时，继续起身至站立。顶端呼气。
7. 以髋部铰链、向后送臀开始下放——沿同一条垂直直线放下哑铃。
8. 哑铃下放过程中或开始下一次动作前吸气。

exercises.title: Deadlift (Smith Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the Smith machine bar in the lowest position and add weight.
2. Stand facing the bar with your shins a couple of inches away.
3. Lean forward and grab the bar with a double overhand grip.
4. Bend your knees slightly and bring your chest out to put your back in a neutral position.
5. Take a breath and pull the bar up, extending your hips near the top as you breathe out.
6. Pause briefly at the top and lower the bar by bringing your buttocks back.
7. As the bar reaches lower-thigh level, bend your knees. Maintain a neutral spine.
8. Breathe in on the way down or before initiating the next rep.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将史密斯机横杆调至最低位置并加负重。
2. 面向横杆站立，小腿距横杆约两英寸。
3. 俯身，用双正握握住横杆。
4. 微屈膝，挺胸使背部保持中立位。
5. 吸气，向上拉起横杆，接近顶端时伸展髋部并呼气。
6. 在顶端稍作停顿，向后送臀下放横杆。
7. 横杆降至大腿下部时屈膝。保持脊柱中立。
8. 下放过程中或开始下一次动作前吸气。

exercises.title: Deadlift (Trap bar)
exercises.how_to:
1. Load a trap bar and stand inside it. Your feet should be hip-width apart, with the toes pointing slightly out.
2. Squat down and grab the handles on both sides.
3. Bring your shoulders back to straighten your back.
4. Take a breath and initiate the pull by digging your heels into the floor.
5. As the bar moves up, gradually extend your hips and knees until you’re upright. Breathe out.
6. Lower the trap bar slowly. Bring your buttocks back first and gradually bend your knees until you’re at the starting position.
7. Breathe in as the bar moves down or before initiating the next rep.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在六角杠上加负重并站入其中。双脚与髋同宽，脚尖略微外展。
2. 下蹲，握住两侧的握把。
3. 肩部后收以挺直背部。
4. 吸气，脚跟蹬地开始上拉。
5. 杠铃上升时，逐渐伸展髋部和膝盖直至站直。呼气。
6. 缓慢下放六角杠。先向后送臀，再逐渐屈膝，回到起始位置。
7. 杠铃下放时或开始下一次动作前吸气。

exercises.title: Deadlift High Pull
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand in front of a loaded barbell.
2. Spread your feet wide and point your toes out. Have your shins an inch or two from the bar.
3. Lean forward and grab the bar with a double overhand grip. Your hands should be several inches apart.
4. Bend your knees and bring your chest out to position yourself against the bar, and straighten your back.
5. Initiate the pull by digging your heels into the floor and flexing your legs.
6. Extend your hips and knees until you’re upright.
7. Immediately pull the barbell in a straight vertical line as you extend your body.
8. Lift the bar until it reaches chest level and breathe out.
9. Lower the bar and hinge at the hips as the weight reaches your upper thighs.
10. Lower the bar in the same straight vertical line.
11. Breathe in on the way down or before initiating the next rep.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站在装有杠铃片的杠铃前。
2. 双脚宽站，脚尖外展。小腿距杠铃约一两英寸。
3. 俯身，用双正握握住杠铃。双手相距数英寸。
4. 屈膝挺胸，身体贴住杠铃，挺直背部。
5. 脚跟蹬地，腿部发力开始上拉。
6. 伸展髋部和膝盖直至站直。
7. 身体伸展的同时，立即沿垂直直线拉动杠铃。
8. 将杠铃提至胸部高度并呼气。
9. 杠铃到达大腿上部时，以髋部为轴下放杠铃。
10. 沿同一条垂直直线下放杠铃。
11. 下放过程中或开始下一次动作前吸气。

exercises.title: Decline Bench Press (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Lie down on the bench, positioning your forehead directly under the bar.
2. Grab the barbell with a double overhand grip. Your arms should be more than shoulder-width apart.
3. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and take a breath.
4. Unrack the bar carefully and bring it in over your chest.
5. Take another breath and lower the barbell to your lower chest.
6. Tap your torso lightly and press the barbell straight up, exhaling near the top.
7. Once finished, bring the barbell over your head and rack it before relaxing your body.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 仰卧在下斜凳上，使额头正对横杆下方。
2. 用双正握握住杠铃。双手间距应大于肩宽。
3. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，吸气。
4. 小心解开杠铃，将其移至胸部上方。
5. 再次吸气，将杠铃下放至下胸。
6. 轻触躯干后，将杠铃垂直推起，接近顶端时呼气。
7. 完成后，将杠铃移至头部上方放回架上，再放松身体。

exercises.title: Decline Bench Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Position yourself on a decline bench and secure your feet.
2. Lie back and retract your shoulder blades.
3. Have a friend hand you the dumbbells one by one. Alternatively, hold the dumbbell and lie back carefully.
4. Keep your arms extended, midsection engaged, and weights over your chest.
5. Take a breath.
6. Lower the dumbbells to your sides while keeping your elbows somewhat tucked in.
7. Lower the weights until your elbows are at torso level.
8. Press the weights straight up, exhaling on the way up.
9. Once finished, have someone take at least one dumbbell from your hand so you can sit up.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在下斜凳上躺好，固定双脚。
2. 仰卧，后收肩胛骨。
3. 请同伴逐一递给你哑铃。也可以自己持铃小心躺下。
4. 手臂保持伸直，收紧核心，哑铃置于胸部上方。
5. 吸气。
6. 将哑铃向两侧下放，肘部适当内收。
7. 下放至肘部与躯干齐平。
8. 将哑铃垂直推起，推起过程中呼气。
9. 完成后，请他人从手中接过至少一只哑铃，再坐起。

exercises.title: Decline Bench Press (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Load the machine appropriately.
2. Set the seat height for the handles to be just below chest level when you sit down.
3. Sit down and grab the handles. Keep your elbows tucked at your sides.
4. Retract your shoulder blades, plant your feet on the floor, squeeze your abs, and inhale.
5. Press the handles forward and down, fully extending your elbows and exhaling. Pause briefly and squeeze your chest.
6. Slowly bend your arms as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在器械上加载合适的配重。
2. 调整座椅高度，使坐下时握把略低于胸部。
3. 坐下并握住握把。肘部贴近身体两侧。
4. 后收肩胛骨，双脚踩实地面，收紧腹部，吸气。
5. 将握把向前下方推，完全伸直肘部并呼气。稍作停顿，夹紧胸肌。
6. 吸气，缓慢屈臂还原。

exercises.title: Decline Bench Press (Smith Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Position a decline bench underneath a Smith machine. The bench should be positioned so that the bar is above your lower chest when you lie back.
2. Load the bar appropriately and have it at a height where you can reach it from a lying position.
3. Lie back, grab the bar with a double overhand grip, and retract your shoulders.
4. Unrack the bar by extending your arms.
5. Take a breath and lower the bar to your chest.
6. Press the bar to the top position and exhale.
7. Once finished, rack the bar carefully and stand up.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将下斜凳置于史密斯机下方。调整凳子位置，使仰卧时横杆位于下胸上方。
2. 为横杆加载合适的重量，并将其调至仰卧时可触及的高度。
3. 仰卧，用双正握握住横杆，后收肩部。
4. 伸直手臂将横杆解开。
5. 吸气，将横杆下放至胸部。
6. 将横杆推至顶端位置并呼气。
7. 完成后，小心将横杆放回架上，然后站起。

exercises.title: Decline Chest Fly (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the bench at a decline.
2. Grab a pair of light dumbbells and sit on the bench, securing your feet.
3. Keep the dumbbells close to your chest and lie back carefully.
4. Extend your arms, position the dumbbells over your chest, and retract your shoulder blades. Keep your wrists neutral (hands facing one another).
5. Take a breath and bring your arms to your sides, stretching your chest muscles. Keep your elbows slightly bent from start to finish.
6. Bring your arms in, squeeze your chest, and tap the dumbbells at the top as you exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将训练凳调至下斜角度。
2. 取一对轻哑铃，坐在凳上，固定双脚。
3. 保持哑铃贴近胸部，小心仰卧躺下。
4. 手臂伸直，将哑铃举于胸部上方，后收肩胛骨。手腕保持中立（双手相对）。
5. 吸气，双臂向两侧下放，拉伸胸肌。全程保持肘部微屈。
6. 呼气，双臂内收，夹紧胸肌，在顶端让哑铃相碰。

exercises.title: Decline Crunch
exercises.how_to:
1. Position yourself on a decline bench and secure your feet.
2. Lie back carefully, keeping your spine in contact with the back support.
3. Bring your hands behind your head.
4. Take a breath and crunch your torso by squeezing your rectus abdominis muscle. Lift your shoulder blades several inches off the bench and exhale.
5. Lower your torso as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 坐上下斜凳，固定双脚。
2. 小心后仰躺下，让脊柱贴合靠背。
3. 双手置于头后。
4. 吸气，收紧腹直肌卷起躯干。将肩胛骨抬离凳面数英寸并呼气。
5. 吸气，放下躯干。

exercises.title: Decline Crunch (Weighted)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a weight plate, position yourself on a decline bench, and secure your legs.
2. Lie back carefully while keeping the plate against your chest.
3. Take a breath and crunch your torso by engaging your abs.
4. Lift your shoulder blades several inches off the floor and exhale.
5. Hold for a moment and lower your torso slowly as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿起杠铃片，坐上下斜凳，固定双腿。
2. 小心后仰躺下，将杠铃片贴在胸前。
3. 吸气，收紧腹部卷起躯干。
4. 将肩胛骨抬离地面数英寸并呼气。
5. 稍作停顿，吸气时缓慢放下躯干。

exercises.title: Decline Push Up
exercises.how_to:
1. Get down on all fours and position your feet on a gym bench, plyo box, or another sturdy object.
2. Extend your body into a push-up position with your hands wider than shoulder-width apart and rotated slightly out.
3. Have your arms straight and shoulder blades retracted.
4. Engage your abs and take a breath.
5. Lower your body by bending your elbows.
6. Move down until your face is close to the floor.
7. Press yourself back by extending your arms. Exhale near the top.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 四肢着地，将双脚放在健身凳、跳箱或其他稳固物体上。
2. 身体伸展成俯卧撑姿势，双手间距略宽于肩并略微外旋。
3. 手臂伸直，肩胛骨后收。
4. 收紧腹部并吸气。
5. 弯曲手肘放低身体。
6. 下放至面部接近地面。
7. 伸直手臂撑起身体。接近顶部时呼气。

exercises.title: Deficit Deadlift
exercises.how_to: (Hevy provides no How-to steps for this entry.)
exercises.how_to_zh: （Hevy 未提供此动作的分步说明。）

exercises.title: Diamond Push Up
exercises.how_to:
1. Get down on all fours and bring your hands together. Your thumbs and index fingers should be in contact or just a couple of inches apart.
2. Extend your body into a push-up position, bringing your shoulders, hips, and knees into alignment.
3. Bring your shoulders back, squeeze your glutes, and take a breath.
4. Lower yourself by bending your elbows.
5. Descend as low as possible and hold the bottom for a moment.
6. Press yourself back to the top, exhaling as you straighten your arms.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 四肢着地，双手并拢。拇指与食指相触或仅相距数英寸。
2. 身体伸展成俯卧撑姿势，让肩、髋、膝成一直线。
3. 肩部后收，收紧臀部并吸气。
4. 弯曲手肘放低身体。
5. 尽可能下放，并在最低点稍作停顿。
6. 撑回顶部，伸直手臂时呼气。

exercises.title: Downward Dog
exercises.how_to:
1. Get down on all fours with your knees underneath your hips. Have your shoulders, elbows, and wrists in vertical alignment.
2. Take a breath and push your buttocks back as you extend your arms.
3. Transition into the high position by elevating your glutes and straightening your legs as you maintain a rigid upper body.
4. Hold the position and release by first bending your knees and then bringing your torso forward.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 四肢着地，膝盖位于髋部正下方。肩、肘、腕保持垂直对齐。
2. 吸气，伸直手臂的同时将臀部向后推。
3. 抬高臀部并伸直双腿，同时保持上身稳定，过渡到高位姿势。
4. 保持该姿势，然后先弯曲膝盖，再将躯干向前放回。

exercises.title: Drag Curl
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a loaded straight bar with your palms facing forward and stand tall.
2. Your hands should be just outside your thighs.
3. Bring your shoulders back and take a breath.
4. Curl the bar by bending your elbows, dragging the weight against your body.
5. Lift the bar as high as possible, squeezing your biceps at the top and exhaling.
6. Lower the bar in the same straight line as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 手掌朝前握住装有杠铃片的直杆，站直。
2. 双手应刚好位于大腿外侧。
3. 肩部后收并吸气。
4. 弯曲手肘弯举杠铃，让重量贴着身体上拖。
5. 将杠铃举到尽可能高，在顶部收紧肱二头肌并呼气。
6. 吸气时沿同样的直线放下杠铃。

exercises.title: Dragon Flag
exercises.how_to:
1. Lie on a flat gym bench and grab the back support with both hands.
2. Extend your body and engage your abs.
3. Take a breath and lift your body off the bench using your midsection musculature.
4. Elevate your body as high as possible and hold for a moment as you exhale.
5. Lower your body slowly and breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 仰卧在平板健身凳上，双手抓住靠背。
2. 伸直身体并收紧腹部。
3. 吸气，用核心肌群将身体抬离凳面。
4. 将身体抬到尽可能高，呼气时稍作停顿。
5. 缓慢放下身体并吸气。

exercises.title: Dragonfly
exercises.how_to:
1. Lie on a flat gym bench and grab the back support with both hands.
2. Extend your body and engage your abs.
3. Take a breath and lift your body off the bench by engaging your midsection musculature.
4. Elevate your body as high as possible and hold for a moment before exhaling.
5. Lower your body slowly and breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 仰卧在平板健身凳上，双手抓住靠背。
2. 伸直身体并收紧腹部。
3. 吸气，收紧核心肌群将身体抬离凳面。
4. 将身体抬到尽可能高，稍作停顿后呼气。
5. 缓慢放下身体并吸气。

exercises.title: Dumbbell Row
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a dumbbell.
2. Place your right knee and right hand on a flat gym bench. Keep your left leg and arm straight with the dumbbell in your hand.
3. Bring your shoulders back and engage your abs.
4. Row the dumbbell until your elbow is at torso level and squeeze for a moment as you exhale.
5. Lower the weight while keeping your shoulders in position. Breathe in on the way down.
6. Once finished, grab the dumbbell with the opposite hand, position your left hand and knee on the bench, and repeat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿起一只哑铃。
2. 将右膝和右手撑在平板健身凳上。左腿和左臂伸直，哑铃握在手中。
3. 肩部后收并收紧腹部。
4. 划船拉起哑铃，直到手肘与躯干齐平，呼气时稍作挤压停顿。
5. 保持肩部位置不变放下重量。下放时吸气。
6. 完成后，换另一只手握哑铃，将左手和左膝撑在凳上，重复动作。

exercises.title: Dumbbell Snatch
exercises.how_to:
1. Place a dumbbell on the floor.
2. Lean forward and grab the dumbbell with one hand.
3. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and take a breath.
4. Thrust the dumbbell up in one powerful swing.
5. Simultaneously dip slightly (bend your knees) to receive the weight overhead.
6. Extend your arm and straighten your legs as you exhale.
7. Lower the dumbbell slowly, breathing in on the way down.
8. Repeat.
9. Grab the dumbbell with the opposite hand and repeat for the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将一只哑铃放在地面上。
2. 俯身用一只手抓住哑铃。
3. 肩部后收，收紧腹部并吸气。
4. 用一次有力的摆动将哑铃向上提起。
5. 同时微微下蹲（弯曲膝盖）以在头顶接住重量。
6. 呼气时伸直手臂并站直双腿。
7. 缓慢放下哑铃，下放时吸气。
8. 重复。
9. 换另一只手抓握哑铃，重复相同的次数。

exercises.title: Dumbbell Squeeze Press
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells, sit on a flat gym bench, and place the weights on top of your thighs.
2. Lie back slowly while keeping your arms bent and dumbbells against your body.
3. Extend your arms, position the dumbbells over your chest, have your wrists neutral (palms facing one another), and squeeze the weights together.
4. Bring your shoulders back and inhale.
5. Lower the dumbbells to your chest, hold for a moment, and press them back to the top as you breathe out.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿起一对哑铃，坐在平板健身凳上，将哑铃放在大腿上。
2. 保持手肘弯曲、哑铃贴住身体，缓慢后仰躺下。
3. 伸直手臂，将哑铃置于胸部上方，手腕保持中立（掌心相对），并将两只哑铃相互挤压。
4. 肩部后收并吸气。
5. 将哑铃下放至胸部，稍作停顿，呼气时再推回顶部。

exercises.title: Dumbbell Step Up
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells and stand in front of a flat gym bench or plyo box.
2. Bring your shoulders back and take a breath.
3. Extend one leg forward and plant the foot on the elevated object.
4. Press through your front foot and step up, positioning yourself on the bench or box as you exhale.
5. Step back to the starting position and breathe in.
6. Extend the opposite leg forward.
7. Keep alternating between left and right.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿起一对哑铃，站在平板健身凳或跳箱前。
2. 肩部后收并吸气。
3. 一条腿向前抬起，将脚掌踩在抬高的物体上。
4. 前脚发力蹬起站上，呼气时让身体站到凳面或箱面上。
5. 退回起始位置并吸气。
6. 换另一条腿向前抬起。
7. 左右腿交替进行。

exercises.title: EZ Bar Biceps Curl
