exercises.how_to:
1. Load an EZ (curved) bar and grab it with an even underhand grip (palms facing forward).
2. Stand tall with your feet in a comfortable stance, knees bent slightly, and shoulders retracted.
3. Take a breath and lift the bar by engaging your biceps.
4. Move the weight up until your wrists are slightly higher than your elbows and breathe out.
5. Pause for a moment and extend your arms as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 给 EZ 杠（弯曲杆）加上重量，双手反握均匀握住（掌心朝前）。
2. 站直，双脚舒适分开，膝盖微屈，肩部后收。
3. 吸气，收紧肱二头肌举起杠铃。
4. 将重量上举至手腕略高于手肘，呼气。
5. 稍作停顿，吸气时伸直手臂。

exercises.title: Elbow to Knee
exercises.how_to:
1. Lie on the floor, bend your knees, rotate your right leg, and position the outer portion of your ankle against your left thigh.
2. Bring your left hand behind your head.
3. Take a breath and engage your abs.
4. Crunch and rotate your torso, bringing your left elbow to your right knee. Exhale.
5. Lower your torso and breathe in.
6. Once finished, place your left ankle against your right thigh and position your right hand behind your head. Repeat for the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 仰卧在地面上，弯曲膝盖，旋转右腿，将右脚踝外侧贴在左大腿上。
2. 左手置于头后。
3. 吸气并收紧腹部。
4. 卷起并旋转躯干，让左肘触碰右膝。呼气。
5. 放下躯干并吸气。
6. 完成后，将左脚踝贴在右大腿上，右手置于头后。重复相同的次数。

exercises.title: Elliptical Trainer
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the correct resistance and position yourself on the elliptical machine.
2. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and take a breath.
3. Initiate the movement by driving your right leg forward as you pull the right handle back.
4. Maintain a steady tempo and move your arms and legs alternatingly.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的阻力，站上椭圆机。
2. 肩部后收，收紧腹部并吸气。
3. 右腿向前蹬的同时向后拉动右侧把手，开始动作。
4. 保持稳定的节奏，手臂与双腿交替运动。

exercises.title: Face Pull
exercises.how_to:
1. Select a light load, set the pulley to a high position, and attach a rope.
2. Grab the rope with your thumbs facing the ceiling.
3. Take a step back to lift the weight off its stack, bring your shoulders back, and stagger your stance for extra support.
4. Take a breath and pull the rope to your face, splitting it by bringing your arms to your sides. Breathe out.
5. Extend your arms as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择较轻的重量，将滑轮调到高位，并装上绳索。
2. 拇指朝上握住绳索。
3. 后退一步将重量从配重片拉起，肩部后收，前后错开站位以获得额外支撑。
4. 吸气，将绳索拉向面部，双臂向两侧分开。呼气。
5. 吸气并伸展手臂。

exercises.title: Farmers Walk
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of heavy dumbbells, kettlebells, or weight plates.
2. Stand tall with your shoulders back, your abs tight, and your gaze directed a few feet forward.
3. Walk forward slowly, breathing steadily as you do.
4. Go for as long as possible and bend your knees to set the weights on the floor.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿起一对重哑铃、壶铃或杠铃片。
2. 站直，肩部后收，腹部收紧，目光看向前方数英尺处。
3. 缓慢向前行走，同时保持平稳呼吸。
4. 尽可能坚持更久，然后弯曲膝盖将重量放到地面上。

exercises.title: Feet Up Bench Press (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the bar at a height where you can unrack it without fully extending your arms.
2. Add the appropriate weight and lie on the bench with your forehead directly underneath the bar.
3. Grab the bar evenly with your hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
4. Bring your shoulder blades back and into the bench, and extend your legs. Depending on your height, the back of your thighs, knees, or calves should rest against the edge of the bench.
5. Engage your abs, unrack the bar, and bring it over your mid-chest.
6. Breathe in and lower the barbell to your chest.
7. Pause for a moment and press the bar to the top as you exhale.
8. Breathe in and repeat for the recommended number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将杠铃架设在你无需完全伸直手臂即可取下的高度。
2. 加上合适的重量，仰卧在凳上，让额头位于杠铃正下方。
3. 双手略宽于肩，均匀握住杠铃。
4. 肩胛骨后收并贴向凳面，双腿伸直。根据身高不同，大腿后侧、膝盖或小腿应靠在凳沿上。
5. 收紧腹部，取下杠铃并移到胸部上方。
6. 吸气，将杠铃下放至胸部。
7. 稍作停顿，呼气时将杠铃推至顶部。
8. 吸气，按建议次数重复。

exercises.title: Fire Hydrants
exercises.how_to:
1. Get down on your hands and knees. Have your knees below your hips and your shoulders, elbows, and wrists in line.
2. Plant your hands flat on the floor and engage your abs to put your back in a neutral position.
3. Flex your right leg without extending the knee.
4. Take a breath and raise your right leg, bringing it to your side. Lift your leg as high as your mobility and strength allow, exhaling at the top. Don’t let your torso rotate with your knee; keep your hips squared.
5. Bring your right leg back to the starting position as you breathe in.
6. Once you’re done, do the same number of reps with the other leg.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双手和双膝撑地。膝盖位于髋部下方，肩、肘、腕成一直线。
2. 手掌平贴地面，收紧腹部使背部保持中立位。
3. 屈曲右腿，但不要伸直膝关节。
4. 吸气，将右腿向体侧抬起。在活动度和力量允许的范围内尽量抬高，抬到顶部时呼气。不要让躯干随膝盖转动；保持髋部正对前方。
5. 吸气时将右腿放回起始位置。
6. 完成后，换另一条腿做相同的次数。

exercises.title: Floor Press (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the barbell on a squat rack at roughly one foot above the floor.
2. Set the squat rack safety bars at torso level (while lying on the floor).
3. Lie flat on the floor with the bar above your forehead.
4. Reach up and grab the bar with an even overhand grip.
5. Retract your shoulder blades, squeeze your abs, and take a breath.
6. Unrack the bar by locking out your elbows.
7. Position the bar over your chest and take another breath.
8. Lower the bar until your elbows come in contact with the floor.
9. Press the bar up, exhaling near the top.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将杠铃放在深蹲架上，高度约离地一英尺。
2. 将深蹲架的安全杆设在（躺在地面时的）躯干高度。
3. 平躺在地面上，让杠铃位于额头上方。
4. 向上伸手，以正握均匀握住杠铃。
5. 肩胛骨后收，收紧腹部并吸气。
6. 锁紧手肘将杠铃取下。
7. 将杠铃移到胸部上方，再次吸气。
8. 下放杠铃，直到手肘接触地面。
9. 将杠铃推起，接近顶部时呼气。

exercises.title: Floor Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells and sit on the floor.
2. Bend your arms to bring the weights close to your torso, and lie back.
3. Keep your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
4. Position the dumbbells to your sides, engage your abs, and retract your shoulder blades.
5. Take a breath and press the dumbbells up and in, breathing out at the top.
6. Slowly lower the dumbbells to your sides as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿起一对哑铃，坐在地面上。
2. 弯曲手臂将哑铃收近躯干，然后后仰躺下。
3. 保持膝盖弯曲，双脚平贴地面。
4. 将哑铃置于身体两侧，收紧腹部，肩胛骨后收。
5. 吸气，将哑铃向上向内推起，在顶部呼气。
6. 吸气时缓慢将哑铃下放至身体两侧。

exercises.title: Floor Triceps Dip
exercises.how_to:
1. Sit down, bend your knees, and place your feet flat on the floor.
2. Lean your torso back and place your hands flat on the floor and behind your body.
3. Engage your abs and take a breath.
4. Press through your palms to extend your arms, lifting your buttocks several inches off the floor. Exhale.
5. Slowly bend your arms, bringing your butt back to the floor as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 坐下，弯曲膝盖，双脚平贴地面。
2. 躯干后倾，双手平放在身后地面上。
3. 收紧腹部并吸气。
4. 手掌发力伸直手臂，将臀部抬离地面数英寸。呼气。
5. 缓慢弯曲手臂，吸气时将臀部放回地面。

exercises.title: Flutter Kicks
exercises.how_to:
1. Lie on the floor with your arms to your sides and hands flat on the floor.
2. Engage your abs and raise your feet a couple of inches off the ground.
3. Breathe in and begin moving your feet up and down alternatingly, several inches in each direction.
4. Maintain a steady exercise tempo and breathing.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 仰卧在地面上，双臂置于身体两侧，手掌平贴地面。
2. 收紧腹部，将双脚抬离地面数英寸。
3. 吸气，开始双脚交替上下摆动，每个方向数英寸。
4. 保持稳定的动作节奏和呼吸。

exercises.title: Frog Jumps
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand tall with your feet wider than your hips and toes pointing slightly out.
2. Engage your abs and extend your arms with your hands in front of your hips.
3. Take a breath and descend into a squat, keeping your heels in contact with the floor.
4. Descend until your hands brush the floor.
5. Immediately press through your heels as powerfully as possible, propelling yourself in the air and exhaling at the top. Keep your arms pointing to the floor.
6. Take another breath as you land, descend into the next repetition, and repeat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站直，双脚间距宽于髋部，脚尖略微外展。
2. 收紧腹部，手臂前伸，双手位于髋部前方。
3. 吸气，下蹲，保持脚跟接触地面。
4. 下蹲至双手擦到地面。
5. 立即用脚跟尽可能用力蹬地，将身体腾空跃起，在最高点呼气。保持手臂指向地面。
6. 落地时再次吸气，下蹲进入下一次重复。

exercises.title: Frog Pumps (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a dumbbell and lie on the floor.
2. Carefully place the weight on your groin and hold it with both hands.
3. Bring your feet together and have your knees pointed out.
4. Engage your abs and take a breath.
5. Press through your feet to extend your hips toward the ceiling, squeezing your glutes at the top and breathing out.
6. Slowly lower your buttocks to the floor as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿起一只哑铃，仰卧在地面上。
2. 小心地将哑铃放在腹股沟处，用双手扶住。
3. 双脚并拢，膝盖向外打开。
4. 收紧腹部并吸气。
5. 双脚蹬地，将髋部向天花板方向顶起，在顶部收紧臀部并呼气。
6. 吸气时缓慢将臀部放回地面。

exercises.title: Front Lever Hold
exercises.how_to:
1. Reach up and grab a bar with an even, overhand grip. Your hands should be shoulder-width apart and elbows extended.
2. Bring your feet together and extend your knees by flexing your quadriceps.
3. Maintain a neutral spine by flexing your midsection muscles. Avoid arching your lower back during any part of the front lever.
4. Flex your entire upper body and take a breath.
5. With your body rigid, initiate the front lever by leaning back as you engage your lats and midsection.
6. Raise your entire body horizontally by engaging your back, shoulders, and midsection musculature.
7. Lift your body until you reach a horizontal position and hold, breathing steadily.
8. Slowly move back to the starting position as you relax your body.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 向上伸手，以正握均匀握住横杠。双手与肩同宽，手肘伸直。
2. 双脚并拢，收缩股四头肌伸直膝关节。
3. 收缩核心肌群保持脊柱中立。前水平动作的任何阶段都不要弓起下背。
4. 收紧整个上身并吸气。
5. 身体保持绷紧，收紧背阔肌和核心，上身后仰开始前水平动作。
6. 收紧背部、肩部和核心肌群，将整个身体水平抬起。
7. 抬起身体直到达到水平位置并保持，平稳呼吸。
8. 放松身体，缓慢回到起始位置。

exercises.title: Front Lever Raise
exercises.how_to:
1. Reach up and grab a bar with an even, overhand grip. Your hands should be shoulder-width apart, and your elbows should be extended.
2. Bring your feet together and extend your knees by flexing your quadriceps.
3. Maintain a neutral spine by flexing your midsection muscles. Don't arch your lower back during any part of the front lever.
4. Flex your entire upper body and take a breath.
5. With your body rigid, initiate the front lever by leaning back as you engage your lats and midsection.
6. Raise your entire body in a horizontal position by engaging your back, shoulders, and midsection musculature.
7. Lift your body until you reach a horizontal position, and hold for a moment as you exhale.
8. Slowly move back to the starting position as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 向上伸手，以正握均匀握住横杠。双手与肩同宽，手肘伸直。
2. 双脚并拢，收缩股四头肌伸直膝关节。
3. 收缩核心肌群保持脊柱中立。前水平动作的任何阶段都不要弓起下背。
4. 收紧整个上身并吸气。
5. 身体保持绷紧，收紧背阔肌和核心，上身后仰开始前水平动作。
6. 收紧背部、肩部和核心肌群，以水平姿势抬起整个身体。
7. 抬起身体直到达到水平位置，呼气时稍作停顿。
8. 吸气时缓慢回到起始位置。

exercises.title: Front Raise (Band)
exercises.how_to:
1. Take an open-ended resistance band with handles on both sides.
2. Step over the middle of the band, grab both ends, and position your arms to your sides.
3. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and take a breath.
4. Raise your arms in front of your body in one smooth motion, exhaling at the top.
5. Slowly lower your arms to your sides as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 取一条两端带握把的弹力带。
2. 双脚踩住弹力带中间，双手抓住两端，手臂置于身体两侧。
3. 肩部后收，收紧腹部并吸气。
4. 手臂以一次流畅的动作在身前抬起，在顶部呼气。
5. 吸气时缓慢将手臂放回身体两侧。

exercises.title: Front Raise (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab the bar with a double overhand grip (palms facing back). Your hands should be shoulder-width apart.
2. Stand tall, bring your shoulders back, and squeeze your abs.
3. Take a breath and lift the barbell in front of your body, keeping your elbows extended. Lift until the weight is at shoulder level and exhale.
4. Lower the barbell to the starting position, breathing in on the way down.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双手正握握住杠铃（掌心朝后）。双手与肩同宽。
2. 站直，肩部后收，收紧腹部。
3. 吸气，保持手肘伸直，在身前举起杠铃。举至重量到达肩部高度并呼气。
4. 将杠铃放回起始位置，下放时吸气。

exercises.title: Front Raise (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the pulley in the lowest position and attach a straight bar.
2. Face away from the cable machine with the bar between your legs.
3. Grab the straight bar with an overhand grip (palms facing back), and have the rope between your legs. Your arms should be straight.
4. Bring your shoulders back, engage your upper body, and bend your knees slightly.
5. Inhale and raise the bar away from your body in one fluid motion.
6. Lift until the bar is at shoulder level and breathe out. Keep your arms straight.
7. Lower your arms to the starting position as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将滑轮调到最低位置并装上直杆。
2. 背对绳索器械站立，让直杆位于双腿之间。
3. 正握握住直杆（掌心朝后），绳索从双腿之间穿过。手臂应保持伸直。
4. 肩部后收，收紧上身，膝盖微微弯曲。
5. 吸气，以一次流畅的动作将直杆向前抬起远离身体。
6. 举至直杆到达肩部高度并呼气。保持手臂伸直。
7. 吸气时将手臂放回起始位置。

exercises.title: Front Raise (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells and stand tall.
2. Position the dumbbells in front of your thighs with your palms facing back.
3. Bring your shoulders back and inhale.
4. Raise both dumbbells until they are at shoulder level. Exhale at the top.
5. Lower the dumbbells to your upper thighs as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿起一对哑铃，站直。
2. 将哑铃置于大腿前方，掌心朝后。
3. 肩部后收并吸气。
4. 将两只哑铃举至肩部高度。在顶部呼气。
5. 吸气时将哑铃下放至大腿上部。

exercises.title: Front Raise (Suspension)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab the handles of a suspension trainer with your arms straight and in front of your chest.
2. Lean your body back several degrees, have your feet together, and engage your abs.
3. Take a breath and raise your arms overhead, pulling your body into a vertical position. Exhale.
4. Slowly lower your arms in front of your chest as you lean back and breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 握住悬吊带握把，手臂伸直置于胸前。
2. 身体后倾数度，双脚并拢，收紧腹部。
3. 吸气，将手臂举过头顶，把身体拉回垂直位置。呼气。
4. 身体后倾，吸气时缓慢将手臂放回胸前。

exercises.title: Front Squat
exercises.how_to:
1. Position the barbell at collarbone height.
2. Dip by bending your knees slightly, pressing your upper chest against the bar, and extending your arms forward.
3. Bend your right elbow and bring your forearm over the bar with the hand resting atop your collarbone.
4. Bend your left elbow and position your left hand on top of your collarbone, right over the bar.
5. Position the barbell on your shoulders, bring your chest out, take a breath, and extend your knees to unrack the bar.
6. Take two steps back to clear enough room.
7. Inhale and descend by bending your knees while keeping your torso upright.
8. Go down as comfortably as possible––ideally, until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
9. Push through your heels to squat up and exhale near the top.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将杠铃放在锁骨高度。
2. 微微屈膝下蹲，上胸抵住杠铃，双臂向前伸出。
3. 弯曲右肘，将右前臂抬到杠铃上方，右手放在锁骨上。
4. 弯曲左肘，左手放在锁骨上，正好越过杠铃。
5. 将杠铃置于肩上，挺起胸部，吸气，伸直膝盖取下杠铃。
6. 后退两步，留出足够空间。
7. 吸气，保持躯干直立，屈膝下蹲。
8. 在舒适范围内尽量下蹲，理想情况下蹲到大腿与地面平行。
9. 脚跟着力蹬起站直，接近顶部时呼气。

exercises.title: Full Squat
exercises.how_to:
1. Position a barbell behind your neck and place it on your upper back muscles.
2. Grab the bar evenly for support.
3. Bring your shoulders back and position your feet in a comfortable stance with your toes pointing slightly out.
4. Engage your abs and take a breath.
5. Squat down and keep your heels in contact with the floor.
6. Descend as much as your mobility allows, hold for a moment, and press through your heels to move up.
7. Exhale near the top.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将杠铃置于颈后，放在上背肌肉上。
2. 均匀握住杠铃以作支撑。
3. 肩部后收，双脚舒适分开站立，脚尖略微外展。
4. 收紧腹部并吸气。
5. 下蹲，保持脚跟接触地面。
6. 在活动度允许的范围内尽量下蹲，稍作停顿，然后脚跟着力蹬起。
7. 接近顶部时呼气。

exercises.title: Glute Bridge
exercises.how_to:
1. Lie flat on the ground.
2. Bend your knees and plant your feet on the floor.
3. Position your arms to your sides for balance.
4. Take a breath and press through your heels to extend your hips toward the ceiling.
5. Squeeze your glutes at the top and hold the position for a moment as you exhale.
6. Lower your buttocks to the floor as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 平躺在地面上。
2. 弯曲膝盖，双脚踩实地面。
3. 双臂置于身体两侧以保持平衡。
4. 吸气，脚跟着力蹬地，将髋部向天花板方向顶起。
5. 在顶部收紧臀部，呼气时保持该姿势稍作停顿。
6. 吸气时将臀部放回地面。

exercises.title: Glute Bridge (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Sit on the floor, roll a loaded barbell over your hips, and lie back.
2. Bring your shoulders back, bend your knees, and plant your feet flat on the ground, having them roughly hip-width apart.
3. Grab the bar with both hands and push your hips against it.
4. Breathe in and engage your abs.
5. Push through your heels and engage your glutes to drive your hips toward the ceiling as you exhale.
6. Pause briefly at the top and slowly lower your hips to the starting position as you breathe in. Grip the bar to keep it in position.
7. Repeat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 坐在地面上，将装有杠铃片的杠铃滚到髋部上方，然后后仰躺下。
2. 肩部后收，弯曲膝盖，双脚平贴地面，间距约与髋同宽。
3. 双手握住杠铃，将髋部顶住杠铃。
4. 吸气并收紧腹部。
5. 脚跟着力蹬地，收紧臀部将髋部向天花板方向顶起，同时呼气。
6. 在顶部稍作停顿，吸气时缓慢将髋部放回起始位置。握紧杠铃使其保持位置。
7. 重复。

exercises.title: Glute Ham Raise
exercises.how_to:
1. Set yourself up on a glute ham raise machine. The ankle pad should be against your Achilles heel, and your knees should be on the platform supporting your hips. Push the balls of your feet against the foot platform if your machine has one.
2. With your torso upright, knees bent, and ankles secure, cross your arms in front of your chest, retract your shoulder blades, and inhale.
3. Slowly extend your legs and bring your torso forward and down while keeping your back and hips rigid.
4. Descend as much as possible––ideally, until your knees are almost entirely straight.
5. Engage your posterior chain to bend your knees and raise your torso to the starting position. Exhale near the top.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在臀腘绳肌训练器上就位。脚踝垫应抵住跟腱，膝盖放在支撑髋部的平台上。如果你的器械有脚踏板，用前脚掌蹬住脚踏板。
2. 躯干直立，膝盖弯曲，脚踝固定，双臂在胸前交叉，肩胛骨后收，吸气。
3. 保持背部和髋部绷紧，缓慢伸直双腿，让躯干向前下方移动。
4. 尽可能下放，理想情况下放至膝盖几乎完全伸直。
5. 收紧后链肌群弯曲膝盖，将躯干抬回起始位置。接近顶部时呼气。

exercises.title: Glute Kickback (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load.
2. Position your right side to the machine and grab the horizontal support bar.
3. Place the back of your right thigh against the pad, just above the crease of the knee.
4. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and extend your leg back in one fluid motion as you exhale.
5. Slowly bring your leg to the starting position as you breathe in.
6. Once finished, rotate your body 180 degrees, and do the same number of reps for your left leg.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的配重。
2. 身体右侧朝向器械，抓住水平支撑杆。
3. 将右大腿后侧贴在护垫上，位置刚好在膝窝上方。
4. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，呼气时以一次流畅的动作将腿向后伸展。
5. 吸气时缓慢将腿放回起始位置。
6. 完成后，身体旋转 180 度，换左腿做相同的次数。

exercises.title: Glute Kickback on Floor
exercises.how_to:
1. Get down on all fours with your hands flat and knees supporting your lower body.
2. Your knees should be underneath your hips, and your wrists, elbows, and shoulders should be aligned.
3. Engage your abs and take a breath.
4. Kick your right leg back and up, squeezing your glutes at the top and exhale. Keep your knee bent.
5. Slowly bring the leg to the starting position and breathe in.
6. Once finished training one side, do the same number of reps with your other leg.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 四肢撑地，手掌平贴地面，双膝支撑下身。
2. 膝盖应位于髋部正下方，腕、肘、肩成一直线。
3. 收紧腹部并吸气。
4. 将右腿向后上方踢起，在顶部收紧臀部并呼气。保持膝盖弯曲。
5. 缓慢将腿放回起始位置并吸气。
6. 一侧训练完成后，换另一条腿做相同的次数。

exercises.title: Goblet Squat
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a dumbbell and raise it in front of your torso with both arms while keeping it vertical (with one side up).
2. Position your hands to the sides of it with your palms placed firmly against the top weight plate.
3. Straighten your back, engage your abs, and inhale.
4. Descend into a squat while keeping your torso upright.
5. Squat as low as you comfortably can – ideally until your thighs are parallel with the floor.
6. Push through your heels to raise yourself back to the starting position and exhale near the top of the repetition.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双手握住一只哑铃，保持竖直（一侧朝上），举于躯干前方。
2. 双手置于哑铃两侧，掌心紧贴上方配重片。
3. 挺直背部，收紧腹部，吸气。
4. 保持躯干直立下蹲。
5. 在舒适范围内尽可能下蹲，理想情况下大腿与地面平行。
6. 以脚跟发力回到起始位置，在动作顶端附近呼气。

exercises.title: Good Morning (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the bar up at around armpit height, and grip it evenly, slightly outside shoulder-width level.
2. Tuck yourself under the bar and position it on your lower traps, around the level of your rear deltoids.
3. Extend your upper back and press the bar against it with both hands. Keep your wrist straight and don't rest the bar on your hands.
4. With your feet hip-width apart and firmly planted on the ground, push your hips forward and unrack the bar. Take a few steps back to clear enough space for the lift.
5. With the bar firmly pressed against your upper back and your feet planted into the ground, take a breath and push your hips straight back.
6. As you lean forward, keep your back in a neutral position and think about pushing your butt back.
7. Lean your torso forward as much as possible while keeping your back straight. You should feel an intense stretch in your posterior chain muscles. Allow for a slight bend in your knees at the bottom.
8. Initiate the upward movement by pushing your hips forward and stand tall. Exhale at the top.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将杠铃架设在约腋窝高度，双手略宽于肩均匀握住。
2. 身体钻到杠铃下方，将杠铃放在下斜方肌上，约与后三角肌齐平。
3. 挺起上背，双手将杠铃压紧。手腕保持伸直，不要让杠铃压在手上。
4. 双脚与髋同宽站稳，髋部前顶取下杠铃。后退几步，留出足够的动作空间。
5. 杠铃紧压上背、双脚踩实地面，吸气，将髋部径直向后推。
6. 上身前倾时保持背部中立，想着把臀部向后推。
7. 保持背部挺直，尽可能前倾躯干。你应感到后链肌群被强烈拉伸。在最低点允许膝盖略微弯曲。
8. 髋部前顶启动向上动作，站直。在顶部呼气。

exercises.title: Gorilla Row (Kettlebell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Place two kettlebells of equal weight on the floor and stand before them.
2. Lean forward and grab the two kettlebell handles.
3. Bend your knees to some degree and retract your shoulder blades to straighten your back.
4. Take a deep breath, engage your abs, and row one kettlebell until your elbow is at torso level. Exhale.
5. Lower the weight to the floor as you breathe in.
6. Immediately row the other kettlebell and breathe out.
7. Alternate between left and right until you’re done.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将两只重量相同的壶铃放在地面上，站在壶铃前。
2. 俯身并抓住两只壶铃的把手。
3. 适度屈膝，肩胛骨后收，使背部挺直。
4. 深吸一口气，收紧腹部，将一只壶铃划起至肘部与躯干齐平。呼气。
5. 吸气的同时将壶铃放回地面。
6. 立即划起另一只壶铃并呼气。
7. 左右交替，直到完成。

exercises.title: HIIT
exercises.how_to: (Hevy provides no How-to steps for this entry.)
exercises.how_to_zh: （Hevy 未提供此动作的分步说明。）

exercises.title: Hack Squat
exercises.how_to:
1. Place a barbell on the floor and stand in front of it. Your calves should almost be in contact with it.
2. Bring your chest out and descend into a squat.
3. Grab the barbell with your palms facing back, and keep your shoulders retracted.
4. While holding the barbell firmly, take a deep breath and push through your heels to move up.
5. Drag the barbell against your legs and buttocks. Exhale near the top.
6. With your shoulders back and gaze directed forward, bend at the knees and hips to descend.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将杠铃放在地面上，站在杠铃前。小腿几乎贴住杠铃。
2. 挺胸并下蹲。
3. 掌心向后抓住杠铃，保持肩胛骨后收。
4. 握紧杠铃，深吸一口气，脚后跟发力起身。
5. 让杠铃贴着大腿和臀部上移。接近顶部时呼气。
6. 肩部后收，目光向前，屈膝屈髋下蹲。

exercises.title: Hack Squat (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Add weight to the machine.
2. Position yourself inside the machine with your shoulders against the pad.
3. Have your feet in a comfortable squatting stance on the platform below.
4. Bring your shoulders back and engage your abs.
5. Extend your knees to unrack the weight and remove the safety latch.
6. Inhale and descend by bending your knees.
7. Move down until your knees form a 90-degree angle.
8. Press through your heels and straighten your legs, exhaling near the top.
9. Once finished, put the safety on, rack the weight, and relax your body.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 为器械加上配重。
2. 进入器械内，肩部抵住靠垫。
3. 双脚以舒适的深蹲站距踩在下方的踏板上。
4. 肩部后收，收紧腹部。
5. 伸直膝盖解锁重量，并取下安全插销。
6. 吸气并屈膝下蹲。
7. 下蹲至膝盖呈 90 度角。
8. 脚后跟发力伸直双腿，接近顶部时呼气。
9. 完成后扣上安全装置，放回重量，放松身体。

exercises.title: Hammer Curl (Band)
exercises.how_to:
1. Take a looped or open-ended resistance band, step over the middle, and grab both ends.
2. Stand tall with your arms straight and your wrists neutral (facing your body).
3. Take a breath and slowly bend your arms.
4. Curl the band until your wrists are slightly higher than your elbows, and breathe out. Keep your elbows to your sides.
5. Fully extend your arms as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 取一条环形或两端开口的弹力带，踩住中间，双手抓住两端。
2. 站直，手臂伸直，手腕保持中立（朝向身体）。
3. 吸气，缓慢弯曲手臂。
4. 弯举弹力带，直到手腕略高于肘部，呼气。肘部贴近身体两侧。
5. 吸气的同时完全伸直手臂。

exercises.title: Hammer Curl (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate weight and set the pulley to the lowest position.
2. Attach a rope to the pulley.
3. Lean forward and grab both ends of the rope attachment. Keep your hands neutral (palms facing one another).
4. Stand up and step back to lift the weight off its stack, engage your abs, and retract your shoulder blades.
5. Take a breath and lift the rope to your chest by bending your arms. Keep your elbows at your sides.
6. Bend your arms until your wrists are slightly higher than your elbows, and breathe out.
7. Slowly extend your arms and breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的重量，将滑轮调至最低位置。
2. 在滑轮上安装绳索把手。
3. 俯身抓住绳索把手的两端。双手保持中立（掌心相对）。
4. 站直并后退一步，将重量从配重片堆上提起，收紧腹部，肩胛骨后收。
5. 吸气，弯曲手臂将绳索提至胸前。肘部贴近身体两侧。
6. 弯曲手臂直到手腕略高于肘部，呼气。
7. 缓慢伸直手臂并吸气。

exercises.title: Hammer Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells and stand tall.
2. Position your arms to your sides with your wrists neutral (palms facing your body).
3. Bring your shoulders back and take a breath.
4. Curl both dumbbells simultaneously, lifting them until your wrists are slightly higher than your elbows. Exhale.
5. Extend your arms fully as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿起一对哑铃，站直。
2. 手臂放在身体两侧，手腕保持中立（掌心朝向身体）。
3. 肩部后收并吸气。
4. 同时弯举两只哑铃，直到手腕略高于肘部。呼气。
5. 吸气的同时完全伸直手臂。

exercises.title: Handstand Hold
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand tall with your arms overhead and core engaged.
2. Take a breath and lean forward, planting your hands on the floor.
3. Use the momentum you generate to extend your legs to the ceiling.
4. Hold the handstand position.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站直，手臂举过头顶，收紧核心。
2. 吸气并向前倾，双手撑在地面上。
3. 借助产生的动量将双腿伸向天花板。
4. 保持倒立姿势。

exercises.title: Handstand Push Up
exercises.how_to:
1. Assume a handstand position by placing your hands flat on the floor and lifting your legs to the ceiling. You can support yourself against a wall for extra balance.
2. Once in position, take a breath and lower yourself by bending your elbows.
3. Move down slowly and stop when your head is a couple of inches from the floor.
4. Press by extending your elbows and exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双手平放在地面上，将双腿举向天花板，进入倒立姿势。可以靠墙支撑以获得更好的平衡。
2. 进入姿势后，吸气并屈肘下放身体。
3. 缓慢下放，当头部离地面几英寸时停住。
4. 伸直肘部撑起并呼气。

exercises.title: Hang Clean
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand tall and hold a barbell with an overhand grip (palms facing back). Your hands should be more than shoulder-width apart.
2. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and position your feet comfortably.
3. Take a breath and thrust the barbell forward and up.
4. Immediately sink into a squat and receive the barbell in a front rack position. Your elbows should be bent, and your fingertips should support the barbell as it lies on your shoulders.
5. Press through your heels and extend your knees to stand up, exhaling at the top.
6. Grab hold of the barbell and carefully lower it to the starting position as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站直，以正握（掌心向后）握住杠铃。握距应宽于肩。
2. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，双脚以舒适姿势站稳。
3. 吸气，将杠铃向前上方发力提起。
4. 立即下蹲，以颈前架位接住杠铃。肘部弯曲，指尖托住架在肩上的杠铃。
5. 脚后跟发力伸直膝盖站起，在顶部呼气。
6. 握住杠铃，吸气的同时小心地将其放回起始位置。

exercises.title: Hang Snatch
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a loaded barbell with an overhand grip (palms facing back).
2. Stand tall and straighten your arms.
3. Engage your abs and take a breath.
4. Hinge at the hips until the barbell is just above knee level.
5. Drive your hips forward as you thrust the weight overhead, bending your knees and sinking into a squat.
6. Catch the bar overhead with your elbows extended.
7. Push through your heels and squat up while keeping your arms straight. Exhale at the top.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 以正握（掌心向后）抓住已上片的杠铃。
2. 站直并伸直手臂。
3. 收紧腹部并吸气。
4. 屈髋俯身，直到杠铃略高于膝盖。
5. 髋部前送，同时将重量举过头顶，屈膝下蹲。
6. 肘部伸直，在头顶接住杠铃。
7. 脚后跟发力，保持手臂伸直站起。在顶部呼气。

exercises.title: Hanging Knee Raise
exercises.how_to:
1. Reach up and grab a pull-up bar with an overhand grip (palms facing forward). Your hands should be shoulder-width apart.
2. Bring your legs together, engage your abs, and retract your shoulders.
3. Take a breath and lift your legs, bending your knees.
4. Raise your legs as high as possible in one fluid motion and exhale.
5. Slowly extend your legs as you breathe in. Don’t let your lower back arch.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 向上伸手，以正握（掌心向前）抓住引体向上杆。双手与肩同宽。
2. 双腿并拢，收紧腹部，肩部后收。
3. 吸气并屈膝抬起双腿。
4. 以流畅的动作将双腿尽可能抬高并呼气。
5. 吸气的同时缓慢伸直双腿。不要让下背拱起。

exercises.title: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.how_to:
1. Reach up and grab a pull-up bar with an even overhand grip (palms facing forward).
2. Take a breath, engage your abs, and lift your feet off the floor, suspending yourself in the air.
3. Raise your legs while keeping them straight.
4. Pause briefly at the top as you exhale.
5. Slowly lower your legs while keeping your body stable as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 向上伸手，以均匀的正握（掌心向前）抓住引体向上杆。
2. 吸气，收紧腹部，双脚离地，将身体悬于空中。
3. 保持双腿伸直并抬起。
4. 在顶部稍作停顿并呼气。
5. 吸气的同时保持身体稳定，缓慢放下双腿。

exercises.title: Heel Taps
exercises.how_to:
1. Lie on the floor, bend your knees, bring your feet together, and plant them flat.
2. Position your arms to your sides and take a breath.
3. Crunch your torso to the left, tapping your left ankle with your hand.
4. Extend your upper body, take another breath, and crunch to the right.
5. Alternate between left and right until you’re done.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 仰卧在地面上，屈膝，双脚并拢平放。
2. 手臂放在身体两侧，吸气。
3. 躯干向左侧卷起，用手触碰左脚踝。
4. 伸展上身，再次吸气，然后向右侧卷起。
5. 左右交替，直到完成。

exercises.title: Hex Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells, preferably hexagonal ones.
2. Sit on a flat gym bench and place the weights on your thighs.
3. Lie back while keeping the weights close to your torso.
4. As you lie down, extend your arms and squeeze the dumbbells together.
5. Retract your shoulder blades, take a deep breath, and squeeze your abs.
6. Lower the dumbbells to your upper stomach and pause briefly.
7. Press the weights to extend your arms and exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿起一对哑铃，最好是六角形哑铃。
2. 坐在平板健身凳上，将哑铃放在大腿上。
3. 躺下，同时让哑铃贴近躯干。
4. 躺下的过程中伸直手臂，将哑铃相互挤压。
5. 肩胛骨后收，深吸一口气，收紧腹部。
6. 将哑铃下放至上腹部并稍作停顿。
7. 推起哑铃伸直手臂并呼气。

exercises.title: High Knee Skips
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand tall with your arms to your sides, legs straight, and feet a few inches apart.
2. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and inhale.
3. Raise your left knee toward your chest as you bring your left arm back. Simultaneously bend your right arm, positioning your hand to the side of your face.
4. Lower your left foot to the floor as you exhale, and bring your right arm to your side.
5. Inhale and immediately bring the opposite knee to your chest, bending your left arm.
6. Alternate and maintain a steady tempo from start to finish.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站直，手臂放在身体两侧，双腿伸直，双脚分开几英寸。
2. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，吸气。
3. 将左膝抬向胸口，同时左臂向后摆。同时弯曲右臂，将手放在脸侧。
4. 呼气的同时将左脚放回地面，右臂回到身体一侧。
5. 吸气，立即抬起另一侧膝盖至胸口，同时弯曲左臂。
6. 左右交替，自始至终保持稳定节奏。

exercises.title: High Knees
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand tall with your shoulders back, abs engaged, and gaze forward.
2. Take a breath and raise your right knee to your chest while simultaneously bringing your right arm behind your body.
3. Lower your knee and immediately lift the opposite one, bringing your left arm behind your body.
4. Raise your knees to your chest alternatingly, maintaining a steady tempo as you do.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站直，肩部后收，收紧腹部，目光向前。
2. 吸气，将右膝抬向胸口，同时右臂摆到身后。
3. 放下右膝，立即抬起另一侧膝盖，左臂摆到身后。
4. 交替将膝盖抬向胸口，同时保持稳定节奏。

exercises.title: Hiking
exercises.how_to: (Hevy provides no How-to steps for this entry.)
exercises.how_to_zh: （Hevy 未提供此动作的分步说明。）

exercises.title: Hip Abduction (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the cable pulley to the lowest position, attach an ankle cuff, and select the weight.
2. Wrap the cuff around your right ankle and stand up with your left shoulder pointing toward the machine.
3. Bring your shoulders back and step slightly away from the machine to unrack the weight. You can hold onto the machine for balance.
4. Engage your abs and slightly raise your right foot off the ground.
5. Breathe in and raise your right leg to the side in one smooth motion, exhaling at the top of the rep.
6. Slowly bring your leg in as you breathe in and repeat.
7. Once finished, wrap the cuff around your left ankle, stand up with your right shoulder pointing toward the pulley, and repeat for the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将绳索滑轮调至最低位置，安装脚踝绑带，并选择合适的重量。
2. 将绑带套在右脚踝上，站起，左肩朝向器械。
3. 肩部后收，稍远离器械将重量解锁。可以扶住器械保持平衡。
4. 收紧腹部，右脚稍稍离地。
5. 吸气，以流畅的动作将右腿向侧面抬起，在动作顶端呼气。
6. 吸气的同时缓慢将腿收回并重复。
7. 完成后，将绑带套在左脚踝上，站起，右肩朝向滑轮，重复相同的次数。

exercises.title: Hip Abduction (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load and sit down.
2. Bring your shoulders back and grab the handles to your sides.
3. Step on the foot platforms and position the outer part of your lower thighs against the pads.
4. Take a breath and spread your legs out as much as possible in one fluid motion, breathing out.
5. Bring your knees together as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的配重并坐下。
2. 肩部后收，抓住身体两侧的把手。
3. 双脚踩在踏板上，让大腿下段外侧贴住靠垫。
4. 吸气，以流畅的动作尽可能将双腿向外分开，呼气。
5. 吸气的同时将双膝并拢。

exercises.title: Hip Adduction (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the cable pulley to the lowest position, attach an ankle cuff, and select the weight.
2. Wrap the cuff around your right ankle and stand up with your right shoulder pointing toward the machine.
3. Take a step away from the machine. The goal is for the weight to be unracked while your right leg is at your side. You can hold onto the machine for balance.
4. Engage your abs and slightly raise your right foot off the ground.
5. Inhale and bring your right leg in until the right foot is in front of the left one. Exhale.
6. Let your right leg return to the side as you breathe in.
7. Repeat.
8. Once finished, wrap the cuff around your left ankle, stand up with your left shoulder pointing toward the pulley, step away, and repeat for the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将绳索滑轮调至最低位置，安装脚踝绑带，并选择合适的重量。
2. 将绑带套在右脚踝上，站起，右肩朝向器械。
3. 远离器械走一步。目标是让右腿在身体一侧时重量解锁。可以扶住器械保持平衡。
4. 收紧腹部，右脚稍稍离地。
5. 吸气，将右腿向内收，直到右脚位于左脚前方。呼气。
6. 吸气的同时让右腿回到身体一侧。
7. 重复。
8. 完成后，将绑带套在左脚踝上，站起，左肩朝向滑轮，远离一步，重复相同的次数。

exercises.title: Hip Adduction (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load.
2. Sit down and place your inner thighs against the machine pads. Position your feet on the foot platforms below.
3. Grab the handles to your sides, retract your shoulder blades, and take a breath.
4. Squeeze your inner thigh muscles to bring the pads together as you breathe out.
5. Move your legs to the starting position as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的配重。
2. 坐下，让大腿内侧贴住器械靠垫。双脚放在下方的踏板上。
3. 抓住身体两侧的把手，肩胛骨后收，吸气。
4. 呼气的同时收紧大腿内侧肌肉，将靠垫并拢。
5. 吸气的同时将双腿回到起始位置。

exercises.title: Hip Thrust
exercises.how_to:
1. Sit on the floor and position your upper back against the edge of a bench.
2. Bend your arms and place your hands on your chest.
3. Bend your knees and plant your feet flat on the floor. Your knees should point forward, not to the sides.
4. Bring your shoulders back and take a breath.
5. Engage your glutes and push through your heels to raise your butt until your hips align with your shoulders.
6. Hold the contraction for a moment and exhale.
7. Lower your butt to the floor as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 坐在地面上，上背靠在长凳边缘。
2. 弯曲手臂，双手置于胸前。
3. 屈膝，双脚平放地面。膝盖应朝向正前方，而非两侧。
4. 肩部后收，吸气。
5. 收紧臀部，以脚跟发力将臀部抬起，直到髋部与肩部对齐。
6. 保持收缩片刻并呼气。
7. 吸气，将臀部放回地面。

exercises.title: Hip Thrust (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Sit on the floor and position a loaded barbell over your hips.
2. Place your upper back against the edge of a flat gym bench.
3. Bend your knees and plant your feet flat on the floor.
4. Place your hands over the barbell and grab it firmly.
5. Engage your abs and take a breath.
6. Thrust the barbell toward the ceiling by squeezing your buttocks and pushing through your heels. Exhale at the top.
7. Lower your hips to the floor and breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 坐在地面上，将已上片的杠铃放在髋部上方。
2. 将上背靠在平板健身凳的边缘。
3. 屈膝，双脚平放在地面上。
4. 双手放在杠铃上方并握紧。
5. 收紧腹部并吸气。
6. 收紧臀部，脚后跟发力，将杠铃推向天花板。在顶部呼气。
7. 将髋部放回地面并吸气。

exercises.title: Hip Thrust (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Sit on the ground with a flat gym bench behind you and a dumbbell at your side.
2. Lean back and place your upper back against the edge of the bench.
3. Position your feet roughly hip-width apart and plant them flat on the ground.
4. Grab the dumbbell and place it over your hips. Hold it in position with both hands.
5. Breathe in, engage your abs, and push through your heels to drive your hips to the ceiling.
6. Pause when your knees, hips, and upper body align. Exhale.
7. Slowly lower your hips while keeping your abs engaged. Breathe in on the way down.
8. Repeat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 坐在地面上，身后放一张平板健身凳，身旁放一只哑铃。
2. 向后靠，将上背靠在健身凳边缘。
3. 双脚约与髋同宽，平放在地面上。
4. 拿起哑铃放在髋部上方，双手扶稳。
5. 吸气，收紧腹部，脚后跟发力将髋部推向天花板。
6. 当膝盖、髋部与上身成一条直线时稍作停顿。呼气。
7. 保持腹部收紧，缓慢放下髋部。下放过程中吸气。
8. 重复。

exercises.title: Hip Thrust (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select or load the appropriate weight.
2. Lie back on the machine with your arms to your sides and your upper back in contact with the pad.
3. Secure the strap or belt over your hips.
4. Take a deep breath and engage your abs.
5. Press through your heels to extend your hips toward the ceiling. Squeeze your glutes at the top and hold for a moment as you exhale.
6. Slowly lower your buttocks to the starting position as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择或加上合适的重量。
2. 向后靠在器械上，手臂放在身体两侧，上背贴住靠垫。
3. 将绑带或腰带固定在髋部上方。
4. 深吸一口气，收紧腹部。
5. 脚后跟发力将髋部向天花板伸展。在顶部收紧臀部并保持片刻，同时呼气。
6. 吸气的同时缓慢将臀部放回起始位置。

exercises.title: Hip Thrust (Smith Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the Smith machine bar to a low position, enough to be able to tuck underneath.
2. Load the bar appropriately and place a pad to prevent hip discomfort.
3. Position a flat gym bench parallel or perpendicular to the bar at an approximately one-foot distance (tweak the setup to find your ideal position).
4. Sit on the floor and lean back to position your shoulder blades on the bench. The bar should be directly over your hips.
5. Bend your knees and plant your feet on the floor.
6. Grab the bar, push your hips against the pad, and engage your abs.
7. Breathe in and push through your heels to raise your hips toward the ceiling until they align with your knees and upper body. Exhale at the top.
8. Slowly lower your buttocks to the floor as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将史密斯机的杠铃杆调至较低位置，低到足以钻到下方。
2. 为杠铃杆加上合适的配重，并垫上护垫以防髋部不适。
3. 在距杠铃杆约一英尺处放置一张平板健身凳，与杠铃杆平行或垂直（可自行调整找到最合适的位置）。
4. 坐在地面上，向后靠，将肩胛骨靠在健身凳上。杠铃杆应位于髋部正上方。
5. 屈膝，双脚踩在地面上。
6. 抓住杠铃杆，将髋部顶住护垫，收紧腹部。
7. 吸气，脚后跟发力将髋部向天花板抬起，直到与膝盖和上身成一条直线。在顶部呼气。
8. 吸气的同时缓慢将臀部放回地面。

exercises.title: Hollow Rock
exercises.how_to:
1. Lie down on an exercise mat. Have your hands at your sides, feet together, and legs straight.
2. Contract your abs as if trying to initiate a crunch. Doing so will put your lower back against the exercise mat.
3. Squeeze your thigh muscles as your legs are together, and lift your feet a couple of inches off the floor. Keep your legs straight.
4. Lift your head a couple of inches off the floor and extend your arms back behind your head.
5. Hold the position for as long as possible and breathe steadily.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 仰卧在训练垫上。双手放在身体两侧，双脚并拢，双腿伸直。
2. 收紧腹部，就像要开始做卷腹一样。这样会让下背贴住训练垫。
3. 双腿并拢，收紧大腿肌肉，将双脚抬离地面几英寸。保持双腿伸直。
4. 将头部抬离地面几英寸，手臂向后伸过头顶。
5. 尽可能长时间保持该姿势，并均匀呼吸。

exercises.title: Incline Bench Press (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Lie back on the incline bench and grab the bar with an even overhand grip. The bar should be close enough to unrack without overextending your body.
2. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and plant your feet on the floor.
3. Take a breath and unrack the bar by locking out your elbows.
4. Bring the barbell over your chest and take another breath.
5. Lower the weight to your mid chest and pause for a moment.
6. Press the bar in a straight line and exhale near the top.
7. Once finished, carefully bring the bar over your head and rack it before relaxing.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 仰卧在上斜凳上，以均匀的正握抓住杠铃杆。杠铃杆应足够近，无需过度伸展身体即可解锁。
2. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，双脚踩在地面上。
3. 吸气，伸直肘部解锁杠铃。
4. 将杠铃移到胸部上方，再吸一口气。
5. 将重量下放至胸部中段并停顿片刻。
6. 沿直线推起杠铃，接近顶部时呼气。
7. 完成后，小心地将杠铃移到头顶上方放回架上，然后放松。

exercises.title: Incline Bench Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the incline of a bench at 45 degrees, grab a pair of dumbbells, and sit down.
2. Place the dumbbells on top of your thighs, and lie back as you kick the weights up and over your torso.
3. Bring the dumbbells to your sides, plant your feet on the floor, retract your shoulders, and take a breath. Keep your elbows somewhat tucked in.
4. Press both dumbbells toward the ceiling, tapping them lightly at the top. Breathe out.
5. Lower the weights to your sides, breathing in on the way down.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将健身凳调至 45 度上斜，拿起一对哑铃并坐下。
2. 将哑铃放在大腿上方，向后躺下，同时用腿将哑铃踢到躯干上方。
3. 将哑铃放到身体两侧，双脚踩在地面上，肩部后收，吸气。肘部稍微内收。
4. 将两只哑铃向天花板推起，在顶部轻轻相碰。呼气。
5. 将哑铃下放至身体两侧，下放过程中吸气。

exercises.title: Incline Bench Press (Smith Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Place an incline bench under the Smith machine. The bar should be directly over your mid-chest when you lie down.
2. Set the bar at a height you can reach without fully extending your arms.
3. Lie down, grab the bar with an overhand grip (palms facing forward), and dig your shoulder blades into the bench.
4. Engage your abs and press the bar up, rotating it to remove the safety.
5. Take a breath and lower the bar to your chest.
6. Press it back to the top and exhale.
7. Once finished, rack the bar.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将一张上斜凳放在史密斯机下方。躺下时杠铃杆应位于胸部中段正上方。
2. 将杠铃杆设置到手不用完全伸直即可够到的高度。
3. 躺下，以正握（掌心向前）抓住杠铃杆，将肩胛骨压入健身凳。
4. 收紧腹部，将杠铃杆向上推起，同时旋转以解除安全锁。
5. 吸气，将杠铃杆下放至胸部。
6. 将杠铃杆推回顶部并呼气。
7. 完成后，将杠铃杆放回架上。

exercises.title: Incline Chest Fly (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells and sit at the base of an incline gym bench.
2. Place the weights on top of your thighs and lie back slowly.
3. Lift the dumbbells over your chest and extend your arms.
4. Bring your shoulders back and take a breath.
5. Extend your arms to your sides until your elbows are at torso level. Keep your elbows slightly bent.
6. Bring your arms in, squeezing your chest, and tap the dumbbells at the top. Exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿起一对哑铃，坐在上斜健身凳的底端。
2. 将哑铃放在大腿上方，缓慢向后躺下。
3. 将哑铃举到胸部上方并伸直手臂。
4. 肩部后收并吸气。
5. 将手臂向身体两侧展开，直到肘部与躯干齐平。肘部保持微屈。
6. 将手臂向内收拢，挤压胸肌，在顶部让哑铃相碰。呼气。

exercises.title: Incline Chest Press (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Add the appropriate amount of weight.
2. Adjust the seat height so you can comfortably grab the handles and keep your elbows tucked as you sit down.
3. Sit down, plant your feet on the floor, and grab the handles.
4. Retract your shoulder blades, engage your abs, and take a breath.
5. Press the handles up and overhead in one fluid motion, exhaling at the top.
6. Slowly bend your arms as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 加上适量的配重。
2. 调整座椅高度，使坐下后能舒适地抓住把手并保持肘部内收。
3. 坐下，双脚踩在地面上，抓住把手。
4. 肩胛骨后收，收紧腹部，吸气。
5. 以流畅的动作将把手向上、向头顶方向推起，在顶部呼气。
6. 吸气的同时缓慢弯曲手臂。

exercises.title: Incline Push Ups
exercises.how_to:
1. Place your hands on the edge of a sturdy object (plyo box, gym bench, or a chair).
2. Straighten your body as you would for a regular push-up.
3. Bring your shoulders back and squeeze your glutes.
4. Take a breath and lower yourself to the object you’re using, tapping your chest at the bottom position.
5. Press yourself back to the top and fully extend your arms as you exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将双手放在稳固物体（跳箱、健身凳或椅子）的边缘。
2. 像做标准俯卧撑一样绷直身体。
3. 肩部后收，收紧臀部。
4. 吸气，将身体下放至所用物体处，在最低点让胸部触碰物体。
5. 将自己推回顶部，呼气的同时完全伸直手臂。

exercises.title: Inverted Row
exercises.how_to:
1. Set a bar for the rows at around hip height. You can use a Smith machine.
2. Grab the bar with an overhand grip and tuck yourself underneath.
3. With your arms straight and bar over your chest, extend your body and balance your lower half on your heels.
4. Engage your glutes and abs, bring your chest out, and take a breath. Your body should be as straight as an arrow.
5. Pull through your elbows to bring your body toward the bar. Touch the bar to your chest without flaring your elbows. Breathe out.
6. Slowly lower yourself to the starting position as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将杠铃杆设置在约髋部高度的位置用于划船。可以使用史密斯机。
2. 以正握抓住杠铃杆，将身体钻到杆下。
3. 手臂伸直，杠铃杆位于胸部上方，伸展身体，让下半身以脚后跟保持平衡。
4. 收紧臀部和腹部，挺胸，吸气。身体应像箭一样笔直。
5. 通过肘部发力将身体拉向杠铃杆。让杠铃杆触碰胸部，肘部不要外翻。呼气。
6. 吸气的同时缓慢下放身体回到起始位置。

exercises.title: Iso-Lateral Chest Press (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Add the appropriate weight to the machine.
2. Adjust the seat height. You should be able to press without flaring your elbows.
3. Sit down and grab the handles with an overhand grip (palms facing down).
4. Bring your shoulders back, plant your feet on the floor, and take a breath.
5. Press the handles forward and up, exhaling as your arms straighten.
6. Bend your elbows as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 为器械加上适量的配重。
2. 调整座椅高度。推起时肘部不应外翻。
3. 坐下，以正握（掌心向下）抓住把手。
4. 肩部后收，双脚踩在地面上，吸气。
5. 将把手向前、向上推起，在手臂伸直时呼气。
6. 吸气的同时弯曲肘部。

exercises.title: Iso-Lateral High Row (Machine)
exercises.title_zh: 固定器械分动式高位划船
exercises.how_to:
1. Load the machine and set the thigh pad for your legs to fit snugly.
2. Sit down and grab the handles.
3. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and take a breath.
4. Pull the handles to your torso, squeezing your back muscles, and breathe out.
5. Slowly extend your arms as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 为器械加上配重，调整腿部靠垫使双腿贴紧。
2. 坐下并抓住把手。
3. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，吸气。
4. 将把手拉向躯干，挤压背部肌肉，呼气。
5. 吸气的同时缓慢伸直手臂。

exercises.title: Iso-Lateral Low Row
exercises.how_to:
1. Add the appropriate amount of weight.
2. Sit down with your stomach and chest against the pad.
3. Reach forward and grab the two handles.
4. Retract your shoulder blades, take a deep breath, and engage your abs.
5. Pull both handles until your elbows are at your sides, and squeeze your back muscles as you exhale.
6. Slowly extend your arms as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 加上适量的配重。
2. 坐下，让腹部和胸部贴住靠垫。
3. 向前伸手抓住两个把手。
4. 肩胛骨后收，深吸一口气，收紧腹部。
5. 将两个把手拉至肘部位于身体两侧，呼气的同时挤压背部肌肉。
6. 吸气的同时缓慢伸直手臂。

exercises.title: Iso-Lateral Row (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Add the appropriate weight to the machine.
2. Adjust the seat height to have your torso against the front pad when you sit down.
3. Sit down, plant your feet flat, position your torso against the pad, and grab the handles.
4. Bring your shoulders back and take a breath.
5. Pull the handles to your sides, squeezing your back at the top of the repetition and exhaling.
6. Slowly extend your arms while keeping your shoulders retracted and breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 为器械加上适量的配重。
2. 调整座椅高度，使坐下时躯干贴住前方靠垫。
3. 坐下，双脚平放，躯干贴住靠垫，抓住把手。
4. 肩部后收并吸气。
5. 将把手拉向身体两侧，在动作顶端挤压背部并呼气。
6. 保持肩部后收，缓慢伸直手臂并吸气。

exercises.title: JM Press (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the barbell at a height where you can reach it without fully extending your arms.
2. Lie on the bench, reach up, grab the bar with a shoulder-width grip, and unrack it.
3. Position the bar over your chest with your arms straight, just as you would during a standard bench press.
4. Plant your feet on the floor, retract your shoulder blades, take a deep breath, and engage your abs.
5. Slowly bend your elbows, lowering the barbell to your upper chest.
6. Pause briefly and fully extend your arms as you exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将杠铃放在无需完全伸直手臂即可够到的高度。
2. 仰卧在长凳上，向上伸手，以与肩同宽的握距握住杠铃并取下。
3. 手臂伸直，将杠铃置于胸部上方，与标准卧推相同。
4. 双脚踩实地面，收紧肩胛骨，深吸一口气，收紧腹部。
5. 缓慢弯曲手肘，将杠铃下放至上胸。
6. 稍作停顿，呼气的同时完全伸直手臂。

exercises.title: Jack Knife (Suspension)
exercises.how_to:
1. Secure your feet on the handles of a suspension kit.
2. Extend your body into a push-up position with your arms straight or bent, shoulders back, and abs tight.
3. Take a breath and tuck your knees, bringing them close to your elbows. Breathe out.
4. Slowly extend your knees as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将双脚固定在悬吊带的把手上。
2. 身体伸展成俯卧撑姿势，手臂伸直或弯曲，肩部后收，腹部收紧。
3. 吸气，屈膝收腿，让膝盖靠近肘部。呼气。
4. 吸气的同时缓慢伸直膝盖。

exercises.title: Jackknife Sit Up
exercises.how_to:
1. Lie flat on the floor with your legs straight and arms at your sides. Your heels, legs, butt, upper back, head, and arms should be in contact with the floor.
2. Engage your abs and raise your legs as you bend your knees.
3. Simultaneously lift your torso, bringing your arms toward your lower body. Exhale.
4. Extend your body back to the starting position and breathe in on the way down.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 平躺在地面上，双腿伸直，手臂放在身体两侧。脚后跟、双腿、臀部、上背、头部和手臂都应贴住地面。
2. 收紧腹部，屈膝的同时抬起双腿。
3. 同时抬起躯干，将手臂伸向下半身。呼气。
4. 将身体放回起始位置，下放过程中吸气。

exercises.title: Jump Rope
exercises.how_to: (Hevy provides no How-to steps for this entry.)
exercises.how_to_zh: （Hevy 未提供此动作的分步说明。）

exercises.title: Jump Shrug
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a barbell with an overhand grip (palms facing back) and stand tall. Your hands should be just outside your thighs.
2. Bring your shoulders back and engage your abs.
3. Lean your torso forward slightly by hinging at the hip.
4. Take a breath, bend your knees slightly, and press through your heels to jump.
5. Immediately shrug your shoulders as high as possible and exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 以正握（掌心向后）握住杠铃，站直。双手应位于大腿外侧。
2. 肩部后收，收紧腹部。
3. 以髋部为轴，躯干略向前倾。
4. 吸气，膝盖微屈，脚跟发力起跳。
5. 立即尽最大幅度耸肩，呼气。

exercises.title: Jump Squat
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and toes pointing slightly out.
2. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and position your hands in front of your torso.
3. Take a breath and descend halfway into a squat.
4. Press through your heels to move up and immediately jump as high as possible, swinging your arms to your sides and behind your body as you exhale.
5. Take another breath as you land and descend into another squat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站直，双脚与肩同宽，脚尖略微外展。
2. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，双手置于躯干前方。
3. 吸气，下蹲至一半深度。
4. 脚跟发力向上并立即尽力跳高，同时呼气并将手臂向身体两侧及身后摆动。
5. 落地时再次吸气，并再次下蹲。

exercises.title: Jumping Jack
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand tall with your arms to your sides, legs straight, and feet together.
2. Engage your abs and take a breath.
3. Hop and bring your feet out as you extend your arms to your sides and over your head.
4. Jump again and bring your feet together and arms to your sides. Exhale.
5. Keep repeating rhythmically, hopping just a couple of inches off the floor, and breathing regularly.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站直，双臂垂于体侧，双腿伸直，双脚并拢。
2. 收紧腹部，吸气。
3. 跳起并将双脚分开，同时双臂向两侧展开并举过头顶。
4. 再次跳起，双脚并拢，双臂回到体侧。呼气。
5. 保持有节奏地重复，离地仅数厘米，并规律呼吸。

exercises.title: Jumping Lunge
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand tall with your feet a few inches apart, arms to your sides, and shoulders back.
2. Engage your abs and take a breath.
3. Jump vertically and immediately bring your right leg forward and your left leg back.
4. As you land on your front foot and the ball of your left foot, immediately sink into a lunge.
5. Descend until your front thigh is almost parallel to the floor.
6. Press through your front heels to move up and immediately jump. Exhale as you start moving up.
7. Switch leg positions while in the air, breathe in, and sink into another lunge.
8. Keep jumping and switching leg positions, doing a lunge in between.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站直，双脚分开数厘米，双臂垂于体侧，肩部后收。
2. 收紧腹部，吸气。
3. 垂直跳起，同时右腿向前、左腿向后。
4. 前脚与左脚前掌落地时，立即下蹲成弓步。
5. 下蹲至前侧大腿几乎与地面平行。
6. 前脚跟发力向上并立即跳起。起身时呼气。
7. 在空中交换双腿位置，吸气，再次下蹲成弓步。
8. 持续跳跃并交换双腿位置，中间完成一次弓步。

exercises.title: Kettlebell Around the World
exercises.how_to:
1. Hold a kettlebell in your right hand and stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and shoulders back.
2. Engage your abs and breathe in.
3. Move the kettlebell to the left in front of your body and switch hands, grabbing the weight with your left hand.
4. Continue the rotation by moving the kettlebell back and around your body.
5. As the kettlebell gets to your buttocks, reach back with your right hand and grab it, continuing the rotation in the same direction.
6. Continue switching hands as the kettlebell rotates around your waist and breathe steadily. Maintain a consistent tempo and keep your abs tense.
7. Once finished rotating the weight in one direction, do the same number of reps in the opposite direction.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 右手持壶铃，站直，双脚与髋同宽，肩部后收。
2. 收紧腹部，吸气。
3. 将壶铃在身前移向左侧并换手，用左手接住。
4. 继续旋转，将壶铃向身后绕体移动。
5. 壶铃到臀部位置时，右手向后伸接住壶铃，继续同方向旋转。
6. 壶铃绕腰旋转时持续换手，保持均匀呼吸。保持稳定节奏，腹部持续收紧。
7. 一个方向旋转完成后，反方向完成相同次数。

exercises.title: Kettlebell Clean
exercises.how_to:
1. Position the kettlebell on the floor.
2. Stand in front of the weight with your feet hip-width apart.
3. Bend your knees and lean your torso forward, grabbing the kettlebell with your right hand.
4. Engage your abs and take a breath.
5. Press through your heels to straighten your knees as you simultaneously pull the weight in a straight vertical line close to your body.
6. As the kettlebell reaches hip level, drive your hips forward and thrust the weight up.
7. Bend your arm and have the kettlebell land on your shoulder, lying against the top of your forearm and biceps. Exhale.
8. Lower the weight to the floor and breathe in on the way down or before initiating the next rep..
9. Once finished, grab the kettlebell with your left hand and do the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将壶铃放在地面上。
2. 站在壶铃前，双脚与髋同宽。
3. 屈膝并前倾躯干，右手握住壶铃。
4. 收紧腹部，吸气。
5. 脚跟发力伸直膝盖，同时将壶铃沿贴近身体的竖直直线拉起。
6. 壶铃到髋部高度时，髋部前顶，将壶铃向上带起。
7. 屈臂让壶铃落在肩上，贴住前臂上侧与肱二头肌。呼气。
8. 将壶铃放回地面，下放过程中或下一次动作开始前吸气。
9. 完成后，换左手握住壶铃，完成相同次数。

exercises.title: Kettlebell Curl
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of kettlebells and position them to your sides with your arms straight and palms facing forward.
2. Bring your shoulders back and engage your abs.
3. Take a breath and curl the kettlebells, bending your arms until your wrists are slightly higher than your elbows. Breathe out at the top.
4. Slowly extend your arms, breathing in as you lower them.
5. Repeat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双手各持一只壶铃置于体侧，手臂伸直，掌心向前。
2. 肩部后收，收紧腹部。
3. 吸气并弯举壶铃，屈臂至手腕略高于手肘。顶端呼气。
4. 缓慢伸直手臂，下放时吸气。
5. 重复。

exercises.title: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a kettlebell by the horns or have your palms against the bell with the handle pointing down.
2. Lift the weight in front of your chest with your elbows bent.
3. Bring your shoulders back and position your feet in a comfortable stance, with your toes slightly pointed out.
4. Take a breath and engage your abs.
5. Descend by bending your knees and maintaining an upright torso as you move down.
6. Squat until your thighs are parallel to the floor and your elbows are between your thighs.
7. Hold the bottom position for a moment.
8. Push through your heels to move up, keeping the kettlebell close to your body.
9. Exhale as you straighten your legs.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 握住壶铃的把手两侧，或用掌心托住铃体、把手朝下。
2. 屈肘将壶铃举至胸前。
3. 肩部后收，双脚以舒适站距站立，脚尖略微外展。
4. 吸气，收紧腹部。
5. 屈膝下蹲，下蹲过程中保持躯干直立。
6. 下蹲至大腿与地面平行，手肘位于两腿之间。
7. 在最低点稍作停顿。
8. 脚跟发力起身，壶铃贴近身体。
9. 伸直双腿时呼气。

exercises.title: Kettlebell Halo
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a kettlebell by the horns with your wrists neutral and thumbs facing forward.
2. Stand up and turn the kettlebell bottoms up with your palms now facing your body and your elbows bent at roughly 90 degrees.
3. Assume a comfortable stance, bring your chest out, and engage your abs.
4. Breathe in and pull the kettlebell back and around the right side of your head. This will cause your left forearm to travel over your head.
5. As the kettlebell moves behind your head, continue the rotation by raising your right forearm above your head.
6. Complete the rep by bringing the kettlebell to the starting position in front of your chest. Exhale.
7. Breathe in and rotate the kettlebell around your head, this time in the opposite direction.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 握住壶铃把手两侧，手腕保持中立，拇指朝前。
2. 站起并将壶铃翻转至底部朝上，掌心朝向身体，手肘弯曲约 90 度。
3. 以舒适站姿站立，挺胸，收紧腹部。
4. 吸气，将壶铃向后方绕头部右侧移动。此时左前臂会经过头顶。
5. 壶铃移向头后时，抬起右前臂继续旋转。
6. 将壶铃回到胸前起始位置，完成一次动作。呼气。
7. 吸气，反向绕头旋转壶铃。

exercises.title: Kettlebell High Pull
exercises.how_to:
1. Position a kettlebell on the floor.
2. Spread your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, with your toes pointing out.
3. Bend your knees and grab the kettlebell handle with both hands. Keep your back neutral.
4. Take a breath and press through your heels to extend your arms.
5. As the kettlebell reaches hip level, use the momentum and pull the weight vertically into an upright row, exhaling at the top.
6. Slowly extend your arms and bend your knees and hips to set the weight on the floor, inhaling on the way down or before initiating the next rep.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将壶铃放在地面上。
2. 双脚站距宽于肩，脚尖外展。
3. 屈膝，双手握住壶铃把手。保持背部中立。
4. 吸气，脚跟发力伸展手臂。
5. 壶铃到髋部高度时，利用惯性将壶铃竖直上拉成直立划船，顶端呼气。
6. 缓慢伸直手臂，屈膝屈髋将壶铃放回地面，下放过程中或下一次动作开始前吸气。

exercises.title: Kettlebell Shoulder Press
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a kettlebell and lift it to shoulder level. Keep your elbow bent and the weight positioned against the top of your forearm and bicep.
2. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and have your feet in a comfortable position.
3. Take a breath and press the weight straight up, fully extending your arm and exhaling.
4. Slowly lower it to your side as you breathe in.
5. Repeat.
6. Once finished, grab the kettlebell with your opposite hand, performing the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 握住壶铃并举至肩部高度。保持手肘弯曲，壶铃贴住前臂上侧与肱二头肌。
2. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，双脚以舒适姿势站立。
3. 吸气并将壶铃竖直上推，完全伸直手臂并呼气。
4. 缓慢下放至体侧，同时吸气。
5. 重复。
6. 完成后，换另一只手握住壶铃，完成相同次数。

exercises.title: Kettlebell Snatch
exercises.how_to:
1. Position a kettlebell in front of your body.
2. Have your feet shoulder-width apart, with your toes pointing slightly out.
3. Bend your knees and lean forward to grab the kettlebell.
4. Stand tall and hold the weight in front of your body.
5. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and breathe in.
6. Hinge at the hips as you bring the kettlebell back and between your legs.
7. Extend your knees and hips to generate momentum and raise the weight forward and up, lifting it overhead in one smooth motion.
8. Fully straighten your arm as you lift the kettlebell overhead and exhale.
9. Lower the kettlebell in a straight line as you breathe in.
10. Repeat.
11. Once finished, do the same number of reps with your opposite arm.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将壶铃放在身前。
2. 双脚与肩同宽，脚尖略微外展。
3. 屈膝前倾，握住壶铃。
4. 站直，将壶铃置于身前。
5. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，吸气。
6. 以髋部为轴，将壶铃向后摆至两腿之间。
7. 伸展膝盖与髋部产生惯性，将壶铃向前上方带起，一次流畅地举过头顶。
8. 壶铃举过头顶时完全伸直手臂，呼气。
9. 沿直线下放壶铃，同时吸气。
10. 重复。
11. 完成后，换另一只手臂完成相同次数。

exercises.title: Kettlebell Swing
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a kettlebell by its handle with your wrists neutral (palms facing one another).
2. Stand tall and have the weight in front of your hips. Your feet should be shoulder-width apart or slightly wider.
3. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and take a breath.
4. Hinge at the hip, bringing your buttocks back. The kettlebell should end up between your thighs.
5. Extend your hips forcefully, thrusting the kettlebell in front of your body until it ends up at shoulder height, and exhale.
6. Lower the kettlebell and immediately hinge at the hips again for the weight to end up between your thighs.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 握住壶铃把手，手腕保持中立（掌心相对）。
2. 站直，壶铃置于髋部前方。双脚应与肩同宽或略宽。
3. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，吸气。
4. 以髋部为轴，臀部后移。壶铃应摆至两腿之间。
5. 用力伸展髋部，将壶铃向前摆至肩部高度，呼气。
6. 下放壶铃，立即再次以髋部为轴，让壶铃回到两腿之间。

exercises.title: Kettlebell Turkish Get Up
exercises.how_to:
1. Lie on the floor with your right knee bent and your right foot flat on the ground. Have your left leg straight.
2. Hold a kettlebell in your right hand and keep your wrist, elbow, and shoulder in vertical alignment.
3. Move your left arm to the side with the hand flat on the floor.
4. Engage your abs, take a breath, and raise your torso off the floor. Keep your right arm straight and the kettlebell over your shoulder joint. Push yourself with your left arm until your torso is vertical and you're seated.
5. With the kettlebell still over your right shoulder and left hand supporting you, bend your left leg and place the knee on the floor, raising yourself.
6. Raise your torso higher and remove your left hand from the floor.
7. Square your hips to create a solid lunge position, take another breath, and lift your left knee, stepping on the left foot.
8. Get up to the standing position by extending your knees and hips. Keep the kettlebell over your shoulder, and don’t bend your elbow.
9. Reverse the motion by lunging back, lifting your left foot off the floor, landing on your left knee, and rotating the left leg behind your body.
10. Place your left hand on the floor, extend your left leg in front of you, and get into the seated position without extending the right knee.
11. Bend your left arm to lower your torso and lie on your back and into the starting position.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 仰卧地面，右膝弯曲，右脚掌平贴地面。左腿伸直。
2. 右手持壶铃，保持手腕、手肘与肩部在一条垂直线上。
3. 左臂向体侧展开，手掌平贴地面。
4. 收紧腹部，吸气，将躯干抬离地面。保持右臂伸直，壶铃位于肩关节上方。用左臂支撑身体，直到躯干竖直坐起。
5. 保持壶铃位于右肩上方、左手支撑身体，屈左腿将膝盖放在地面上，撑起身体。
6. 进一步抬高躯干，左手离开地面。
7. 摆正髋部形成稳固的弓步姿势，再次吸气，抬起左膝，左脚踩地。
8. 伸展膝盖与髋部站起。保持壶铃位于肩部上方，不要弯曲手肘。
9. 反向还原：向后撤步成弓步，左脚抬离地面，以左膝着地，将左腿转到身后。
10. 左手放在地面上，左腿向前伸直，在不伸直右膝的情况下坐回地面。
11. 弯曲左臂下放躯干，仰卧回到起始位置。

exercises.title: Kipping Pull Up
exercises.how_to:
1. Reach up and grab the pull-up bar with an overhand grip (palms facing forward).
2. Raise your legs slightly and bring your buttocks back to swing your body slightly and generate momentum.
3. Use the momentum you generate by allowing your legs to swing back, bringing your back into hyperextension.
4. Continue building momentum by allowing your legs to swing forward.
5. Bend your elbows to pull yourself up. Bring your chin over the bar, straighten your body, and allow the momentum to til you slightly back, similar to an inverted row.
6. Lower yourself immediately and keep your body in the tilted position.
7. Once your arms are almost entirely straight, allow your legs to drop and swing back as your buttocks travel back, causing an arch in your spine.
8. Swing your legs forward again and use the momentum to pull yourself up a second time.
9. Keep moving up and down, using momentum to go from back flexion to hyperextension on each repetition.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 向上伸手，以正握（掌心向前）握住引体向上杆。
2. 略微抬腿，臀部后移，使身体轻微摆动以产生惯性。
3. 利用产生的惯性，让双腿向后摆动，使背部进入超伸状态。
4. 让双腿向前摆动，继续积累惯性。
5. 弯曲手肘将身体拉起。下巴过杆，身体伸直，借惯性略微后倾，类似反向划船。
6. 立即下放身体，保持身体后倾姿势。
7. 手臂几乎完全伸直时，放下双腿并向后摆动，臀部后移，使脊柱形成反弓。
8. 再次向前摆腿，利用惯性第二次将身体拉起。
9. 持续上下摆动，每次动作都利用惯性从背部弯曲过渡到超伸。

exercises.title: Knee Raise Parallel Bars
exercises.how_to:
1. Position yourself inside a captain’s chair with your feet on a platform or steps, back against the pad, and forearms flat on the pair of padded parallel bars.
2. Bring your shoulders back and contract your abs.
3. Step off the platform or steps and support yourself with your upper body musculature. Keep your shoulders in position and avoid slumping.
4. Take a breath and engage your abs to raise your knees as high as possible in one fluid motion. Breathe out at the top.
5. Lower your knees to the starting position, extending them on the way down, and stop before your lower back begins to arch. Breathe in on the way down.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站进船长椅内，双脚踩在踏板或台阶上，背部贴住靠垫，前臂平放在两侧带垫的双杠上。
2. 肩部后收，收紧腹部。
3. 离开踏板或台阶，用上肢支撑身体。保持肩部位置，避免含胸。
4. 吸气并收紧腹部，一次流畅地将膝盖抬至最高。顶端呼气。
5. 将膝盖下放回起始位置，下放过程中伸直双腿，在下背开始反弓前停止。下放时吸气。

exercises.title: Kneeling Pulldown (band)
exercises.how_to:
1. Attach a resistance band overhead.
2. Grab both resistance band handles, step back, and kneel.
3. Lean your torso forward in the direction of the resistance band anchor point.
4. Bring your shoulders back and take a breath.
5. Pull the band to your shoulders while keeping your elbows tucked in and in line with your torso. Exhale.
6. Extend your arms slowly as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将弹力带固定在高处。
2. 双手握住弹力带两端把手，后退一步并跪下。
3. 躯干朝弹力带固定点方向前倾。
4. 肩部后收，吸气。
5. 将弹力带拉向肩部，手肘内收并与躯干保持在同一平面。呼气。
6. 缓慢伸直手臂，同时吸气。

exercises.title: Kneeling Push Up
exercises.how_to:
1. Get down on your hands and knees.
2. Lean forward and position your hands in a comfortable stance.
3. Engage your abs and take a breath.
4. Descend by bending your elbows.
5. Move down until your face is an inch from the floor and pause.
6. Press yourself back to the top and exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双手和双膝撑地。
2. 身体前倾，双手以舒适的位置撑地。
3. 收紧腹部，吸气。
4. 弯曲手肘下降身体。
5. 下降至脸部离地约一英寸处并停顿。
6. 撑起身体回到起始位置，呼气。

exercises.title: L-Sit Hold
exercises.how_to:
1. Position yourself on a captain’s chair or parallel dip bars.
2. Grab the handles evenly and straighten your arms.
3. Suspend yourself in the air and engage your abs.
4. Take a breath and raise your legs until they are parallel to the floor.
5. Hold the position for 15 to 60 seconds and release.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在船长椅或双杠臂屈伸架上就位。
2. 双手均匀握住把手，伸直手臂。
3. 将身体悬空支撑，收紧腹部。
4. 吸气，抬起双腿至与地面平行。
5. 保持该姿势 15 至 60 秒后放松。

exercises.title: Landmine 180
exercises.how_to:
1. Secure one end of a barbell on a landmine attachment and put a weight plate on the other.
2. Grab the barbell sleeve with your palms supporting the bottom end.
3. Stand tall and position the barbell to your right with your arms straight and abs flexed.
4. Take a breath and raise the barbell to your face by bending your elbows.
5. Immediately lower the weight to your left, extending your arms. Exhale.
6. Take another breath and lift the barbell in the opposite direction.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将杠铃一端固定在地雷管底座上，另一端装上杠铃片。
2. 握住杠铃套筒，掌心托住底端。
3. 站直，将杠铃置于身体右侧，手臂伸直，收紧腹部。
4. 吸气，弯曲手肘将杠铃举至面部高度。
5. 立即将杠铃向左侧下放，同时伸直手臂。呼气。
6. 再次吸气，向相反方向举起杠铃。

exercises.title: Landmine Row
exercises.how_to:
1. Secure one end of a barbell to a landmine attachment.
2. Add the appropriate amount of weight to the other side of the bar.
3. Take a V-handle and position it underneath the barbell.
4. Grab the handle with both hands, placing it securely against the end of the barbell shaft (just before the sleeve begins).
5. Bend your knees, retract your shoulder blades, and squeeze your abs.
6. Lift the barbell a couple of inches off the floor and take another breath.
7. Row the bar to your upper stomach and pause briefly as you exhale.
8. Lower the barbell by extending your arms and breathe in. Don’t rest the bar on the floor.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将杠铃一端固定在地雷管底座上。
2. 在杠铃另一端加上适量铃片。
3. 取一个 V 形把手，将其置于杠铃下方。
4. 双手握住把手，将其紧贴杠铃杆末端（套筒开始之前的位置）。
5. 屈膝，收紧肩胛骨，收紧腹部。
6. 将杠铃抬离地面数厘米，再次吸气。
7. 将杠铃划向上腹部，呼气并稍作停顿。
8. 伸臂下放杠铃并吸气。不要让杠铃停在地面上。

exercises.title: Landmine Squat and Press
exercises.how_to:
1. Anchor one end of a barbell on a landmine and add a weight plate on the other.
2. Reach down and grab the free barbell end with both hands.
3. Straighten your body and have your hands together and in front of your chest.
4. Position your feet in a comfortable stance for squats.
5. Engage your abs, take a breath, and descend into a squat.
6. Go down until your thighs are parallel to the floor, and press through your heels to move back up.
7. As you straighten your legs, immediately press the bar overhead and exhale at the top.
8. Slowly lower the bar to your chest, inhale, and squat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将杠铃一端固定在地雷管底座上，另一端装上杠铃片。
2. 俯身用双手握住杠铃的自由端。
3. 直起身体，双手并拢置于胸前。
4. 双脚以适合深蹲的舒适站距站立。
5. 收紧腹部，吸气，下蹲。
6. 下蹲至大腿与地面平行，脚跟发力起身。
7. 伸直双腿时立即将杠铃向上推过头顶，顶端呼气。
8. 缓慢将杠铃下放至胸前，吸气，再次下蹲。

exercises.title: Lat Pulldown (Band)
exercises.how_to:
1. Anchor a resistance band overhead - for example, on a pull-up bar.
2. Grab both ends of the resistance band, straighten your arms, step back to lengthen the band, and sit on a plyo box or gym bench. You can also kneel.
3. Lean slightly in the direction of the band anchor point.
4. Take a breath and pull the band to your upper chest, squeezing your lats at the bottom and breathing out.
5. Extend your arms slowly and breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将弹力带固定在高处，例如引体向上杆上。
2. 双手握住弹力带两端，伸直手臂，后退拉长弹力带，坐在跳箱或健身房长凳上。也可以跪姿进行。
3. 身体略微朝弹力带固定点方向倾斜。
4. 吸气，将弹力带拉向上胸，在末端收紧背阔肌并呼气。
5. 缓慢伸直手臂，同时吸气。

exercises.title: Lat Pulldown (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
1. Adjust the knee pad on the machine to be right against your thighs.
2. Select a weight you can lift for at least ten smooth reps.
3. Grab the bar with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Your palms should face forward.
4. Sit down and secure your legs underneath the pad.
5. With your arms extended, bring your shoulders back and down.
6. Take a breath and pull the weight down through your elbows. As you pull, keep your elbows tucked and in line with your torso. Breathe out.
7. Hold for a moment and extend your arms fully as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 调整器械上的膝垫，使其紧贴大腿。
2. 选择能流畅完成至少十次的重量。
3. 双手略宽于肩握杠。掌心向前。
4. 坐下，将双腿固定在膝垫下方。
5. 手臂伸直，肩部后收下沉。
6. 吸气，用手肘将重量下拉。下拉时手肘内收，与躯干保持在同一平面。呼气。
7. 稍作停顿，吸气并完全伸直手臂。

exercises.title: Lat Pulldown (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load.
2. Adjust the thigh pad. Your legs should fit snugly.
3. Stand up and grab the handles with an even overhand grip (palms facing forward).
4. Keep your arms straight and sit down, securing your legs under the pad.
5. Bring your shoulders back and take a breath.
6. Pull the handles down, tucking your elbows and bringing them in line with your torso. Breathe out.
7. Extend your arms slowly and breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的配重。
2. 调整腿垫。双腿应紧贴其下方。
3. 站起，以均衡的正握（掌心向前）握住把手。
4. 保持手臂伸直并坐下，将双腿固定在腿垫下方。
5. 肩部后收，吸气。
6. 将把手下拉，手肘内收并与躯干保持在同一平面。呼气。
7. 缓慢伸直手臂，同时吸气。

exercises.title: Lat Pulldown - Close Grip (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
1. Attach a V handle to a lat pulldown machine.
2. Select the appropriate load.
3. Adjust the thigh pad for your legs to fit snugly underneath.
4. Grab the V handle with a neutral grip (palms facing one another), sit down, and position your thighs underneath the pad.
5. Bring your shoulders back and lean your torso slightly back.
6. Inhale and pull the V handle to your chest, squeezing your back muscles and exhaling.
7. Slowly extend your arms as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在背阔肌下拉器械上装上 V 形把手。
2. 选择合适的配重。
3. 调整腿垫，使双腿紧贴其下方。
4. 以对握（掌心相对）握住 V 形把手，坐下，将大腿置于腿垫下方。
5. 肩部后收，躯干略微后倾。
6. 吸气，将 V 形把手拉向胸部，收紧背部肌肉并呼气。
7. 缓慢伸直手臂，同时吸气。

exercises.title: Lateral Band Walks
exercises.how_to:
1. Wrap a looped resistance band around your ankles or thighs, just above the knees.
2. Lean your torso forward a bit and bend your knees slightly.
3. Engage your abs and take a breath.
4. Take a lateral step to the right and exhale.
5. Inhale again and take another step in the same direction.
6. Once finished walking in one direction, take the same number of steps to the left, breathing steadily as you do.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将环形弹力带套在脚踝或大腿上，位于膝盖上方。
2. 躯干略向前倾，膝盖微屈。
3. 收紧腹部，吸气。
4. 向右侧跨一步，呼气。
5. 再次吸气，沿同一方向再跨一步。
6. 一个方向行走完成后，向左侧走相同的步数，保持均匀呼吸。

exercises.title: Lateral Box Jump
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand sideways to a plyometric box or flat gym bench.
2. Have your feet close, arms to your sides, and your body straight.
3. Take a breath, descend into a quarter squat, and swing your arms back.
4. Press through your heels to extend your legs and drive your arms forward, jumping laterally and up. Breathe out.
5. Land on the elevated platform and carefully get down on the opposite side as you breathe in.
6. Jump laterally in the opposite direction.
7. Keep alternating.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 侧身站在跳箱或平坦的健身房长凳旁。
2. 双脚靠近，双臂垂于体侧，身体挺直。
3. 吸气，下蹲至四分之一深度，双臂向后摆。
4. 脚跟发力伸展双腿，双臂向前摆动，向侧上方跳起。呼气。
5. 落在台面上，吸气的同时小心从另一侧下台。
6. 向相反方向侧向跳。
7. 持续交替进行。

exercises.title: Lateral Leg Raises
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand tall with your feet together, legs straight, and shoulders back.
2. Grab onto something for balance––for example, a squat rack or chair.
3. Engage your abs and take a breath.
4. Raise your right leg laterally as high as possible in one fluid motion and exhale.
5. Lower your leg to the starting position and breathe in.
6. Once finished, do the same number of reps with the opposite leg.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站直，双脚并拢，双腿伸直，肩部后收。
2. 扶住物体保持平衡，例如深蹲架或椅子。
3. 收紧腹部，吸气。
4. 一次流畅地将右腿向侧上方抬至最高，呼气。
5. 将腿放回起始位置，吸气。
6. 完成后，换另一条腿完成相同次数。

exercises.title: Lateral Lunge
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand tall with your feet a few inches apart and your toes pointing slightly out.
2. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and position your hands in front of your chest.
3. Take a breath and bring your left leg to the side, planting the foot flat on the floor.
4. Immediately sink into a lunge by bending the knee. Keep your opposite leg straight and your foot on the ground.
5. Descend until your left thigh is almost parallel to the floor and hold for a moment.
6. Press through your left heel to extend your knee and bring your leg to the starting position as you exhale.
7. Inhale again as you bring your right leg out, performing the same movement.
8. Keep alternating.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站直，双脚分开数厘米，脚尖略微外展。
2. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，双手置于胸前。
3. 吸气，左腿向侧方跨出，脚掌平贴地面。
4. 立即屈膝下蹲成弓步。保持另一条腿伸直，脚不离地。
5. 下蹲至左大腿几乎与地面平行，稍作停顿。
6. 左脚跟发力伸直膝盖，呼气的同时将腿收回起始位置。
7. 再次吸气，右腿向侧方跨出，完成相同动作。
8. 持续交替进行。

exercises.title: Lateral Raise (Band)
exercises.how_to:
1. Take an open-ended resistance band with handles on both ends.
2. Step over the middle of the band and hold the handles to your sides.
3. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and lean your torso slightly forward. Your hands should be in front of your hips.
4. Raise your arms to your sides in one fluid motion. Go up until your shoulders, elbows, and wrists align, exhaling at the top.
5. Lower your arms to the starting position as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 取一条两端带把手的开口弹力带。
2. 双脚踩住弹力带中段，双手握住把手置于体侧。
3. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，躯干略微前倾。双手应位于髋部前方。
4. 一次流畅地将双臂向两侧抬起。抬至肩、肘、腕成一条直线，顶端呼气。
5. 将双臂下放回起始位置，同时吸气。

exercises.title: Lateral Raise (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the pulleys of a double cable machine in the lowest position and attach handles.
2. Select the appropriate weight on both stacks.
3. Walk to the left and grab the handle with your right hand.
4. Walk to the right and grab the other handle with your left hand.
5. Stand in the middle with your arms straight and your hands in front of your hips.
6. Engage your abs, retract your shoulder blades, and breathe in.
7. Raise both arms to your sides in one fluid motion, going up until your shoulders, elbows, and wrists align. Exhale at the top.
8. Lower your arms as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将双绳索器械的滑轮调到最低位置并装上把手。
2. 在两侧配重片上选择合适的重量。
3. 向左走，用右手握住把手。
4. 向右走，用左手握住另一侧把手。
5. 站在中间，手臂伸直，双手位于髋部前方。
6. 收紧腹部，收紧肩胛骨，吸气。
7. 一次流畅地将双臂向两侧抬起，抬至肩、肘、腕成一条直线。顶端呼气。
8. 下放双臂，同时吸气。

exercises.title: Lateral Raise (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of light dumbbells and stand tall.
2. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and take a breath.
3. Lift both arms laterally until your elbows and wrists align with your shoulders. Exhale at the top.
4. Lower the dumbbells to your sides as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双手各持一只轻哑铃，站直。
2. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，吸气。
3. 将双臂向两侧抬起，直至手肘与手腕和肩部齐平。顶端呼气。
4. 将哑铃下放至体侧，同时吸气。

exercises.title: Lateral Raise (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load and adjust the seat’s height.
2. Sit down and bring your shoulders back and into the back support.
3. Grab the handles on your sides and position your forearms flat against the pads.
4. Take a breath and bring your arms to your sides smoothly, going up until your elbows are at shoulder level. Breathe out.
5. Lower your arms to your sides and breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的配重并调整座椅高度。
2. 坐下，肩部后收并贴住靠背。
3. 握住身体两侧的把手，前臂平贴在垫板上。
4. 吸气，平稳地将双臂向两侧抬起，抬至手肘与肩同高。呼气。
5. 将双臂下放至体侧，吸气。

exercises.title: Lateral Squat
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, and point your toes slightly out.
2. Raise your arms in front of your body for balance.
3. Breathe in, bring your left leg out several inches, plant your foot, and squat.
4. Go down as low as your strength and mobility allow.
5. Hold for a moment and forcefully push through your heels to bring yourself to the top as you exhale.
6. Breathe in, bring your right leg out, plant your foot, and squat.
7. Keep alternating.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双脚与髋同宽站立，脚尖略微外展。
2. 双臂在身前抬起以保持平衡。
3. 吸气，左腿向侧方跨出数厘米，踩实脚掌并下蹲。
4. 在力量与柔韧性允许的范围内尽量下蹲。
5. 稍作停顿，用力蹬脚跟起身还原，同时呼气。
6. 吸气，右腿向侧方跨出，踩实脚掌并下蹲。
7. 持续交替进行。

exercises.title: Leg Extension (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load.
2. Adjust the pad to be against your lower legs, just above your feet when seated.
3. Sit down, grab the handles by your sides, place your lower shins against the pad, and retract your shoulders.
4. Take a breath and straighten your legs by engaging your quadriceps.
5. Lift the weight until your knees straighten, and breathe out.
6. Hold for a moment and bend your knees slowly as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的配重。
2. 调整垫板位置，使其在坐姿下贴住小腿、位于脚踝上方。
3. 坐下，握住身体两侧的把手，将小腿下段贴住垫板，收紧肩部。
4. 吸气，收紧股四头肌伸直双腿。
5. 将重量抬起直至膝盖伸直，呼气。
6. 稍作停顿，吸气并缓慢屈膝。

exercises.title: Leg Press (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Add the appropriate weight to the leg press machine and sit down.
2. Lift your legs and plant your feet flat on the platform. Have your feet in a comfortable position with your toes pointing slightly out.
3. Grab the handles to your sides, bring your shoulders back, and engage your abs.
4. Press the platform and straighten your legs while rotating the handles to remove the safety pins.
5. Take another breath and lower the platform by bending your knees.
6. Hold the bottom position for a moment and press the platform away as you exhale.
7. Once finished, straighten your legs, rotate the handles to put the safety pins on, and rest.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在腿举器械上加上适量配重并坐下。
2. 抬起双腿，将双脚平放在踏板上。双脚以舒适位置放置，脚尖略微外展。
3. 握住身体两侧的把手，肩部后收，收紧腹部。
4. 推动踏板并伸直双腿，同时转动手柄解除安全插销。
5. 再次吸气，屈膝下放踏板。
6. 在最低点稍作停顿，呼气的同时将踏板推开。
7. 完成后，伸直双腿，转动手柄扣上安全插销，然后休息。

exercises.title: Leg Press Horizontal (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load and sit down.
2. Place your feet flat on the platform at a comfortable width.
3. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and grab the handles by your sides.
4. Take a breath and press the platform forward until you straighten your legs. Exhale.
5. Bend your legs slowly as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的配重并坐下。
2. 双脚以舒适间距平放在踏板上。
3. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，握住身体两侧的把手。
4. 吸气，将踏板向前推至双腿伸直。呼气。
5. 吸气并缓慢屈腿。

exercises.title: Leg Raise Parallel Bars
exercises.how_to:
1. Position yourself on a captain’s chair. Have your forearms flat against the horizontal pads and grab the handles for support.
2. Bring your feet together and engage your abs to position your lower back against the back support.
3. Take a breath and raise your legs in one fluid motion, going as high as possible. Exhale at the top.
4. Slowly lower your legs to the starting position and keep the tension on your abs. Breathe in on the way down, and don’t let your lower back arch.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 坐在船长椅上，前臂平放在横向靠垫上，双手握住把手支撑身体。
2. 双脚并拢，收紧腹部，让下背贴住靠背。
3. 吸气，用流畅的动作抬高双腿，尽量抬高。在最高点呼气。
4. 缓慢将双腿放回起始位置，保持腹部紧张。下放时吸气，不要让下背拱起。

exercises.title: Low Cable Fly Crossovers
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load.
2. Set the pulleys in the lowest position and attach handles.
3. Grab both handles one at a time and stand in the middle with your arms to your sides.
4. Stagger your stance, bring your shoulders back, and squeeze your abs.
5. Take a breath and bring your arms up and in, tapping the handles lightly as you squeeze your chest and breathe out.
6. Slowly bring your arms to your sides as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的重量。
2. 将滑轮调到最低位置并装上把手。
3. 依次握住两个把手，站在中间，双臂垂于身体两侧。
4. 前后错开站立，肩部后收，收紧腹部。
5. 吸气，双臂向上向内合拢，在挤压胸肌并呼气时让把手轻碰。
