6. 吸气，缓慢将双臂放回身体两侧。

exercises.title: Low Row (Suspension)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab the handles of a suspension kit and extend your arms in front of your body.
2. Step forward a bit to lean your body at a comfortable angle.
3. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and squeeze your glutes.
4. Take a breath and pull yourself up, squeezing your back muscles at the top and exhaling.
5. Slowly extend your arms and breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 握住悬吊带的把手，双臂在身体前方伸直。
2. 向前迈一小步，让身体后倾到舒适的角度。
3. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，夹紧臀部。
4. 吸气，将身体拉起，在最高点挤压背部肌肉并呼气。
5. 缓慢伸直手臂并吸气。

exercises.title: Lunge
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand tall with your shoulders back, hands on your hips, and gaze directed forward.
2. Take a breath and engage your abs.
3. Lunge forward, bringing your right leg in front of your body, and plant the foot on the floor.
4. Immediately descend by bending your knee and going down until your back knee taps the floor.
5. Press through your front heel to stand up and exhale.
6. Bring your back foot forward, plant it on the floor, and lunge again.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站直，肩部后收，双手叉腰，目视前方。
2. 吸气并收紧腹部。
3. 向前弓步，右腿迈到身体前方，脚掌踩实地面。
4. 立即屈膝下蹲，直到后侧膝盖轻触地面。
5. 通过前脚脚跟发力站起并呼气。
6. 后脚向前迈出，踩实地面，再次弓步。

exercises.title: Lunge (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Position a barbell on your upper back and grab it for support.
2. Have your feet hip-width apart with your toes pointing slightly out.
3. Take a breath, lunge forward, and plant your foot flat on the floor.
4. Immediately sink into a lunge while keeping your torso stable and upright.
5. Descend until your back knee is an inch or two from the floor.
6. Press through your front heel to extend your knee and bring the leg to the starting position as you exhale.
7. Take another breath and lunge forward, extending the opposite leg.
8. Keep alternating.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将杠铃置于上背，双手握住以稳定。
2. 双脚与髋同宽，脚尖略微外展。
3. 吸气，向前弓步，脚掌平放踩实地面。
4. 立即下蹲成弓步，保持躯干稳定直立。
5. 下蹲至后侧膝盖距离地面一两英寸。
6. 通过前脚脚跟发力伸直膝盖，呼气的同时将腿带回起始位置。
7. 再次吸气，向前弓步，换另一条腿。
8. 交替进行。

exercises.title: Lunge (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells, hold them to your sides, and stand tall.
2. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and have your feet in a comfortable stance.
3. Take a breath and lunge forward, plating one foot in front of your body.
4. Immediately sink into a lunge and descend until your front thigh is almost parallel to the floor. Your back knee should be an inch or two from the floor.
5. Press through your front heel to extend your leg and bring it back to the starting position as you exhale.
6. Take another breath and lunge again, bringing your opposite leg forward.
7. Keep alternating.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双手各持一只哑铃，置于身体两侧，站直。
2. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，双脚以舒适的姿势站立。
3. 吸气，向前弓步，一只脚踩到身体前方。
4. 立即下蹲成弓步，下蹲至前侧大腿几乎与地面平行。后侧膝盖应距离地面一两英寸。
5. 通过前脚脚跟发力伸直腿，呼气的同时回到起始位置。
6. 再次吸气，向前弓步，换另一条腿。
7. 交替进行。

exercises.title: Lying Knee Raise
exercises.how_to:
1. Lie on the floor with your feet together, arms to your sides, and your body straight.
2. Engage your abs and lift your feet an inch or two from the floor. Your lower back should be in contact with the floor.
3. Take a breath and lift your legs, bending your knees at a 90-degree angle. Breathe out.
4. Slowly lower your legs to the starting position as you straighten your knees. Breathe in and keep your feet off the floor.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 仰卧在地面，双脚并拢，双臂置于身体两侧，身体成一条直线。
2. 收紧腹部，将双脚抬起距离地面一两英寸。下背应贴住地面。
3. 吸气，抬起双腿，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。呼气。
4. 缓慢将双腿放回起始位置，同时伸直膝盖。吸气，并保持双脚离开地面。

exercises.title: Lying Leg Curl (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load and adjust the pad to be over your Achilles tendon (above the heel) when you lie down.
2. Lie down, grab the handles, and place the back of your lower legs against the pad.
3. Take a breath and engage your hamstrings to curl your legs, lifting the weight.
4. Curl until your lower legs are almost vertical and exhale at the top.
5. Hold for a moment and extend your knees slowly as you inhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的重量，并调整靠垫，使你躺下时靠垫位于跟腱（脚跟上方）处。
2. 躺下，握住把手，将小腿后侧抵住靠垫。
3. 吸气，收紧腘绳肌弯举双腿，抬起重量。
4. 弯举至小腿几乎垂直，在最高点呼气。
5. 停顿片刻，吸气的同时缓慢伸直膝盖。

exercises.title: Lying Leg Raise
exercises.how_to:
1. Lie on the floor with your legs straight, arms to your sides, and palms flat on the floor.
2. Engage your abs, take a breath, and bring your legs together.
3. Lift your legs in the air until your heels point at the ceiling. Breathe out.
4. Lower your legs slowly without resting your feet on the floor and breathe in. Maintain slight roundness in your lower back throughout each repetition.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 仰卧在地面，双腿伸直，双臂置于身体两侧，手掌平放地面。
2. 收紧腹部，吸气，双脚并拢。
3. 抬起双腿，直到脚跟朝向天花板。呼气。
4. 缓慢放下双腿，不要让双脚放在地面上，并吸气。每次重复时保持下背略微拱起。

exercises.title: Lying Neck Curls
exercises.how_to:
1. Lie face up on a flat gym bench with your head over the edge.
2. Breathe in and lower your head to a comfortable level.
3. Flex the muscles on the front of your neck to perform a repetition as you exhale.
4. Lower your head again as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 仰卧在平板健身凳上，头部悬在凳子边缘外。
2. 吸气，将头部下放至舒适的位置。
3. 呼气的同时收缩颈前肌肉完成一次动作。
4. 吸气，再次下放头部。

exercises.title: Lying Neck Curls (Weighted)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a weight plate and lie face up on a flat gym bench with your head over the edge.
2. Position the weight plate against your forehead and hold it with both hands.
3. Breathe in and lower your head to a comfortable level.
4. Flex the muscles on the front of your neck to raise your head as you exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 取一片杠铃片，仰卧在平板健身凳上，头部悬在凳子边缘外。
2. 将杠铃片抵住前额，双手握住。
3. 吸气，将头部下放至舒适的位置。
4. 呼气的同时收缩颈前肌肉抬起头部。

exercises.title: Lying Neck Extension
exercises.how_to:
1. Lie face down on a flat gym bench with your head over the edge.
2. Grab the back support for balance or place your hands on the ground.
3. Inhale and extend your neck back in one fluid motion. Exhale.
4. Lower your head as you breathe in, and repeat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 俯卧在平板健身凳上，头部悬在凳子边缘外。
2. 握住靠背保持平衡，或将双手放在地面上。
3. 吸气，用流畅的动作向后伸展颈部。呼气。
4. 吸气的同时下放头部，重复。

exercises.title: Lying Neck Extension (Weighted)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a weight plate and lie face down on a flat gym bench with your head over the edge.
2. Position the weight behind your head and hold it with both hands.
3. Inhale and lower your head until you feel a stretch at the back of your neck.
4. Extend your neck in one fluid motion to lift your head and exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 取一片杠铃片，俯卧在平板健身凳上，头部悬在凳子边缘外。
2. 将杠铃片置于头后，双手握住。
3. 吸气，下放头部直到感觉颈后拉伸。
4. 用流畅的动作伸展颈部抬起头部并呼气。

exercises.title: Meadows Rows (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set a barbell on a landmine attachment or place one end of the bar at a wall angle to serve as an anchor point.
2. Load the opposite side of the barbell with some weight.
3. Stand perpendicular to the loaded side of the bar (one side facing it).
4. Assume a staggered stance, bend forward, and grab the barbell sleeve with the hand closer to the bar.
5. Raise your torso enough for the loaded side of the barbell to lift an inch or two off the floor while your arm is straight.
6. Bring your shoulders back, take a breath, and pull the bar up and close to your side, squeezing your lat. Pull the weight until your elbow is at a 90-degree angle and the barbell sleeve is at torso level as you exhale.
7. Extend your arm slowly, breathing in on the way down. Don’t protract your shoulder (roll it forward) as you reach the bottom of each rep.
8. Once finished training one side, turn your body 180 degrees and do the same number of reps with your opposite arm.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将杠铃装入地雷架，或将杠铃一端抵在墙角作为固定点。
2. 在杠铃另一端加上重量。
3. 站在杠铃负重一侧的垂直方向（身体一侧朝向杠铃）。
4. 采用前后错开的站姿，俯身，用靠近杠铃的手握住杠铃套筒。
5. 抬起躯干，直到手臂伸直时杠铃负重端离开地面一两英寸。
6. 肩部后收，吸气，将杠铃向上拉起贴近身体一侧，挤压背阔肌。呼气的同时将重量拉到肘部呈 90 度角、杠铃套筒位于躯干高度。
7. 缓慢伸直手臂，下放时吸气。每次动作到底部时不要让肩部前引（向前滚动）。
8. 一侧训练完成后，身体转 180 度，用另一只手臂完成相同次数。

exercises.title: Mountain Climber
exercises.how_to:
1. Get down on all fours. Have your hands and knees flat on the floor.
2. Straighten your leg to support your lower body on your toes.
3. Engage your abs and lift your buttocks several inches toward the ceiling.
4. Take a breath and tuck your right knee to your chest in one fluid motion. Exhale.
5. Extend the right leg as you breathe in.
6. Tuck your left knee to your chest and exhale.
7. Keep alternating and maintain a steady tempo from start to finish.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 跪撑在地面，双手和双膝平放在地上。
2. 伸直双腿，用脚尖支撑下半身。
3. 收紧腹部，将臀部向天花板抬起几英寸。
4. 吸气，用流畅的动作将右膝收向胸部。呼气。
5. 吸气的同时伸直右腿。
6. 将左膝收向胸部并呼气。
7. 交替进行，全程保持稳定的节奏。

exercises.title: Muscle Up
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand underneath a pull-up bar, reach up, jump, and grab it with a double overhand grip (palms facing forward).
2. As you grab the bar, engage your abs, have your shoulder blades back, and keep your hips slightly flexed, legs straight, and feet together.
3. As your body beings to swing back, pull yourself up as powerfully as possible, aiming to bring your body back and around the pull-up bar. The momentum should carry you high enough for your chest to end up slightly above the bar.
4. Perform a straight bar dip to extend your elbows, exhaling near the top.
5. Lower yourself by bending your elbows and moving your body down from the bar.
6. Swing back and forth to create momentum and begin the next repetition just as your body starts swinging back.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站在引体向上杠下方，向上伸展、起跳，用双手正握（掌心朝前）握住单杠。
2. 握住单杠时收紧腹部，肩胛骨后收，髋部略微屈曲，双腿伸直，双脚并拢。
3. 当身体开始向后摆动时，尽可能有力地向上拉起，目标是让身体绕到单杠上方。惯性应能让你升得足够高，使胸部略高于单杠。
4. 做直杠臂屈伸伸直肘部，在接近顶部时呼气。
5. 屈肘，让身体从单杠上缓缓下降。
6. 前后摆动产生惯性，在身体开始向后摆动的瞬间开始下一次重复。

exercises.title: Negative Pull Up
exercises.how_to:
1. Place a stool, gym bench, or plyo box underneath a pull-up bar.
2. Step on the object and grab the pull-up bar with an overhand grip (palms facing forward). Your elbows should be bent at roughly 90 degrees.
3. Take a deep breath and engage your abs.
4. Step off the object to suspend yourself in the air and slowly extend your arms against the force of gravity.
5. Once done, step on the sturdy object again and repeat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在引体向上杠下方放置凳子、健身凳或跳箱。
2. 踩上物体，用正握（掌心朝前）握住引体向上杠。肘部应弯曲约 90 度。
3. 深吸气并收紧腹部。
4. 从物体上踏下，让身体悬空，对抗重力缓慢伸直手臂。
5. 完成后再次踩上稳固的物体，重复。

exercises.title: Nordic Hamstrings Curls
exercises.how_to:
1. Get down on your knees and secure your feet underneath a loaded barbell or another sturdy object.
2. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and squeeze your glutes.
3. You can have your arms to your sides or position your hands in front of your torso for support.
4. Take a breath and lower your torso to the floor by slowly extending your knees. Keep your hips stable and your glutes engaged.
5. Lower yourself as much as your strength allows and engage your posterior muscles to lift your torso to an upright position. Exhale near the top.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 跪在地上，将双脚固定在负重杠铃或其他稳固物体下方。
2. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，夹紧臀部。
3. 双臂可置于身体两侧，或双手放在躯干前方支撑。
4. 吸气，通过缓慢伸直膝盖将躯干下放至地面。保持髋部稳定，臀部收紧。
5. 在力量允许的范围内尽量下放，然后收紧身体后侧肌群将躯干抬回直立位置。在接近顶部时呼气。

exercises.title: Oblique Crunch
exercises.how_to:
1. Lie on your right side, bend your knees, and stack your legs.
2. Place your left hand behind your head.
3. Take a breath and engage your top obliques to crunch your torso, lifting your right shoulder off the floor. Breathe out.
4. Lower your shoulder to the floor as you breathe in.
5. Repeat.
6. Once finished, lie on your left side and repeat for the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 侧卧在右侧，屈膝，双腿叠放。
2. 左手放在头后。
3. 吸气，收缩上侧腹斜肌卷起躯干，将右肩抬离地面。呼气。
4. 吸气，将肩膀放回地面。
5. 重复。
6. 完成后换左侧侧卧，完成相同次数。

exercises.title: One Arm Push Up
exercises.how_to:
1. Get down on all fours.
2. Extend your legs and support your lower body on your toes. Spread your feet wider than hip-width distance.
3. Have your hands shoulder-width apart or slightly wider.
4. Engage your abs.
5. With your body tense and in position, lift one hand off the floor and bring it back behind your back.
6. Take a breath and lower yourself by bending your supporting arm. Go down as much as you can––ideally, until your chest is a couple of inches from the floor.
7. Extend your arm to get back to the starting position and exhale.
8. Once finished on one side, support your body on your other hand and do the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 跪撑在地面。
2. 伸直双腿，用脚尖支撑下半身。双脚间距宽于髋宽。
3. 双手与肩同宽或略宽。
4. 收紧腹部。
5. 身体绷紧并保持姿势，将一只手抬离地面，放到背后。
6. 吸气，屈曲支撑臂将身体下放。尽量下放，理想情况下直到胸部距离地面几英寸。
7. 伸直手臂回到起始位置并呼气。
8. 一侧完成后，换另一只手支撑身体，完成相同次数。

exercises.title: Overhead Curl (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the pulleys of a double cable machine in the highest position.
2. Select the appropriate weight on both stacks and attach handles to the pulleys.
3. Grab the two handles and stand in the middle of the cable machine with your arms straight and to your sides.
4. Bring your shoulders back and engage your abs.
5. Simultaneously bend your arms, bringing the handles to the sides of your head as you breathe out.
6. Slowly extend your arms as you inhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将双滑轮绳索机的滑轮调到最高位置。
2. 在两个配重片组上选择合适的重量，并将把手装到滑轮上。
3. 握住两个把手，站在绳索机中间，双臂伸直置于身体两侧。
4. 肩部后收，收紧腹部。
5. 呼气的同时屈肘，将把手拉向头部两侧。
6. 吸气的同时缓慢伸直手臂。

exercises.title: Overhead Dumbbell Lunge
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells and stand tall.
2. Raise the weights overhead and straighten your arms.
3. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and take a breath.
4. Extend your right leg forward, planting your foot on the floor.
5. Descend into a lunge until your front thigh is almost parallel to the floor.
6. Press through your front heel to extend your knee and bring your leg to the starting position as you exhale.
7. Take another breath and extend the opposite leg forward.
8. Alternate between left and right until you’re done.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双手各持一只哑铃，站直。
2. 将重量举过头顶，手臂伸直。
3. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，吸气。
4. 右腿向前迈出，脚掌踩实地面。
5. 下蹲成弓步，直到前侧大腿几乎与地面平行。
6. 通过前脚脚跟发力伸直膝盖，呼气的同时将腿带回起始位置。
7. 再次吸气，换另一条腿向前迈出。
8. 左右交替，直到完成。

exercises.title: Overhead Plate Raise
exercises.how_to:
1. Put your middle and ring fingers through the center hole of a weight plate and curl them against the plate. Have your thumb, index finger, and pinky pressed firmly on the other side.
2. Grab a second weight plate in the same way with your other hand.
3. Stand tall, extend your arms, and have the weight plates at your sides with your wrists neutral (palms facing your body).
4. Bring your chest out, engage your abs, and breathe in.
5. Raise the plates to your sides and overhead in a smooth arc motion with your knuckles facing one another at the top. Exhale.
6. Slowly lower the plates to your sides in the same arc motion, breathing in on the way down.
7. Repeat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将中指和无名指伸入杠铃片中心孔并扣住杠铃片，拇指、食指和小指紧压在另一面。
2. 用另一只手以同样的方式握住第二片杠铃片。
3. 站直，手臂伸直，杠铃片置于身体两侧，手腕保持中立（掌心朝向身体）。
4. 挺胸，收紧腹部，吸气。
5. 以平滑的弧线将杠铃片举至身体两侧并过头顶，在最高点让双手指关节相对。呼气。
6. 沿同样的弧线缓慢将杠铃片放回身体两侧，下放时吸气。
7. 重复。

exercises.title: Overhead Press (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Position the barbell at collarbone height on a rack or stand.
2. Grab the bar with an overhand grip (palms facing down), keeping your hands roughly shoulder-width apart.
3. Tuck yourself underneath the bar, retract your shoulders, engage your abs, and take a breath.
4. Unrack the barbell and take a couple of steps back.
5. Have your feet hip-width apart and the barbell at upper chest level.
6. Take another breath and press the bar in a straight vertical line, moving your head slightly back.
7. Press until your arms are straight and exhale.
8. Lower the bar in the same straight line until it ends up at neck level. Breathe in on the way down.
9. Once finished, move forward and carefully rack the barbell.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将杠铃放在架子上锁骨高度的位置。
2. 用正握（掌心朝下）握住杠铃，双手约与肩同宽。
3. 身体钻到杠铃下方，肩部后收，收紧腹部，吸气。
4. 取下杠铃，向后退几步。
5. 双脚与髋同宽，杠铃位于上胸高度。
6. 再次吸气，将杠铃沿垂直直线向上推，头部略微后移。
7. 推至手臂伸直并呼气。
8. 沿同样的直线下放杠铃，直到其位于颈部高度。下放时吸气。
9. 完成后向前走，小心地将杠铃放回架上。

exercises.title: Overhead Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells and stand tall.
2. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and squeeze your glutes.
3. Take a breath and lift the dumbbells to your sides. Bend your elbows at 90 degrees.
4. Inhale again and press the weights up and in, tapping them lightly at the top. Breathe out.
5. Lower the dumbbells to your sides and breathe in.
6. Stop when your elbows are slightly lower than your shoulders and initiate the next rep.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双手各持一只哑铃，站直。
2. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，夹紧臀部。
3. 吸气，将哑铃举到身体两侧。肘部弯曲 90 度。
4. 再次吸气，将重量向上向内推起，在最高点轻碰。呼气。
5. 将哑铃下放至身体两侧并吸气。
6. 当肘部略低于肩部时停止，开始下一次重复。

exercises.title: Overhead Press (Smith Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Position the Smith machine bar at collarbone height and add weight plates.
2. Stand in front of the bar and grab it with an even overhand grip. Your hands should be shoulder-width apart.
3. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and take a breath.
4. Unrack the bar.
5. Take another breath and press the bar overhead, exhaling at the top.
6. Slowly lower the bar, breathing in on the way down.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将史密斯机杠铃调至锁骨高度并加上杠铃片。
2. 站在杠铃前，用均匀的正握握住杠铃。双手应与肩同宽。
3. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，吸气。
4. 取下杠铃。
5. 再次吸气，将杠铃向上推过头顶，在最高点呼气。
6. 缓慢下放杠铃，下放时吸气。

exercises.title: Overhead Squat
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a barbell with a double overhand grip. Use a wider grip, but not to the point of shoulder discomfort.
2. Raise the barbell overhead and straighten your arms.
3. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and position your feet in a comfortable stance for squatting.
4. Take a breath and descend.
5. Keep your heels in contact with the floor and move down until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
6. Pause for a moment and press through your heels to drive yourself up.
7. Extend your knees and hips fully, exhaling near the top and keeping the barbell directly overhead.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 用双手正握握住杠铃。握距可宽一些，但不要宽到肩部不适。
2. 将杠铃举过头顶，手臂伸直。
3. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，双脚以舒适的深蹲站姿站立。
4. 吸气并下蹲。
5. 保持脚跟贴地，下蹲直到大腿与地面平行。
6. 停顿片刻，通过脚跟发力蹬起。
7. 完全伸直膝盖和髋部，在接近顶部时呼气，并保持杠铃位于头顶正上方。

exercises.title: Overhead Triceps Extension (Cable)
exercises.title_zh: 绳索过头肱三头肌屈伸
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the pulley at mid-thigh height, attach a rope, and select the correct load.
2. Grab both ends of the rope with an overhand grip (palms facing your body).
3. In one motion, turn away from the machine and dip slightly to raise the rope over your shoulders, positioning it behind your head. Your elbows should be bent and to the sides of your head.
4. With your chest out, lean forward slightly, bring one foot forward for balance, and brace your abs.
5. Breathe in and extend your elbows, spreading the rope at the top. Exhale.
6. Slowly bend your elbows as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将滑轮调至大腿中部高度，装上绳索，并选择合适的重量。
2. 用正握（掌心朝向身体）握住绳索两端。
3. 用一个动作转身背对器械，略微下蹲将绳索举过肩部，置于头后。肘部应弯曲并位于头部两侧。
4. 挺胸，身体略微前倾，一只脚向前保持平衡，收紧腹部。
5. 吸气，伸直肘部，在最高点分开绳索。呼气。
6. 吸气的同时缓慢屈肘。

exercises.title: Partial Glute Bridge (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Sit down with a loaded barbell over your hips and your upper back positioned against the edge of a flat gym bench.
2. Grab the bar evenly for support and plant your feet flat on the floor with toes pointing slightly out.
3. Brace your abs, breathe in, and press your hips against the barbell.
4. Push through your heels and engage your glutes to raise the bar and your hips toward the ceiling.
5. Pause when your hips align with your upper body. Squeeze your glutes at the top and exhale.
6. Slowly lower your buttocks several inches as you breathe in. Keep your abs tense and stop when you notice that your knees begin to move back toward your hips.
7. Extend your hips again and exhale.
8. Do the required number of reps in this partial range of motion and lower your buttocks to the floor.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 坐下，将负重杠铃放在髋部上方，上背靠在平板健身凳边缘。
2. 双手均匀握住杠铃以稳定，双脚平放地面，脚尖略微外展。
3. 收紧腹部，吸气，用髋部顶住杠铃。
4. 通过脚跟发力，收紧臀部，将杠铃和髋部向天花板抬起。
5. 当髋部与上身成一直线时停顿。在最高点夹紧臀部并呼气。
6. 吸气的同时缓慢将臀部下放几英寸。保持腹部紧张，当膝盖开始向髋部回移时停止。
7. 再次伸展髋部并呼气。
8. 在这个半程活动范围内完成所需次数，然后将臀部放回地面。

exercises.title: Pause Squat (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the barbell at collarbone height and add the appropriate amount of weight to it.
2. Place both hands evenly on the bar and grab it.
3. Tuck your head underneath and position your trapezius against the bar.
4. Engage your entire body and extend your knees to unrack the bar.
5. Take a couple of careful steps back, assume a comfortable squatting stance, take a deep breath, and engage your abs.
6. Squat to a comfortable depth and pause for two to three seconds.
7. Press through your heels to return to the top as you exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将杠铃调至锁骨高度并加上合适的重量。
2. 双手均匀地握住杠铃。
3. 头部钻到杠铃下方，将斜方肌贴在杠铃上。
4. 绷紧全身，伸直膝盖取下杠铃。
5. 小心地向后退几步，采用舒适的深蹲站姿，深吸气并收紧腹部。
6. 下蹲至舒适的深度，停顿两到三秒。
7. 通过脚跟发力回到顶部并呼气。

exercises.title: Pendlay Row (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand in front of a barbell with your feet in a comfortable stance and your toes pointing slightly out.
2. Lean forward and grab the bar with a double overhand grip.
3. Bring your shoulders back to straighten your back. Your shoulders should be slightly in front of the barbell and higher than your hips.
4. Take a breath and row the barbell to your chest as you exhale.
5. Lower the barbell slowly and rest it on the floor as you breathe in.
6. Row the barbell from a dead stop.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站在杠铃前，双脚以舒适的姿势站立，脚尖略微外展。
2. 俯身，用双手正握握住杠铃。
3. 肩部后收以挺直背部。肩部应略在杠铃前方并高于髋部。
4. 吸气，将杠铃划向胸部并呼气。
5. 缓慢下放杠铃，吸气的同时将其放回地面。
6. 从静止状态再次将杠铃划起。

exercises.title: Pendulum Squat (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Load the appropriate amount of weight plates.
2. Position yourself inside the machine, stepping on the platform with your upper back against the pads.
3. Have your feet in a comfortable squatting stance with your toes pointing slightly out.
4. Grab the handles at the sides of your head (or before you).
5. Retract your shoulder blades, engage your abs, and take a deep breath.
6. Fully extend your knees to lift the weight and use the handles to unrack it.
7. Squat slowly until your knees form a 90-degree angle, and pause briefly.
8. Press through your heels to return to the top position as you exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 装上合适数量的杠铃片。
2. 进入器械内，双脚踩在踏板上，上背贴住靠垫。
3. 双脚以舒适的深蹲站姿站立，脚尖略微外展。
4. 握住头部两侧（或前方）的把手。
5. 肩胛骨后收，收紧腹部，深吸气。
6. 完全伸直膝盖抬起重量，利用把手将其取下。
7. 缓慢下蹲，直到膝盖呈 90 度角，并短暂停顿。
8. 通过脚跟发力回到顶部位置并呼气。

exercises.title: Pike Pushup
exercises.how_to:
1. Get down on all fours. Have your knees and hands on the floor.
2. Straighten your legs and support your lower body on your toes.
3. Bring your buttocks back toward the ceiling to fold your body for the starting position.
4. Keep your shoulders back to maintain a neutral spine.
5. Take a breath and lower your body to the floor by bending your elbows.
6. Go down until your forehead is close to the floor, and press yourself back to the top as you exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 跪撑在地面，双膝和双手放在地上。
2. 伸直双腿，用脚尖支撑下半身。
3. 将臀部向后上方抬起，使身体折叠成起始姿势。
4. 保持肩部后收以维持脊柱中立。
5. 吸气，屈肘将身体下放至地面。
6. 下放至前额接近地面，呼气的同时撑回顶部。

exercises.title: Pilates
exercises.how_to: (Hevy provides no How-to steps for this entry.)
exercises.how_to_zh: （Hevy 未提供此动作的分步说明。）

exercises.title: Pinwheel Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells and stand tall with your shoulders back and chest out.
2. Position both dumbbells slightly in front of your thighs with your palms facing in and back.
3. Take a breath and curl one dumbbell in toward your chest until it comes slightly higher than your elbow. Breathe out.
4. Lower the dumbbell to the starting position, fully extending your arm. Breathe in on the way down.
5. Repeat with your other arm.
6. Keep alternating.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双手各持一只哑铃，站直，肩部后收，挺胸。
2. 将两只哑铃置于大腿稍前方，掌心朝向内侧和后方。
3. 吸气，将一只哑铃向胸部弯举，直到略高于肘部。呼气。
4. 将哑铃放回起始位置，手臂完全伸直。下放时吸气。
5. 换另一只手臂重复。
6. 交替进行。

exercises.title: Pistol Squat
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand tall with your arms extended forward, feet flat on the floor, shoulders back, and abs engaged.
2. Lift your left foot a few inches off the floor and take a breath.
3. Descend into a squat by bending your right knee. Allow your left leg to travel in front of your body.
4. Go down as low as possible––ideally, until your thigh is parallel to the floor.
5. Press through your right heel and move back to the top as you exhale.
6. Once finished training one side, plant your left foot on the floor, and do the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站直，双臂前伸，双脚平放地面，肩部后收，收紧腹部。
2. 将左脚抬起离开地面几英寸，吸气。
3. 屈右膝下蹲，让左腿在身体前方伸出。
4. 尽量下蹲，理想情况下直到大腿与地面平行。
5. 通过右脚脚跟发力回到顶部并呼气。
6. 一侧完成后，将左脚踩实地面，完成相同次数。

exercises.title: Plank
exercises.how_to:
1. Get down on the floor.
2. Extend your body. Support your lower body on your toes and your upper body on your forearms.
3. Keep your shoulders neutral and abs engaged.
4. Hold the position for as long as possible, breathing steadily as you do.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 俯身趴在地面上。
2. 伸展身体，脚尖支撑下半身，前臂支撑上半身。
3. 肩部保持中立，收紧腹部。
4. 尽可能长时间保持该姿势，同时保持均匀呼吸。

exercises.title: Plank Pushup
exercises.how_to:
1. Get down on all fours.
2. Extend your legs and support your lower body on your toes.
3. Place your forearms flat on the floor with your elbows underneath your shoulders.
4. Engage your abs and take a breath.
5. Extend your arms one at a time by placing your hands flat on the floor and pushing yourself up, exhaling as you extend both arms.
6. Reverse the motion by placing your forearms flat on the floor as you breathe in.
7. Keep alternating between the two positions.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 跪撑在地面。
2. 伸直双腿，用脚尖支撑下半身。
3. 前臂平放地面，肘部位于肩部正下方。
4. 收紧腹部，吸气。
5. 依次伸直手臂，将手掌平放地面撑起身体，双臂伸直时呼气。
6. 反向动作，吸气的同时将前臂放回地面。
7. 在两种姿势之间交替进行。

exercises.title: Plate Curl
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab the sides of a weight plate and position it in front of your hips.
2. Bring your shoulders back and engage your abs.
3. Take a breath and curl the plate until your wrists are slightly higher than your elbows. Exhale at the top.
4. Slowly extend your arms as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 握住杠铃片两侧，将其置于髋部前方。
2. 肩部后收，收紧腹部。
3. 吸气，弯举杠铃片直到手腕略高于肘部。在最高点呼气。
4. 吸气的同时缓慢伸直手臂。

exercises.title: Plate Front Raise
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a weight plate and position your hands on the sides with your arms straight.
2. Bring your shoulders back, have your feet in a comfortable stance, look forward, and take a breath.
3. Engage your abs and lift the plate in front of your body while keeping your arms straight. Breathe out.
4. Slowly lower the plate to your hips as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 握住一片杠铃片的两侧，手臂伸直。
2. 肩部后收，双脚以舒适的姿势站立，目视前方，吸气。
3. 收紧腹部，保持手臂伸直将杠铃片举到身体前方。呼气。
4. 吸气的同时缓慢将杠铃片下放至髋部。

exercises.title: Plate Press
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a weight plate by its sides and lift it in front of your chest.
2. Have your feet in a comfortable stance, engage your abs, and retract your shoulder blades.
3. Take a breath and press the plate forward, fully extending your arms and exhaling.
4. Slowly bend your arms, bringing the plate to your chest as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 握住杠铃片两侧，将其举到胸前。
2. 双脚以舒适的姿势站立，收紧腹部，肩胛骨后收。
3. 吸气，将杠铃片向前推出，完全伸直手臂并呼气。
4. 吸气的同时缓慢屈臂，将杠铃片收回胸前。

exercises.title: Plate Squeeze (Svend Press)
exercises.title_zh: 杠铃片挤压（斯文德推举）
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a weight plate and stand tall.
2. Squeeze the plate flat between your hands and lift it to your chest.
3. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and have your feet in a comfortable position.
4. Take a breath and press the plate forward until your arms are straight. Exhale.
5. Slowly bring the plate to your chest as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 抓起一片杠铃片，站直身体。
2. 双手将杠铃片夹紧于胸前并抬起。
3. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，双脚站于舒适位置。
4. 吸气，将杠铃片向前推出，直至手臂伸直。呼气。
5. 吸气的同时将杠铃片缓慢收回胸前。

exercises.title: Power Clean
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand in front of a loaded barbell with your feet underneath it and shins a couple of inches away.
2. Bend down and grab the barbell with an even, overhand grip.
3. Bring your chest out as much as possible. Your hips should be slightly higher than your knees in this position.
4. Initiate the first pull by deadlifting the barbell off the floor as you press your heels into the ground. Make the initial pull powerful.
5. Once the barbell travels above your knees, keep driving your hips forward as you begin pulling the weight in a straight vertical line. The sequence should happen in one smooth motion.
6. As the barbell travels up, squat, catch it, and have it land over your shoulders and upper chest.
7. As the barbell lands in a front rack position, squat up to the top, straightening your knees fully. Breathe out at the top.
8. Lower the barbell to the floor while keeping your back neutral.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站于装有杠铃片的杠铃前，双脚位于杠铃下方，小腿距杠铃约几厘米。
2. 俯身，双手以均匀的正握握住杠铃。
3. 尽量挺起胸部。此时臀部应略高于膝盖。
4. 脚跟压向地面，将杠铃硬拉离地，启动第一次发力。起始拉起要有力。
5. 当杠铃超过膝盖后，持续向前送髋，同时沿垂直直线拉起重量。整个动作应连贯流畅。
6. 杠铃上升时下蹲，接住杠铃，使其落于肩部与上胸之上。
7. 杠铃落于前架位后，蹲起至站立，完全伸直膝盖。在最高点呼气。
8. 保持背部中立，将杠铃放回地面。

exercises.title: Power Snatch
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand in front of a loaded barbell.
2. Position your feet underneath the bar with your shins a couple of inches away.
3. Lean forward and grab the bar with a double overhand grip. Use a wide grip, but not to the point of shoulder discomfort.
4. Lower your hips to position your shins against the barbell and bring your chest out to straighten your back.
5. Take a breath and engage your abs.
6. Pull the bar in a straight line, keeping it close to your shins.
7. As soon as the bar passes your knees, initiate the second, more aggressive pull and simultaneously extend your hips.
8. With the bar traveling in a straight vertical line, engage your upper body to continue pulling the bar to chest level.
9. As soon as the bar is high enough, bend your knees to tuck under the weight and receive it in an overhead position with your arms straight.
10. Complete the repetition by extending your legs and exhaling.
11. Slowly lower the barbell to the floor while keeping it close to your body.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站于装有杠铃片的杠铃前。
2. 双脚位于杠铃下方，小腿距杠铃约几厘米。
3. 俯身，双手以双正握握住杠铃。采用宽握，但不要宽到肩部不适。
4. 下压臀部，使小腿贴住杠铃，挺起胸部以挺直背部。
5. 吸气并收紧腹部。
6. 沿直线拉起杠铃，使其贴近小腿。
7. 杠铃一旦超过膝盖，立即启动第二次更有力的上拉，同时伸展髋部。
8. 杠铃沿垂直直线上升时，用上身继续将其拉至胸部高度。
9. 杠铃足够高时立即屈膝，身体钻到杠铃下方，以手臂伸直过头姿势接住。
10. 伸腿站起并在呼气中完成这次动作。
11. 保持杠铃贴近身体，将其缓慢放回地面。

exercises.title: Preacher Curl (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Load the bar and adjust the seat height of the preacher bench. You should be able to place your upper arms on the pad and maintain an upright torso.
2. Position yourself over the machine, grab the bar with an even underhand grip (palms facing the ceiling), lift the bar, and sit down.
3. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and breathe in.
4. Lower the bar until your arms are almost straight.
5. Lift the bar until your forearms are almost upright, and breathe out.
6. Extend your arms slowly as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 装好杠铃并调整牧师凳座椅高度。应能将上臂放在垫板上并保持躯干直立。
2. 站到器械前，双手以均匀的反握握住杠铃（掌心朝向天花板），抬起杠铃后坐下。
3. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，吸气。
4. 放下杠铃，直至手臂几乎伸直。
5. 抬起杠铃，直至前臂几乎竖直，呼气。
6. 吸气的同时缓慢伸直手臂。

exercises.title: Preacher Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the height of the preacher bench seat. You should be able to comfortably place the back of your upper arms against the pad.
2. Grab a pair of dumbbells and sit down.
3. Place your arms on the pad, bend your elbows, and have your wrists facing your body.
4. Engage your abs and take a breath.
5. Lower the dumbbells until your arms are straight.
6. Curl the weights to the top position, stopping when your forearms are almost upright. Breathe out.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 调整牧师凳座椅高度。应能舒适地将上臂后侧贴住垫板。
2. 拿起一对哑铃并坐下。
3. 将手臂放在垫板上，屈肘，手腕朝向身体。
4. 收紧腹部并吸气。
5. 放下哑铃，直至手臂伸直。
6. 将哑铃弯举至最高位置，前臂几乎竖直时停止。呼气。

exercises.title: Preacher Curl (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load.
2. Adjust the seat’s height. You should be able to put your triceps against the pad while seated.
3. Sit down, extend your arms, and grab the handles.
4. Engage your abs and take a breath.
5. Bend your arms to lift the weight until your forearms are almost upright. Exhale at the top.
6. Slowly extend your arms as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的配重。
2. 调整座椅高度。坐姿时应能将肱三头肌贴住垫板。
3. 坐下，伸直手臂并握住把手。
4. 收紧腹部并吸气。
5. 屈臂抬起重量，直至前臂几乎竖直。在最高点呼气。
6. 吸气的同时缓慢伸直手臂。

exercises.title: Press Under
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a barbell with a double overhand grip. Use a wide grip, but not to the point of shoulder discomfort.
2. Lift the barbell and position it on your upper back behind your neck.
3. Have your feet in a comfortable stance, bring your shoulders back, and engage your abs.
4. Inhale and simultaneously press the barbell overhead as you descend into a squat.
5. Move down until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
6. Press through your heels to straighten your legs and breathe out as you place the barbell on your upper back.
7. Inhale and repeat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双手以双正握握住杠铃。采用宽握，但不要宽到肩部不适。
2. 抬起杠铃，置于颈后的上背部。
3. 双脚站于舒适位置，肩部后收，收紧腹部。
4. 吸气，在下蹲的同时将杠铃推举过头。
5. 下蹲直至大腿与地面平行。
6. 脚跟发力伸直双腿，将杠铃放回上背部时呼气。
7. 吸气并重复。

exercises.title: Pull Up (Assisted)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load on the pull-up machine.
2. Grab the pull-up bar with an overhand grip (palms facing forward).
3. Place your knees on the padded platform.
4. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and take a breath.
5. Pull yourself up until your chin is slightly over the bar and exhale.
6. Lower yourself and fully straighten your arms as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在引体向上器械上选择合适的配重。
2. 以正握握住引体向上杆（掌心朝前）。
3. 双膝跪在软垫平台上。
4. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，吸气。
5. 将自己拉起，直至下巴略高于横杆，呼气。
6. 吸气的同时缓慢下降并完全伸直手臂。

exercises.title: Pull Up (Band)
exercises.how_to:
1. Wrap a looped resistance band on a pull-up bar and let it hang.
2. Put your feet on the band loop one at a time as you grab the pull-up bar with an overhand grip. Your hands should be slightly more than shoulder-width apart.
3. With your body suspended, bring your shoulders back and take a breath.
4. Pull yourself up and bring your chin over the bar as you breathe out.
5. Pause at the top for a moment and slowly lower yourself, extending your arms fully. Breathe in as you move down.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将环形弹力带套在引体向上杆上，使其自然下垂。
2. 以正握握住引体向上杆，双脚依次踩入弹力带环中。双手间距应略宽于肩。
3. 身体悬空后，肩部后收并吸气。
4. 将自己拉起，呼气的同时使下巴超过横杆。
5. 在最高点稍作停顿，然后缓慢下降并完全伸直手臂。下降时吸气。

exercises.title: Pull Up (Weighted)
exercises.how_to:
1. Attach a weight plate to yourself with a weight belt.
2. Reach up and grab the pull-up bar with an even overhand grip.
3. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and take a breath.
4. Pull yourself up in one fluid motion and exhale at the top.
5. Lower yourself slowly and breathe in, keeping your feet off the floor.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 用负重腰带将杠铃片挂在身上。
2. 向上伸臂，以均匀的正握握住引体向上杆。
3. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，吸气。
4. 以连贯动作将自己拉起，在最高点呼气。
5. 缓慢下降并吸气，双脚始终保持离地。

exercises.title: Pullover (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Pick a dumbbell and set it on the floor next to a gym bench.
2. Position your upper back against the flat gym bench.
3. Bend your knees and have your feet flat on the floor.
4. Reach down and grab the dumbbell.
5. Position the weight over your torso with your hands flat against the top weight plate.
6. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and inhale.
7. Lower the dumbbell behind your head while keeping your arms straight.
8. Hold for a moment and pull the dumbbell over to the starting position as you exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选一只哑铃，放在健身凳旁的地面上。
2. 上背部靠在平板健身凳上。
3. 屈膝，双脚平放于地面。
4. 向下伸手抓起哑铃。
5. 双手平贴在哑铃上层铃片上，将重量置于躯干上方。
6. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，吸气。
7. 保持手臂伸直，将哑铃下放至头后。
8. 稍作停顿，呼气的同时将哑铃拉回起始位置。

exercises.title: Pullover (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Add the appropriate load to the machine and adjust the seat height.
2. Sit down and place your lower triceps and elbows on the pads, with your hands grasping the handles for additional support.
3. Breathe in, engage your abs, and pull the weight down until your elbows are at your sides. Exhale.
4. Raise your arms to the starting overhead position as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 为器械加上合适的配重并调整座椅高度。
2. 坐下，将肱三头肌下部和肘部放在垫板上，双手握住把手以提供额外支撑。
3. 吸气，收紧腹部，将重量下拉，直至肘部到达身体两侧。呼气。
4. 吸气的同时将手臂举回头顶起始位置。

exercises.title: Push Press
exercises.how_to:
1. Have the barbell in a front rack position: your hands outside shoulder-width level with a full grip on the bar as it sits atop your shoulders.
2. Position your feet at roughly hip-width level with your toes pointed slightly out.
3. Take a deep breath and initiate the dip phase by bending your knees and hips as you keep your torso upright.
4. As you dip a few inches, change the direction by pushing through your heels to extend your knees and hips.
5. Use your lower body’s momentum to push through your torso and lift the bar off your shoulders.
6. Immediately push through your elbows to extend the bar overhead, exhaling at the top.
7. Slowly lower the barbell to the initial position, resting atop your shoulders as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 使杠铃处于前架位：双手间距略宽于肩，完整握住置于肩上的杠铃。
2. 双脚约与髋同宽，脚尖略微外展。
3. 深吸气，保持躯干直立，屈膝屈髋开始下蹲蓄力阶段。
4. 下蹲几厘米后改变方向，脚跟发力伸展膝、髋。
5. 借助下肢的动量经躯干传导，将杠铃推离肩部。
6. 随即用肘部发力将杠铃推举过头，在最高点呼气。
7. 吸气的同时将杠铃缓慢放回起始位置，落于肩上。

exercises.title: Push Up (Weighted)
exercises.how_to:
1. Get down on your knees and hands.
2. Straighten your legs and have your feet at a hip-width distance.
3. Position your hands slightly wider than shoulder-level apart, and keep your elbows tucked.
4. Engage your abs to ensure a neutral spine position.
5. Have someone place a weight plate on your mid-back.
6. Take a breath and lower yourself by bending your elbows.
7. Go down as much as your strength allows––ideally until your torso is a couple of inches from the floor.
8. Press yourself to the top, extending your elbows and exhaling.
9. Take another breath and repeat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双膝双手撑地。
2. 伸直双腿，双脚与髋同宽。
3. 双手间距略宽于肩，肘部内收。
4. 收紧腹部，保持脊柱中立。
5. 让他人将一片杠铃片放在你的中背部。
6. 吸气并屈肘下降身体。
7. 在力量允许范围内尽量下降，最好直至躯干距地面几厘米。
8. 呼气的同时伸直肘部将身体推回最高点。
9. 再次吸气并重复。

exercises.title: Push Up - Close Grip
exercises.how_to:
1. Get down on your hands and knees.
2. Bring your hands close.
3. Extend your body into a push-up position. Your shoulders, hips, knees, and ankles should be aligned.
4. Bring your shoulders back and take a breath.
5. Descend by bending your elbows. Lower yourself as much as possible.
6. Hold the bottom position for a moment and press to bring yourself to the top as you exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双手与双膝撑地。
2. 双手靠近。
3. 将身体撑成俯卧撑姿势。肩、髋、膝、踝应处于一条直线。
4. 肩部后收并吸气。
5. 屈肘下降。尽可能下放身体。
6. 在最低点稍作停顿，呼气的同时推起身体回到最高点。

exercises.title: Rack Pull
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the bar at mid-shin height.
2. Stand in front of the bar and keep your shins an inch or two away.
3. Lean forward and grab the bar with your hands just outside your thighs.
4. Press your shins against the barbell and simultaneously push your knees slightly against your elbows.
5. Bring your chest out and arch your upper back.
6. Extend your hips as you engage your upper back and drag the barbell up against your shins and thighs. Breathe out at the top.
7. Initiate the descent by bringing your hips back. Lower the bar in the same straight line. Inhale on the way down or before the next rep.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将杠铃架设在小腿中部高度。
2. 站于杠铃前，小腿距杠铃一两英寸。
3. 俯身，双手以略宽于大腿的间距握住杠铃。
4. 小腿贴住杠铃，同时让膝盖略微顶住肘部。
5. 挺起胸部并拱起上背。
6. 收紧上背，伸展髋部，将杠铃贴着小腿和大腿上拉。在最高点呼气。
7. 臀部后移开始下放，沿同一直线放下杠铃。下降过程中或下一次动作前吸气。

exercises.title: Rear Delt Reverse Fly (Cable)
exercises.title_zh: 绳索三角肌后束反向飞鸟
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the pulleys of a double cable machine in the highest position and attach handles.
2. Select the appropriate weight and stand in the middle of the machine.
3. With your left shoulder facing the pulley, grab the handle with your right hand.
4. Walk to the pulley on your right and grab the handle with your left hand.
5. Stand in the middle of the machine, engage your abs, and extend your arms in front of your body.
6. Take a breath and spread your arms, squeezing your upper back muscles. Exhale.
7. Slowly bring your arms to the starting position as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将双滑轮绳索器械的滑轮调至最高位置并装上把手。
2. 选择合适的配重，站在器械中间。
3. 左肩朝向滑轮，右手握住把手。
4. 走到右侧滑轮处，左手握住把手。
5. 站在器械中间，收紧腹部，双臂向前伸直。
6. 吸气，向两侧打开手臂，挤压上背肌肉。呼气。
7. 吸气的同时将手臂缓慢收回起始位置。

exercises.title: Rear Delt Reverse Fly (Dumbbell)
exercises.title_zh: 哑铃三角肌后束反向飞鸟
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of light dumbbells and have your feet at a hip-width distance.
2. Hinge at the hip to lean your torso forward and maintain a neutral spine.
3. Extend your arms and have your wrists neutral (facing one another).
4. Bring your shoulders back and take a breath.
5. Raise both dumbbells to the sides by engaging your posterior deltoids.
6. Lift until your elbows align with your shoulders and hold for a moment. Breathe out.
7. Lower the dumbbells to the starting position and breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿起一对轻哑铃，双脚与髋同宽。
2. 以髋为轴前倾躯干，保持脊柱中立。
3. 手臂伸直，手腕保持中立（彼此相对）。
4. 肩部后收并吸气。
5. 收紧三角肌后束，将两只哑铃向两侧举起。
6. 举至肘部与肩齐平并稍作停顿。呼气。
7. 将哑铃放回起始位置并吸气。

exercises.title: Rear Delt Reverse Fly (Machine)
exercises.title_zh: 固定器械三角肌后束反向飞鸟
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load.
2. Adjust the seat height. The handles should be at shoulder level when you're seated.
3. Sit down and grab the handles with your palms facing down.
4. Bring your shoulders back and take a breath.
5. Extend your arms to your sides and back as you breathe out.
6. Bring your arms to the starting position as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的配重。
2. 调整座椅高度。坐姿时把手应与肩齐平。
3. 坐下，以掌心向下的姿势握住把手。
4. 肩部后收并吸气。
5. 呼气的同时将手臂向两侧及后方伸展。
6. 吸气的同时将手臂收回起始位置。

exercises.title: Rear Kick (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Add the correct load and stand inside the machine with your front facing the chest pad and handles.
2. Position one shin against the bottom pad to create a more stable position and raise your opposite leg back with the foot flat against the footplate.
3. Lean forward and position your stomach and chest against the pad. Grab the handles.
4. Breathe in, engage your abs, and push the platform back and up in one smooth motion until your knee is fully extended. Exhale.
5. Slowly bend your knee as you breathe in. Push again and exhale.
6. Once finished training one side, switch leg positions and do the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 加上合适的配重，面朝胸垫和把手站入器械内。
2. 一侧小腿抵住下方垫板以保持稳定，另一条腿向后抬起，脚掌平贴踏板。
3. 前倾，使腹部和胸部贴住垫板。握住把手。
4. 吸气，收紧腹部，以连贯动作向后上方蹬踏板，直至膝盖完全伸直。呼气。
5. 吸气的同时缓慢屈膝。再次蹬出并呼气。
6. 一侧练完后，交换双腿位置，做相同次数的动作。

exercises.title: Recumbent Bike
exercises.how_to:
1. Pull the lever underneath the seat to adjust it to the correct position. Your legs should be able to extend without your knees locking out.
2. Sit down, place your feet on the pedals, and select your resistance.
3. Grab the handles at the sides of the seat for support.
4. Begin to cycle with a sustainable pace and breathe steadily as you do.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拉动座椅下方的调节杆，将座椅调到合适位置。双腿应能伸展而不至于膝盖锁死。
2. 坐下，双脚踩在踏板上，选择阻力。
3. 握住座椅两侧的把手以保持支撑。
4. 以可持续的节奏开始骑行，并保持平稳呼吸。

exercises.title: Renegade Row (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set a pair of hexagonal dumbbells parallel to one another and at a distance where you can grab them and perform push-ups.
2. Get down and grab both dumbbells. Extend your legs to straighten your body and bring your chest out. Your arms and body should be straight.
3. Space your feet apart for better balance.
4. Shift your weight slightly to the left.
5. Take a breath and row the right dumbbell until your elbow aligns with your torso. Exhale at the top.
6. Lower the weight to the starting position and breathe in.
7. Lean slightly to the right and row the left dumbbell.
8. Continue alternating until you're finished.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将一对六角哑铃平行放置，间距以能握住它们做俯卧撑为宜。
2. 俯身握住两只哑铃。伸直双腿使身体成一条直线并挺胸。手臂与身体应保持笔直。
3. 双脚分开以保持更好的平衡。
4. 将重心略微移向左侧。
5. 吸气，将右侧哑铃划起，直至肘部与躯干齐平。在最高点呼气。
6. 将重量放回起始位置并吸气。
7. 略微向右侧倾斜，划起左侧哑铃。
8. 持续交替进行，直至完成。

exercises.title: Reverse Crunch
exercises.how_to:
1. Lie on the floor, place your arms at your sides, and have your hands flat.
2. Bend your knees at a 90-degree angle and position them directly over your hips.
3. Take a breath, engage your abs, and bring your knees to your upper torso in one fluid motion, lifting your buttocks off the floor. Exhale.
4. Slowly bring your knees to the starting position and breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 仰卧于地面，双臂放于身体两侧，手掌平贴地面。
2. 屈膝成 90 度，使膝盖位于髋部正上方。
3. 吸气，收紧腹部，以连贯动作将膝盖收向上腹部，同时将臀部抬离地面。呼气。
4. 吸气的同时将膝盖缓慢放回起始位置。

exercises.title: Reverse Curl (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a barbell with an overhand grip (palms facing your body).
2. Stand tall, have your feet in a comfortable stance, and retract your shoulder blades.
3. Engage your abs and take a breath.
4. Curl the barbell and bend your arms until your wrists are slightly higher than your elbows. Breathe out.
5. Slowly extend your arms as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 以正握握住杠铃（掌心朝向身体）。
2. 站直，双脚站于舒适位置，肩胛骨后收。
3. 收紧腹部并吸气。
4. 弯举杠铃，屈臂直至手腕略高于肘部。呼气。
5. 吸气的同时缓慢伸直手臂。

exercises.title: Reverse Curl (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load, set the pulley to the lowest position, and attach a straight bar.
2. Lean forward, grab the bar with an overhand grip (palms facing down), and stand up.
3. Take a step back to lift the weight off its stack.
4. Retract your shoulder blades and engage your abs.
5. Curl the weight in one fluid motion until your wrists are slightly higher than your elbows and exhale. Keep your elbows at your side.
6. Slowly extend your arms as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的配重，将滑轮调至最低位置并装上直杆。
2. 俯身，以正握握住横杆（掌心向下），然后站直。
3. 后退一步，将配重块拉起离开配重片。
4. 肩胛骨后收并收紧腹部。
5. 以连贯动作弯举重量，直至手腕略高于肘部，呼气。保持肘部贴近身体两侧。
6. 吸气的同时缓慢伸直手臂。

exercises.title: Reverse Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells and stand tall.
2. Bring your arms in front of your body and have the dumbbells against your upper thighs. Your wrists should be pronated (palms facing your body).
3. Retract your shoulder blades, engage your abs, and take a breath.
4. Curl the dumbbells up until your wrists are slightly higher than your elbows, and breathe out.
5. Slowly extend your arms as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿起一对哑铃并站直。
2. 双臂放于身体前方，哑铃贴住大腿上部。手腕应旋前（掌心朝向身体）。
3. 肩胛骨后收，收紧腹部，吸气。
4. 将哑铃弯举向上，直至手腕略高于肘部，呼气。
5. 吸气的同时缓慢伸直手臂。

exercises.title: Reverse Fly Single Arm (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
1. Position a pulley at shoulder height and attach a handle.
2. Select the appropriate load, grab the handle with your right hand, and take a diagonal step to the right and back to lift the weight from its stack.
3. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and breathe in.
4. Extend your arm to your right side and back, squeezing your shoulder muscle and breathing out.
5. Slowly bring your arm in front of your body as you breathe in.
6. Repeat.
7. Once finished, grab the handle with your left hand, take two steps to the left, and do the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将滑轮调至肩部高度并装上把手。
2. 选择合适的配重，右手握住把手，向右后方斜退一步，将配重拉离配重片。
3. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，吸气。
4. 将手臂向右后方伸展，挤压肩部肌肉并呼气。
5. 吸气的同时将手臂缓慢收回身体前方。
6. 重复。
7. 完成后，左手握住把手，向左走两步，做相同次数的动作。

exercises.title: Reverse Grip Concentration Curl
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a dumbbell and sit on the edge of a flat gym bench.
2. Spread your legs and have your feet flat on the floor.
3. Grab the dumbbell with your right hand and rotate the wrist in, having the palm facing in.
4. Place your right elbow against your inner thigh.
5. Take a breath and lift the dumbbell by bending your arm.
6. Lift until your wrist is slightly higher than your elbow and breathe out.
7. Extend your arm as you breathe in.
8. Once finished, do the same number of reps for your other side.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿起一只哑铃，坐在平板健身凳边缘。
2. 分开双腿，双脚平放于地面。
3. 右手握住哑铃并内旋手腕，使掌心朝向内侧。
4. 将右肘抵住大腿内侧。
5. 吸气并屈臂抬起哑铃。
6. 抬起至手腕略高于肘部，呼气。
7. 吸气的同时伸直手臂。
8. 完成后，换另一侧做相同次数的动作。

exercises.title: Reverse Grip Lat Pulldown (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate weight.
2. Adjust the pad height so your legs fit snugly.
3. Stand tall and grab the bar with an even underhand grip (palms facing back).
4. Sit down and bring your shoulders back.
5. Take a breath and pull the bar to your chest. Exhale immediately.
6. Extend your arms as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的配重。
2. 调整垫板高度，使双腿被稳固卡住。
3. 站直，双手以均匀的反握握住横杆（掌心朝后）。
4. 坐下并肩部后收。
5. 吸气，将横杆拉至胸前。立即呼气。
6. 吸气的同时伸直手臂。

exercises.title: Reverse Grip Triceps Pushdown
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the pulley to the highest position, attach a bar, and select your weight.
2. Grab the bar with your palms facing up.
3. Bring your elbows to your sides and take a step back to unrack the weight.
4. Slightly lean forward to clear room for full arm extension at the bottom position.
5. Bring your shoulders back, breathe in, and extend your arms as you exhale.
6. Slowly bend your arms until your wrists are slightly higher than your elbows and breathe in.
7. Repeat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将滑轮调至最高位置，装上横杆并选择配重。
2. 以掌心向上的姿势握住横杆。
3. 肘部贴近身体两侧，后退一步将配重拉起。
4. 略微前倾，为最低点的手臂完全伸展留出空间。
5. 肩部后收，吸气，呼气的同时伸直手臂。
6. 缓慢屈臂，直至手腕略高于肘部，吸气。
7. 重复。

exercises.title: Reverse Hyperextension
exercises.how_to:
1. Add the appropriate weight to the machine.
2. Adjust the foot pads to be against your Achilles heels when you lie on top of the machine.
3. Position yourself on the machine with your hips on the edge of the pad and grab the handles for support.
4. Secure your feet between the bottom pads.
5. Bring your shoulders back and take a breath.
6. Raise your legs up in one fluid motion until your body is straight, exhaling at the top.
7. Slowly lower your legs to the starting position as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 为器械加上合适的配重。
2. 调整脚垫，使其在你俯卧于器械上时抵住跟腱。
3. 俯卧于器械上，髋部位于垫板边缘，握住把手保持支撑。
4. 将双脚固定在下方垫板之间。
5. 肩部后收并吸气。
6. 以连贯动作抬起双腿，直至身体成一条直线，在最高点呼气。
7. 吸气的同时将双腿缓慢放回起始位置。

exercises.title: Reverse Lunge
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand tall with your shoulders back, abs tight, and hands on your hips.
2. Have your feet in a comfortable stance with your toes pointing slightly out.
3. Take a breath and bring the right leg back, landing on the ball of the right foot. Sink into a lunge by bending your front leg. A good stride length is when your front shin remains relatively vertical (knee over ankle) as you descend.
4. Descend until your front thigh is almost parallel to the floor and your rear knee is an inch or two from the floor.
5. Pause at the bottom and engage your front leg to bring yourself back to the top.
6. Bring the right leg to the starting position and exhale.
7. Take another breath as you lunge back with your left leg.
8. Keep alternating.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站直，肩部后收，腹部收紧，双手叉腰。
2. 双脚站于舒适位置，脚尖略微外展。
3. 吸气，右腿向后迈出，以前脚掌落地。屈前腿下蹲成弓步。合适的步幅是下蹲时前腿小腿基本保持垂直（膝盖位于脚踝上方）。
4. 下降至前腿大腿几乎与地面平行，后膝距地面一两英寸。
5. 在最低点稍作停顿，前腿发力回到起始站立位。
6. 右腿收回起始位置并呼气。
7. 再次吸气，左腿向后迈出做弓步。
8. 持续交替进行。

exercises.title: Reverse Lunge (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Place a barbell on your back and hold it with both hands.
2. Stand tall with your shoulders back, abs engaged, and feet in a comfortable stance.
3. Take a breath and bring your right leg back, landing on the ball of the foot.
4. Sink into a controlled lunge by bending your front leg.
5. Descend until your front thigh is almost parallel to the floor and your rear knee is an inch or two from the floor. Your front shin should be relatively vertical as you move down.
6. Pause at the bottom and push through your front heel to extend your leg, bringing yourself to the top. Exhale.
7. Inhale again and lunge back with your left leg, landing on the ball of the foot.
8. Keep alternating until you finish the set.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将杠铃置于背上，双手握住。
2. 站直，肩部后收，收紧腹部，双脚站于舒适位置。
3. 吸气，右腿向后迈出，以前脚掌落地。
4. 屈前腿，有控制地下蹲成弓步。
5. 下降至前腿大腿几乎与地面平行，后膝距地面一两英寸。下蹲时前腿小腿应基本保持垂直。
6. 在最低点稍作停顿，前脚跟发力伸腿回到站立位。呼气。
7. 再次吸气，左腿向后迈出做弓步，以前脚掌落地。
8. 持续交替进行，直至完成该组。

exercises.title: Reverse Lunge (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells and stand tall.
2. Have your feet in a comfortable stance, bring your shoulders back, and engage your abs.
3. Take a breath and bring the right leg back, landing on the ball of the right foot. Immediately sink into a lunge by bending your front leg.
4. Descend until your front thigh is almost parallel to the floor and your rear knee is an inch or two from the floor. A good stride length is when your front shin remains relatively vertical (knee over ankle) as you descend.
5. Pause at the bottom and engage your front leg to bring yourself back to the top as you exhale.
6. Take another breath and lunge back with your left leg, landing on the ball of your left foot.
7. Keep alternating.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿起一对哑铃并站直。
2. 双脚站于舒适位置，肩部后收，收紧腹部。
3. 吸气，右腿向后迈出，以前脚掌落地。随即屈前腿下蹲成弓步。
4. 下降至前腿大腿几乎与地面平行，后膝距地面一两英寸。合适的步幅是下蹲时前腿小腿基本保持垂直（膝盖位于脚踝上方）。
5. 在最低点稍作停顿，前腿发力回到站立位，同时呼气。
6. 再次吸气，左腿向后迈出做弓步，以前脚掌落地。
7. 持续交替进行。

exercises.title: Reverse Plank
exercises.how_to:
1. Sit on the floor with your legs straight and feet together.
2. Extend your arms to your sides and behind your body. Keep your elbows straight, and place your palms flat on the floor.
3. With your hands planted firmly, contract your glutes and extend your hips toward the ceiling as you simultaneously raise your torso.
4. Have your head, neck, torso, and legs in a straight line. Keep your arms straight and look up.
5. Keep your glutes and midsection engaged, breathe steadily, and hold the plank position.
6. Once you’re done, drop your buttocks to the floor and take a break.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 坐于地面，双腿伸直，双脚并拢。
2. 双臂向身体两侧及后方伸出。保持肘部伸直，手掌平贴地面。
3. 双手撑稳，收紧臀部，髋部向天花板方向顶起，同时抬起躯干。
4. 使头、颈、躯干和双腿成一条直线。保持手臂伸直并抬头向上看。
5. 保持臀部和核心收紧，平稳呼吸，维持平板支撑姿势。
6. 完成后，将臀部放回地面并休息。

exercises.title: Reverse Wrist Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells and sit on a flat gym bench.
2. Place your elbows and forearms on your thighs with palms facing down. Your wrists should be just in front of your knees and the weights hanging.
3. Breathe in and extend your wrists, lifting the dumbbells up. Breathe out at the top.
4. Slowly lower the weights as you breathe in.
5. Repeat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿起一对哑铃，坐在平板健身凳上。
2. 将肘部和前臂放在大腿上，掌心向下。手腕应位于膝盖正前方，哑铃自然下垂。
3. 吸气并伸展手腕，将哑铃向上抬起。在最高点呼气。
4. 吸气的同时缓慢放下重量。
5. 重复。

exercises.title: Ring Dips
exercises.how_to:
1. Adjust the height of the rings to be at roughly stomach level.
2. Stand between the rings and grab them with both hands.
3. Keep your arms straight and elbows close to your body.
4. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and squeeze your glutes.
5. Take a breath and raise your feet off the floor one at a time.
6. Once you're confident that you're stable enough, take another breath and bend your arms.
7. Lower yourself gradually until your elbows are somewhat bent, and you feel a stretch in your chest.
8. Press through your triceps and return to the top as you exhale. Avoid explosive movements because these can lead to instability.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将吊环高度调至约与腹部齐平。
2. 站在吊环之间，双手握住吊环。
3. 保持手臂伸直，肘部贴近身体。
4. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，夹紧臀部。
5. 吸气，双脚依次离开地面。
6. 确认身体足够稳定后，再次吸气并屈臂。
7. 逐渐下降，直至肘部弯曲到一定程度并感到胸部有拉伸感。
8. 呼气的同时用肱三头肌发力推回最高点。避免爆发式动作，以免造成身体不稳。

exercises.title: Ring Pull Up
exercises.how_to:
1. Secure a pair of rings and set them at pull-up bar height.
2. Reach up and grab the rings with an overhand grip (palms facing forward).
3. Bring your shoulders back and down and engage your abs.
4. Bend your knees or bring your feet slightly forward to suspend yourself in the air.
5. Breathe in and pull yourself up in one fluid motion. Exhale at the top.
6. Slowly extend your arms as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 固定一对吊环，将其调至引体向上杆的高度。
2. 向上伸臂，以正握握住吊环（掌心朝前）。
3. 肩部后收下沉，收紧腹部。
4. 屈膝或双脚稍向前伸，使身体悬空。
5. 吸气，以连贯动作将自己拉起。在最高点呼气。
6. 吸气的同时缓慢伸直手臂。

exercises.title: Ring Push Up
exercises.how_to:
1. Secure a pair of rings and set them just an inch or two above the ground.
2. Get down on your knees and grab the rings.
3. Bring your shoulders back and flex your triceps, chest, and abs for maximum stability.
4. Extend your legs to assume a push-up position. Support your lower body on your toes.
5. Flex your glutes for additional stability.
6. Breathe in and slowly lower yourself to the ground while keeping your elbows close to your torso.
7. Descend as much as your strength allows and push back to the top as you exhale.
8. Breathe in and repeat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 固定一对吊环，将其调至距地面一两英寸处。
2. 双膝跪地，握住吊环。
3. 肩部后收，收紧肱三头肌、胸肌和腹部，以获得最大稳定性。
4. 伸直双腿成俯卧撑姿势。以下半身支撑于脚尖。
5. 夹紧臀部以进一步稳定身体。
6. 吸气，保持肘部贴近躯干，缓慢下降至地面。
7. 在力量允许范围内尽量下降，呼气的同时推回最高点。
8. 吸气并重复。

exercises.title: Romanian Deadlift (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a barbell with a double overhand grip (palms facing back). Your hands should be shoulder-width apart.
2. Stand tall, retract your shoulder blades, engage your abs, and have your feet in a comfortable stance.
3. Take a breath and lean forward by bringing your buttocks back (hinging at the hip). Your back should be neutral from start to finish.
4. Lower the bar in a straight vertical line, keeping it close to your body. You should feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
5. Straighten your body by driving your hips forward and exhale near the top.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双手以双正握握住杠铃（掌心朝后）。双手间距应与肩同宽。
2. 站直，肩胛骨后收，收紧腹部，双脚站于舒适位置。
3. 吸气，臀部后移（以髋为轴）前倾躯干。整个过程中背部应保持中立。
4. 沿垂直直线放下杠铃，使其贴近身体。应感到腘绳肌有拉伸感。
5. 髋部前送挺直身体，在接近最高点时呼气。

exercises.title: Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells and stand tall.
2. Position the weights in front of your hips with your palms facing your body.
3. Bring your shoulders back, position your feet a few inches apart, and take a breath.
4. Lean your torso forward by hinging at the hip. Your back should remain neutral, and you should feel a stretch in your posterior thigh muscles.
5. Lower the dumbbells in a straight line until they are below knee level.
6. Extend your hips forward and exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双手各握一只哑铃，站直。
2. 将哑铃置于髋部前方，掌心朝向身体。
3. 肩部后收，双脚分开约几英寸，吸气。
4. 以髋部为轴向前俯身。背部保持中立，应感到大腿后侧有拉伸感。
5. 沿直线下放哑铃，直至低于膝盖高度。
6. 髋部向前挺送并呼气。

exercises.title: Romanian Deadlift (Smith Machine)
exercises.title_zh: 史密斯机罗马尼亚硬拉
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the bar at mid-thigh height and add your weight.
2. Stand close to the bar, almost pressing your thighs against it. Your feet should be hip-width apart.
3. Grab the bar with an overhand grip - palms facing back. Have your hands roughly shoulder-width apart.
4. Unrack the bar and stand tall.
5. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and breathe in.
6. Slowly lower the bar by leaning your torso forward and pushing your buttocks back. You should feel tension at the back of your thighs.
7. Lean forward until your torso is almost parallel to the floor and drive your hips forward to stand up, exhaling at the top.
8. Breathe in on the way down and repeat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将杠铃置于大腿中部高度并加好重量。
2. 靠近杠铃站立，大腿几乎贴住杠铃。双脚与髋同宽。
3. 用正握（掌心向后）握住杠铃。双手约与肩同宽。
4. 起杠并站直。
5. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，吸气。
6. 躯干前倾、臀部后推，缓慢下放杠铃。应感到大腿后侧有紧绷感。
7. 前倾至躯干几乎与地面平行，然后髋部向前发力站起，在顶端呼气。
8. 下放时吸气，重复动作。

exercises.title: Rope Cable Curl
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the pulley in the lowest position and attach a rope.
2. Select the appropriate weight on the cable machine.
3. Bend forward and grab both ends of the rope with a neutral grip (palms facing one another).
4. Stand tall, bring your shoulders back, and step back to lift the weight from its stack.
5. Take a breath and curl the cable by bending your elbows.
6. Lift until your wrists are slightly higher than your elbows, and breathe out.
7. Extend your arms slowly and breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将滑轮调至最低位置并挂上绳索。
2. 在绳索器械上选择合适的重量。
3. 俯身，用对握（掌心相对）抓住绳索两端。
4. 站直，肩部后收，后撤一步将配重从配重片中拉起。
5. 吸气，屈肘弯举绳索。
6. 上举至手腕略高于肘部，呼气。
7. 缓慢伸直手臂并吸气。

exercises.title: Rope Straight Arm Pulldown
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load.
2. Set the pulley to the highest position and attach a rope.
3. Grab both ends of the rope with your hands neutral (facing one another) and straighten your arms.
4. Take a step back, engage your abs, and retract your shoulders.
5. Take a breath and pull the rope to your hips while keeping your arms straight. Breathe out.
6. Slowly bring the rope to the top as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的重量。
2. 将滑轮调至最高位置并挂上绳索。
3. 双手对握（掌心相对）抓住绳索两端，手臂伸直。
4. 后撤一步，收紧腹部，肩部后收。
5. 吸气，保持手臂伸直将绳索拉向髋部。呼气。
6. 缓慢将绳索送回上方，同时吸气。

exercises.title: Rowing Machine
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate resistance and sit down.
2. Reach forward and grab the cable attachment.
3. Bend your knees and place your feet flat on the footplates.
4. With your arms straight, inhale and push yourself back by engaging your thigh muscles.
5. As you move back, row the cable to your torso and exhale.
6. Extend your arms and bend your knees simultaneously to bring yourself back to the starting position as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的阻力并坐下。
2. 向前伸手抓住拉柄。
3. 屈膝，双脚平放在脚踏板上。
4. 手臂伸直，吸气，用大腿发力向后蹬。
5. 后移的同时将拉柄拉向躯干并呼气。
6. 同时伸直手臂、弯曲膝盖，回到起始位置，同时吸气。

exercises.title: Running
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand tall with your shoulders back.
2. Move forward and aim for a midfoot strike: landing the middle of your foot on the ground.
3. Keep your arms bent and hands relaxed.
4. Move your arms in sync with your feet in a natural way.
5. Land lightly on your feet, but avoid bouncing up and down as you move forward.
6. Keep your torso upright, core engaged, and gaze directed a few feet in front of you.
7. Maintain a steady breath, aiming to inhale through the nose and exhale through the mouth.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站直，肩部后收。
2. 向前移动，以中足落地：用脚掌中部接触地面。
3. 手臂保持弯曲，双手放松。
4. 手臂自然地与脚步协调摆动。
5. 落地要轻，但避免在前进时上下弹跳。
6. 保持躯干直立、核心收紧，目光看向身前几英尺处。
7. 保持平稳呼吸，尽量用鼻子吸气、用嘴呼气。

exercises.title: Russian Twist (Bodyweight)
exercises.how_to:
1. Sit down on the floor.
2. Bend your knees and have your feet flat on the ground.
3. Bring your arms in front of your torso and lean back as you engage your abs.
4. Take a breath and twist your torso to the right, holding for a moment and exhaling.
5. Immediately rotate your torso to the starting position as you breathe in.
6. Twist to the left and breathe out.
7. Keep alternating.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 坐在地面上。
2. 屈膝，双脚平放地面。
3. 双臂置于躯干前方，收紧腹部并向后倾斜。
4. 吸气，将躯干转向右侧，稍作停顿并呼气。
5. 立即将躯干转回起始位置，同时吸气。
6. 转向左侧并呼气。
7. 持续交替进行。

exercises.title: Russian Twist (Weighted)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a weight plate or dumbbell and sit on the floor.
2. Bend your knees and plant your feet flat on the ground. You can secure your feet under a bench or have a friend hold them down.
3. Grab the weight, position it in front of your torso, and extend your arms.
4. Lean your torso slightly back and engage your abs.
5. Take a breath and move the weight to the right, twisting your torso in that direction as you exhale.
6. Bring the weight to the starting position as you breathe in.
7. Twist to the left and exhale.
8. Keep alternating.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿起杠铃片或哑铃，坐在地面上。
2. 屈膝，双脚平放地面。可将脚固定在长凳下方，或让同伴按住。
3. 握住重物，置于躯干前方，双臂伸直。
4. 躯干略微后倾，收紧腹部。
5. 吸气，将重物移向右侧，同时将躯干转向该方向并呼气。
6. 将重物带回起始位置，同时吸气。
7. 转向左侧并呼气。
8. 持续交替进行。

exercises.title: Scapular Pull Ups
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pull-up bar with an even overhand grip (palms facing forward).
2. Engage your abs and lift your feet off the floor to suspend yourself in the air.
3. As you hang from the bar, keep your abs and glutes engaged to remain still and not swing back and forth.
4. Take a breath and initiate the scapular pull-up by bringing your shoulders back and down. Keep your arms straight. Doing so will elevate your body slightly.
5. Hold the retracted position for a second or two as you breathe out.
6. Relax your body and allow your shoulders to move forward and up, breathing in as you do.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 用均匀的正握（掌心向前）握住引体向上杆。
2. 收紧腹部，双脚离地，使身体悬空。
3. 悬垂时保持腹部和臀部收紧，使身体稳定，不要前后摆动。
4. 吸气，肩部后收下沉，启动肩胛引体向上。手臂保持伸直。这样会使身体略微上移。
5. 保持肩胛后收的位置一两秒，同时呼气。
6. 放松身体，让肩部向前上方移动，同时吸气。

exercises.title: Seal Row (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Load the bar and lie face down on the seal row bench with your body straight.
2. Grab the bar with an overhand grip (palms facing back) at roughly shoulder-width level.
3. Unrack the bar and bring it underneath your chest. Let your arms hang straight down and fully extended.
4. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and pull the bar while keeping your elbows tucked in.
5. Pull until your elbows are at torso level and exhale.
6. Slowly lower the barbell to the starting position as you breathe in.
7. Repeat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 给杠铃加好重量，俯卧在海豹划船凳上，身体保持笔直。
2. 用正握（掌心向后）握住杠铃，双手约与肩同宽。
3. 取下杠铃，置于胸部下方。双臂自然下垂并完全伸直。
4. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，夹紧肘部拉动杠铃。
5. 拉至肘部与躯干齐平并呼气。
6. 缓慢将杠铃放回起始位置，同时吸气。
7. 重复。

exercises.title: Seal Row (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Place your weights within arm’s reach.
2. Lie face down on a seal row bench or elevated gym bench (for instance, elevated with two plyometric boxes) with your body straight.
3. Grab the dumbbell and let your arms hang straight down and fully extended.
4. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and pull the dumbbells while keeping your elbows tucked in.
5. Pull until your elbows are at torso level and exhale.
6. Slowly lower the weights to the starting position as you breathe in.
7. Repeat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将哑铃放在伸手可及的位置。
2. 俯卧在海豹划船凳或加高的健身凳上（例如用两个跳箱垫高），身体保持笔直。
3. 握住哑铃，双臂自然下垂并完全伸直。
4. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，夹紧肘部拉动哑铃。
5. 拉至肘部与躯干齐平并呼气。
6. 缓慢将哑铃放回起始位置，同时吸气。
7. 重复。

exercises.title: Seated Cable Row - Bar Grip
exercises.title_zh: 坐姿绳索划船 - 横杆握把
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load and sit down.
2. Reach ahead and grab the bar evenly.
3. Sit back and position your feet on the footplates.
4. Bring your shoulders back and engage your abs.
5. Take a breath and pull the handle attachment to your upper stomach. Breathe out.
6. Hold for a moment and extend your arms fully as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的重量并坐下。
2. 向前伸手，均匀握住横杆。
3. 向后坐稳，双脚踩在脚踏板上。
4. 肩部后收，收紧腹部。
5. 吸气，将拉柄拉向胃部上方。呼气。
6. 稍作停顿，完全伸直手臂，同时吸气。

exercises.title: Seated Cable Row - Bar Wide Grip
exercises.title_zh: 坐姿绳索划船 - 横杆宽握
exercises.how_to:
1. Attach a curved bar to a seated cable row machine.
2. Select the appropriate weight.
3. Sit down, place your feet on the platform, and bend your knees slightly.
4. Lean forward and grab the bar with a double overhand grip (palms facing down).
5. Lean back to lift the weight from its stack, engage your abs, and retract your shoulder blades.
6. Take a breath and row the bar to your stomach, squeezing your back and breathing out.
7. Slowly extend your arms and breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在坐姿绳索划船器械上挂上弯杆。
2. 选择合适的重量。
3. 坐下，双脚踩在踏板上，膝盖微屈。
4. 前倾，用双手正握（掌心向下）握住横杆。
5. 后倾将配重从配重片中拉起，收紧腹部，肩胛后收。
6. 吸气，将横杆划向腹部，收紧背部并呼气。
7. 缓慢伸直手臂并吸气。

exercises.title: Seated Cable Row - V Grip (Cable)
exercises.title_zh: 坐姿绳索划船 - V 形握把
exercises.how_to:
1. Attach a V-handle to a seated row machine and select the appropriate weight.
2. Sit down and grab the handle with both hands.
3. Place your feet on the platform and sit back. Maintain a slight bend in your knees.
4. Retract your shoulder blades and engage your abs. Keep your torso upright, and don't lean too far back.
5. Take a deep breath and pull the handle to your stomach in one fluid motion, pausing briefly and exhaling.
6. Slowly extend your arms as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在坐姿划船器械上挂上 V 形把手并选择合适的重量。
2. 坐下，双手握住把手。
3. 双脚踩在踏板上并向后坐稳。保持膝盖微屈。
4. 肩胛后收，收紧腹部。保持躯干直立，不要过度后倾。
5. 深吸气，一次流畅地将把手拉向腹部，稍作停顿并呼气。
6. 缓慢伸直手臂，同时吸气。

exercises.title: Seated Calf Raise
exercises.how_to:
1. Load the machine, sit down, and adjust the pad. Your thighs should fit snugly, allowing you to unrack the weight by extending your ankles.
2. Position your thighs against the pad and grab the handles firmly.
3. Take a breath and unrack the weight by flexing your calves.
4. Put the safety bar to the side and flex your ankles to lower the weight until you feel a stretch in your calves.
5. Press through the balls of your feet and flex your calves, exhaling near the top.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 给器械加好重量，坐下并调整护垫。大腿应被贴合固定，使你能通过伸展踝关节将重量解锁。
2. 将大腿抵住护垫，握紧把手。
3. 吸气，收缩小腿将重量解锁。
4. 将安全杆移到一侧，屈踝下放重量，直到感到小腿有拉伸感。
5. 用前脚掌发力蹬起并收缩小腿，接近顶端时呼气。

exercises.title: Seated Chest Flys (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the same weight on both stacks of a double cable machine.
2. Set both pulleys at the same height––roughly stomach level.
3. Attach handles to both pulleys and position an upright bench facing away and in front of the cable machine.
4. Grab the handles one by one, walk over to the gym bench, and sit down.
5. Extend your arms in front of your body, retract your shoulder blades, inhale, and squeeze your abs.
6. Slowly bring your arms to your sides until you feel a stretch in your chest muscles.
7. Bring your hands together and flex your chest as you exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在双滑轮绳索器械的两侧配重片上选择相同的重量。
2. 将两个滑轮调到相同高度——大约与腹部齐平。
3. 在两个滑轮上挂好把手，将直立凳背对并置于绳索器械前方。
4. 依次拿起把手，走到健身凳前坐下。
5. 双臂在身前伸直，肩胛后收，吸气，收紧腹部。
6. 缓慢将手臂向两侧打开，直到感到胸肌有拉伸感。
7. 双手合拢，收缩胸肌并呼气。

exercises.title: Seated Dip Machine
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load.
2. Sit down and grab the handles to your sides.
3. Plant your feet on the floor, bring your shoulders back, and engage your abs.
4. Take a breath and press the handles down, fully extending your arms and exhaling.
5. Bend your arms as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的重量。
2. 坐下，握住身体两侧的把手。
3. 双脚踩实地面，肩部后收，收紧腹部。
4. 吸气，将把手向下推，完全伸直手臂并呼气。
5. 屈臂还原，同时吸气。

exercises.title: Seated Incline Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Adjust a gym bench to an incline of 65 to 75 degrees.
2. Grab a pair of dumbbells and sit down and back.
3. Have your arms straight and to your sides, with your palms facing one another.
4. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and take a breath.
5. Curl both dumbbells, rotating your wrists out, and exhale. Lift the weights until your wrists are slightly higher than your elbows. Your palms should face the ceiling at the top position.
6. Extend your arms slowly as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将健身凳调至 65 至 75 度的上斜角度。
2. 双手各握一只哑铃，向后坐稳。
3. 手臂伸直垂于身体两侧，掌心相对。
4. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，吸气。
5. 弯举两只哑铃，同时向外旋转手腕，呼气。上举至手腕略高于肘部。在顶端位置掌心应朝向天花板。
6. 缓慢伸直手臂，同时吸气。

exercises.title: Seated Incline Hammer Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.title_zh: 坐姿上斜哑铃锤式弯举
exercises.how_to:
1. Adjust a gym bench to an incline of 65 to 75 degrees.
2. Grab a pair of dumbbells and sit down and back.
3. Have your arms straight and to your sides, with your palms facing one another.
4. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and take a breath.
5. While maintaining a neutral wrist position, curl both dumbbells and exhale at the top. Lift the weights until your wrists are slightly higher than your elbows.
6. Extend your arms slowly as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将健身凳调至 65 至 75 度的上斜角度。
2. 双手各握一只哑铃，向后坐稳。
3. 手臂伸直垂于身体两侧，掌心相对。
4. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，吸气。
5. 保持手腕中立位，弯举两只哑铃，在顶端呼气。上举至手腕略高于肘部。
6. 缓慢伸直手臂，同时吸气。

exercises.title: Seated Lateral Raise (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of light dumbbells and sit at the edge of a flat gym bench.
2. Hold a dumbbell in each hand, have your arms at your sides, and bring your palms to a neutral position (facing your body).
3. Bring your shoulders back and engage your abs.
4. Inhale and raise the dumbbells to your sides until they are at shoulder level. Breathe out.
5. Slowly lower the weights to your sides as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双手各握一只轻哑铃，坐在平板健身凳边缘。
2. 双手各持一只哑铃，手臂垂于身体两侧，掌心转为中立位（朝向身体）。
3. 肩部后收，收紧腹部。
4. 吸气，将哑铃向两侧举起至与肩同高。呼气。
5. 缓慢将哑铃放回身体两侧，同时吸气。

exercises.title: Seated Leg Curl (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load.
2. Adjust the pad position. It should be against your Achilles' heels as you sit down.
3. Sit down, position the back of your lower legs against the pad, and grab the handles at your sides.
4. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and inhale.
5. Bend your knees by contracting your hamstrings and breathe out.
6. Hold for a moment and slowly extend your knees as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的重量。
2. 调整护垫位置。坐下时护垫应抵住脚踝跟腱处。
3. 坐下，将小腿后侧抵住护垫，握住身体两侧的把手。
4. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，吸气。
5. 收缩腘绳肌弯曲膝盖并呼气。
6. 稍作停顿，缓慢伸直膝盖，同时吸气。

exercises.title: Seated Overhead Press (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Position an upright gym bench inside a squat rack.
2. Place the barbell on the rack and sit on the bench. You should be able to reach and unrack the barbell while seated and with your arms slightly bent.
3. Plant your feet on the floor.
4. Reach up and grab the barbell with an even overhand grip (palms facing forward). Your hands should be roughly shoulder-width apart.
5. Engage your abs, take a breath, and carefully unrack the bar.
6. Bring the bar to your chest, lean back into the bench, and bring your chest out.
7. Take another breath and press the bar overhead, exhaling as you reach the top.
8. Lower the bar to collarbone level as you breathe in. Your elbows should be slightly lower than your shoulders at the bottom position.
9. Press the barbell again.
10. Once finished, carefully rack the bar.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将直立健身凳放入深蹲架内。
2. 将杠铃放在架上并坐在凳上。坐姿下手臂微屈时应能触及并取下杠铃。
3. 双脚踩实地面。
4. 向上伸手，用均匀的正握（掌心向前）握住杠铃。双手约与肩同宽。
5. 收紧腹部，吸气，小心取下杠铃。
6. 将杠铃放至胸前，向后靠住凳背，挺起胸部。
7. 再次吸气，将杠铃推举过头，到顶端时呼气。
8. 将杠铃下放至锁骨高度，同时吸气。在底部位置肘部应略低于肩部。
9. 再次推举杠铃。
10. 完成后，小心将杠铃放回架上。

exercises.title: Seated Overhead Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells and sit on a flat gym bench or plyo box.
2. Place the weights on your thighs, bring your shoulders back, and engage your abs.
3. In one motion, thrust the weights and position them to your sides.
4. Take a breath and press the dumbbells overhead, tapping them at the top as you exhale.
5. Slowly lower the dumbbells until your elbows are slightly lower than your shoulders, breathing in on the way down.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双手各握一只哑铃，坐在平板健身凳或跳箱上。
2. 将哑铃放在大腿上，肩部后收，收紧腹部。
3. 一次发力将哑铃上送，置于身体两侧。
4. 吸气，将哑铃推举过头，在顶端轻碰并呼气。
5. 缓慢下放哑铃，直到肘部略低于肩部，下放过程中吸气。

exercises.title: Seated Palms Up Wrist Curl
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of light dumbbells and sit on a flat gym bench.
2. Place your forearms on your thighs with your wrists just in front of your knees.
3. Take a breath and lower the dumbbells by extending your wrists.
4. Immediately lift the weights by flexing your forearm muscles. Hold the top position for a moment and exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双手各握一只轻哑铃，坐在平板健身凳上。
2. 将前臂放在大腿上，手腕位于膝盖前方。
3. 吸气，伸腕下放哑铃。
4. 立即收缩前臂肌肉将哑铃抬起。在顶端稍作停顿并呼气。

exercises.title: Seated Row (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load.
2. Sit down and grab the handles with a neutral grip (hands facing one another).
3. Bring your shoulders back and engage your abs.
4. Take a breath and pull the handles simultaneously.
5. Squeeze your back as you breathe out.
6. Extend your arms slowly and breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的重量。
2. 坐下，用对握（双手相对）握住把手。
3. 肩部后收，收紧腹部。
4. 吸气，同时拉动把手。
5. 收紧背部并呼气。
6. 缓慢伸直手臂并吸气。

exercises.title: Seated Shoulder Press (Machine)
exercises.title_zh: 坐姿固定器械肩部推举
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load.
2. Sit down and bring your shoulder blades into the back support.
3. Plant your feet flat on the floor.
4. Grab the handles to your sides and keep your palms facing forward.
5. Take a breath and engage your abs.
6. Press the weight straight up until your arms are fully extended. Breathe out at the top.
7. Lower the weight to the starting position and breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的重量。
2. 坐下，将肩胛贴住靠背。
3. 双脚平放踩实地面。
4. 握住身体两侧的把手，掌心保持向前。
5. 吸气，收紧腹部。
6. 将重量垂直向上推，直到手臂完全伸直。在顶端呼气。
7. 将重量放回起始位置并吸气。

exercises.title: Seated Triceps Press
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the appropriate weight and sit down.
2. Grab the handles at your sides with a comfortable grip.
3. Bring your shoulders back, take a breath, and squeeze your abs.
4. Push the handles down until your elbows lock out and breathe out.
5. Slowly bend your arms as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 设置合适的重量并坐下。
2. 以舒适的握法握住身体两侧的把手。
3. 肩部后收，吸气，收紧腹部。
4. 将把手向下推，直到肘部锁定并呼气。
5. 缓慢屈臂还原，同时吸气。

exercises.title: Seated Wrist Curl (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a straight bar with an underhand grip (palms facing forward) and sit on a flat gym bench.
2. Widen your foot stance and place your elbows and forearms flat on the bench with your wrists at the edge.
3. Breathe in and curl your wrists to raise the bar in one fluid motion.
4. Pause briefly at the top as you exhale.
5. Slowly lower the bar as you breathe in.
6. Repeat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 用反握（掌心向前）握住直杆，坐在平板健身凳上。
2. 双脚分开，将肘部和前臂平放在凳上，手腕位于凳边。
3. 吸气，屈腕一次流畅地将杠铃抬起。
4. 在顶端稍作停顿并呼气。
5. 缓慢下放杠铃，同时吸气。
6. 重复。

exercises.title: Seated Wrist Extension (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a loaded bar with an overhand grip (palms facing your body).
2. Sit on the edge of a flat gym bench and plant your feet on the floor.
3. Position your forearms on top of your thighs with your wrists in front of your knees.
4. Take a breath and lower the barbell in front of your knees by flexing your wrists.
5. Lift the bar by extending your wrists and exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 用正握（掌心朝向身体）握住加好重量的杠铃。
2. 坐在平板健身凳边缘，双脚踩实地面。
3. 将前臂放在大腿上，手腕位于膝盖前方。
4. 吸气，屈腕将杠铃下放至膝盖前方。
5. 伸腕将杠铃抬起并呼气。

exercises.title: Shoulder Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set an adjustable gym bench at a close to 90-degree angle (almost upright back support).
2. Grab a pair of dumbbells and sit down.
3. Place the weights on top of your thighs.
4. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and take a breath.
5. Lift the dumbbells and kick them up with your thighs.
6. Position the weights to your sides.
7. Take another breath and press the dumbbells up and in, tapping them at the top as you exhale.
8. Lower the dumbbells until your elbows are slightly lower than your shoulders, breathing in on the way down.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将可调健身凳调至接近 90 度（靠背几乎直立）。
2. 双手各握一只哑铃，坐下。
3. 将哑铃放在大腿上方。
4. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，吸气。
5. 用大腿将哑铃向上顶起。
6. 将哑铃置于身体两侧。
7. 再次吸气，将哑铃向上向内推起，在顶端轻碰并呼气。
8. 下放哑铃直到肘部略低于肩部，下放过程中吸气。

exercises.title: Shoulder Press (Machine Plates)
exercises.how_to:
1. Add the appropriate amount of weight to the machine, ensuring it’s equal on both sides.
2. Adjust the seat height. Your elbows should be slightly lower than your shoulders as you grab the handles when you sit down.
3. Sit down and grab the handles.
4. Lean back and retract your shoulder blades.
5. Take a deep breath and engage your abs.
6. Press the weight up in one fluid motion and exhale at the top.
7. Slowly lower the weight as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 给器械加上合适的重量，确保两侧相同。
2. 调整座椅高度。坐下握住把手时，肘部应略低于肩部。
3. 坐下并握住把手。
4. 向后靠，肩胛后收。
5. 深吸气，收紧腹部。
6. 一次流畅地将重量向上推起，在顶端呼气。
7. 缓慢下放重量，同时吸气。

exercises.title: Shoulder Taps
exercises.how_to:
1. Get down on your hands and knees.
2. Extend your legs and support your lower body on your toes.
3. Plant your hands flat on the floor at roughly shoulder-width distance.
4. Engage your abs to straighten your body and retract your shoulder blades.
5. Inhale and descend by bending your elbows. Go down as much as possible and press through your palms to move to the top.
6. Immediately lift your left hand off the floor and tap your right shoulder as you exhale.
7. Bring the hand to the floor and do another push-up as you breathe in on the way down.
8. Lift your right hand to tap your left shoulder.
9. Keep alternating.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双手双膝跪地。
2. 双腿向后伸直，用脚尖支撑下半身。
3. 双手平放地面，约与肩同宽。
4. 收紧腹部使身体成一条直线，肩胛后收。
5. 吸气，屈肘下降。尽量下放，然后用手掌撑起回到顶端。
6. 立即抬起左手离开地面，触碰右肩并呼气。
7. 将手放回地面，再做一次俯卧撑，下放过程中吸气。
8. 抬起右手触碰左肩。
9. 持续交替进行。

exercises.title: Shrug (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a barbell with an overhand grip (palms facing back). Your hands should be just outside your thighs.
