2. Straighten your arms, engage your abs, and retract your shoulder blades.
3. Take a breath and shrug the barbell by elevating your shoulders, exhaling at the top. Imagine that you’re trying to touch your ears with your trapezius.
4. Lower your shoulder blades as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 用正握（掌心向后）握住杠铃。双手应位于大腿外侧。
2. 手臂伸直，收紧腹部，肩胛后收。
3. 吸气，上提肩部做耸肩，在顶端呼气。想象用斜方肌去触碰耳朵。
4. 下放肩胛，同时吸气。

exercises.title: Shrug (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the pulley to the lowest position and attach a straight bar.
2. Select the appropriate weight.
3. Lean forward and grab the straight bar with an overhand grip (palms facing your body).
4. Stand up and step back to lift the weight off its stack.
5. Bring your shoulders back, squeeze your glutes, and engage your abs.
6. Take a breath and shrug, lifting your shoulder blades. Exhale at the top.
7. Slowly lower your shoulder blades as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将滑轮调至最低位置并挂上直杆。
2. 选择合适的重量。
3. 前倾，用正握（掌心朝向身体）握住直杆。
4. 站起并后撤一步，将配重从配重片中拉起。
5. 肩部后收，夹紧臀部，收紧腹部。
6. 吸气，上提肩胛做耸肩。在顶端呼气。
7. 缓慢下放肩胛，同时吸气。

exercises.title: Shrug (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells, stand tall, position your arms to your sides, and have your wrists neutral.
2. Bring your shoulders back and engage your abs.
3. Take a breath, shrug your shoulders as high as possible, and squeeze your trapezius muscle at the top. Keep your arms straight.
4. Exhale at the top and lower your shoulder blades to the starting position as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双手各握一只哑铃，站直，手臂垂于身体两侧，手腕保持中立。
2. 肩部后收，收紧腹部。
3. 吸气，尽量向上耸肩，在顶端收紧斜方肌。手臂保持伸直。
4. 在顶端呼气，将肩胛放回起始位置，同时吸气。

exercises.title: Shrug (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Add the appropriate load to the machine.
2. Stand between the handles, grab them, and stand tall.
3. With your arms straight and at your sides, take a deep breath and engage your abs.
4. Shrug your shoulders up in one fluid motion, exhaling at the top. Don’t bend your elbows.
5. Lower your shoulder blades as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 给器械加上合适的重量。
2. 站在把手之间，握住把手并站直。
3. 手臂伸直垂于身体两侧，深吸气并收紧腹部。
4. 一次流畅地向上耸肩，在顶端呼气。不要屈肘。
5. 下放肩胛，同时吸气。

exercises.title: Shrug (Smith Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Position the Smith machine bar at hip height and add weight.
2. Face away from the bar and grab it with an overhand grip (palms facing back).
3. Engage your abs and take a breath.
4. Rotate the bar to unrack it.
5. Shrug your shoulders as high as possible and squeeze your traps at the top as you breathe out.
6. Lower your shoulder blades and breathe in.
7. Once finished, rotate the bar to rack it on the Smith machine.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将史密斯机杠铃调至髋部高度并加好重量。
2. 背对杠铃，用正握（掌心向后）握住杠铃。
3. 收紧腹部，吸气。
4. 旋转杠铃将其解锁。
5. 尽量向上耸肩，在顶端收紧斜方肌并呼气。
6. 下放肩胛并吸气。
7. 完成后，旋转杠铃将其挂回史密斯机。

exercises.title: Side Bend
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand sideways on a back hyperextension machine. Your right upper thigh should be against the pad, and your feet should be secure.
2. Engage your abs and place your hands behind your head.
3. Take a breath and bend your torso to the right.
4. Squeeze your obliques to bend your torso to the left and exhale.
5. Once finished, rotate your body 180 degrees and do the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 侧身站在下背伸展器械上。右大腿上部应抵住护垫，双脚固定牢靠。
2. 收紧腹部，双手置于脑后。
3. 吸气，将躯干向右侧屈。
4. 收缩腹斜肌将躯干向左侧屈并呼气。
5. 完成后，身体旋转 180 度，做相同次数的动作。

exercises.title: Side Bend (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a dumbbell with your right hand and stand tall with your arm to your side. Place your left hand behind your head.
2. Engage your abs and bring your shoulders back.
3. Take a breath and crunch your torso to the left. Exhale.
4. Extend your torso and breathe in.
5. Crunch again.
6. Once finished, grab the dumbbell with the opposite hand and do the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 右手握住哑铃，手臂垂于体侧站直。左手置于脑后。
2. 收紧腹部，肩部后收。
3. 吸气，将躯干向左侧屈。呼气。
4. 伸直躯干并吸气。
5. 再次侧屈。
6. 完成后，换另一只手握住哑铃，做相同次数的动作。

exercises.title: Side Plank
exercises.how_to:
1. Lie on your left side.
2. Place your left forearm on the floor for balance.
3. Stack your legs and bring one foot over the other.
4. Take a breath and engage your midsection to lift your hips off the floor.
5. Hold the position for 30 to 60 seconds and relax.
6. Turn to your other side and hold the same position.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 向左侧卧。
2. 左前臂撑地保持平衡。
3. 双腿叠放，一只脚放在另一只脚上。
4. 吸气，收紧核心将髋部抬离地面。
5. 保持该姿势 30 至 60 秒，然后放松。
6. 转向另一侧，保持同样的姿势。

exercises.title: Single Arm Cable Crossover
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the pulley at chest height and attach a handle.
2. Select the appropriate load.
3. Grab the handle, step away from the machine, and turn your side to it. The cable pulley should be to your side and slightly behind your body.
4. Bring your shoulders back, breathe in, and engage your abs.
5. With your arm slightly bent and to the side, bring the cable in front of your torso. Squeeze your chest and exhale.
6. Slowly bring your arm to the side and breathe in.
7. Once finished, grab the handle with your other hand, have the pulley at your side and slightly behind your body, and do the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将滑轮调至胸部高度，装上把手。
2. 选择合适的重量。
3. 握住把手，离开器械，侧身面对器械。滑轮应位于身体侧面并略靠后。
4. 肩部后收，吸气，收紧腹部。
5. 手臂微屈置于体侧，将绳索拉至躯干前方。挤压胸肌并呼气。
6. 缓慢将手臂移回体侧并吸气。
7. 完成后换另一只手握住把手，让滑轮位于身体侧面并略靠后，做相同的次数。

exercises.title: Single Arm Cable Row
exercises.how_to:
1. Set a cable pulley in a low position or at chest level and attach a handle.
2. Select the appropriate load, grab the handle, and step back to lift the weight off its stack.
3. Bring your shoulders back, stagger your stance, bend your knees slightly, engage your abs, and breathe in.
4. Pull the handle to your side, aligning your elbow to your torso. Squeeze your back and hold the position for a moment and exhale.
5. Slowly extend your arm and breathe in.
6. Once you have finished training one side, grab the handle with your opposite hand and repeat for the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将绳索滑轮调至低位或胸部高度，装上把手。
2. 选择合适的重量，握住把手，后退一步将重量从配重片中提起。
3. 肩部后收，双脚前后站位，膝盖微屈，收紧腹部并吸气。
4. 将把手拉向体侧，肘部与躯干对齐。挤压背部并短暂停留，呼气。
5. 缓慢伸直手臂并吸气。
6. 一侧训练完成后，换另一只手握住把手，做相同的次数。

exercises.title: Single Arm Curl (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate weight, set the pulley to the lowest position, and attach a handle.
2. Grab the handle with your right hand and position the palm up.
3. Take a step back, inhale, and squeeze your abs.
4. Curl the weight and squeeze your bicep at the top momentarily as you exhale.
5. Slowly extend your arm as you breathe in.
6. Once finished, grab the handle with your left hand and repeat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的重量，将滑轮调至最低位，装上把手。
2. 用右手握住把手，掌心朝上。
3. 后退一步，吸气，收紧腹部。
4. 弯举重量，在顶端短暂挤压肱二头肌并呼气。
5. 缓慢伸直手臂并吸气。
6. 完成后换左手握住把手，重复动作。

exercises.title: Single Arm Landmine Press (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Anchor one end of a barbell on a landmine attachment.
2. Add a weight plate on the opposite barbell sleeve.
3. Lean forward and grab the loaded side with both hands.
4. Carefully lift the bar to chest level and stand tall.
5. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and raise your left arm to your side.
6. Take a breath and press the bar forward and up until your arm is straight. Exhale at the top.
7. Slowly lower the bar to your upper chest as you breathe in.
8. Once finished training one side, grab the bar with your left hand and do the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将杠铃一端固定在地雷管底座上。
2. 在杠铃另一端加上杠铃片。
3. 身体前倾，双手握住装片的一侧。
4. 小心将杠铃抬至胸部高度并站直。
5. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，将左臂抬至体侧。
6. 吸气，将杠铃向前上方推起，直至手臂伸直。在顶端呼气。
7. 缓慢将杠铃放回上胸位置并吸气。
8. 一侧训练完成后，换左手握住杠铃，做相同的次数。

exercises.title: Single Arm Lat Pulldown
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate weight and attach a handle to the pulley.
2. Adjust the knee pad to a height where your thighs fit snugly underneath.
3. Stand tall, reach up, and grab the handle with one hand.
4. Sit down and secure your thighs underneath the pad.
5. With your arm straight, retract your shoulder blades, engage your midsection, and inhale.
6. Pull the cable down and in until you feel a contraction on your back. Keep your elbow in line with your torso and close to your body.
7. Hold for a moment as you exhale.
8. Slowly extend your arm as you breathe in before the next rep.
9. Once finished, stand tall, grab the handle with your other hand, and do the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的重量，在滑轮上装上把手。
2. 调整膝垫高度，使大腿刚好紧贴其下。
3. 站直，向上伸展，单手握住把手。
4. 坐下，将大腿固定在膝垫下方。
5. 手臂伸直，肩胛骨后收，收紧核心并吸气。
6. 将绳索向下向内拉，直到感觉背部收缩。保持肘部与躯干在同一直线上并贴近身体。
7. 短暂停留并呼气。
8. 缓慢伸直手臂并吸气，准备下一次动作。
9. 完成后站起，换另一只手握住把手，做相同的次数。

exercises.title: Single Arm Lateral Raise (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load, set the pulley to the lowest position, and attach a handle.
2. Stand with your left side facing the cable attachment and grab the handle with your right hand.
3. Take a lateral step away to lift the weight off its stack and maintain a slight bend in your right arm.
4. Breathe in, engage your abs, and lift your arm to the side until the wrist and elbow align with your shoulder. Exhale at the top.
5. Slowly lower your arm as you breathe in.
6. Once finished training one side, turn your body 180 degrees, grab the handle with your left hand, and repeat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的重量，将滑轮调至最低位，装上把手。
2. 左侧朝向绳索接口站立，用右手握住把手。
3. 向侧面迈一步将重量从配重片中提起，右臂保持微屈。
4. 吸气，收紧腹部，将手臂向侧面抬起，直至手腕和肘部与肩部齐平。在顶端呼气。
5. 缓慢放下手臂并吸气。
6. 一侧训练完成后，身体转体 180 度，换左手握住把手，重复动作。

exercises.title: Single Arm Tricep Extension (Dumbbell)
exercises.title_zh: 哑铃单臂肱三头肌屈伸
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a dumbbell and sit on a flat gym bench or chair.
2. Lift the weight overhead and straighten your arm.
3. Bring your shoulders back, engage your midsection, and inhale.
4. Lower the dumbbell behind your head while keeping your elbow steady.
5. Bend your arm until you feel a stretch in your tricep, and extend your elbow as you exhale.
6. Once finished, grab the weight with your other hand, and do the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿起一只哑铃，坐在平板凳或椅子上。
2. 将重量举过头顶并伸直手臂。
3. 肩部后收，收紧核心并吸气。
4. 保持肘部稳定，将哑铃放至头后。
5. 屈臂直至感觉肱三头肌被拉伸，呼气时伸直肘部。
6. 完成后换另一只手握住哑铃，做相同的次数。

exercises.title: Single Arm Triceps Pushdown (Cable)
exercises.title_zh: 绳索单臂肱三头肌下压
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load, set the pulley to the highest position, and attach a rope.
2. Grab the rope with your right hand, position your elbow to your side, and step back.
3. Grab the cable machine's pillar with your left hand, take a deep breath, and engage your abs.
4. Slowly extend your arm and flex your triceps as you exhale.
5. Bend your arm as you breathe in.
6. Once finished, grab the rope with your left hand and repeat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的重量，将滑轮调至最高位，装上绳索。
2. 用右手握住绳索，肘部置于体侧，后退一步。
3. 左手扶住绳索器械的立柱，深吸气，收紧腹部。
4. 缓慢伸直手臂并在呼气时收紧肱三头肌。
5. 吸气时屈臂。
6. 完成后换左手握住绳索，重复动作。

exercises.title: Single Leg Extensions
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load on a leg extension machine.
2. Set the pad to be just over your feet as you sit down.
3. Adjust the back support to have your knees just in front of the edge of the seat.
4. Sit down, position one leg against the pad, grab the handles to your sides, bring your shoulders back, and inhale.
5. Extend your leg fully and exhale.
6. Bend the leg as you inhale.
7. Once finished training one side, position your opposite shin against the pad, and do the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在腿屈伸器械上选择合适的重量。
2. 坐下时调整靠垫，使其刚好位于脚部上方。
3. 调整靠背，使膝盖位于坐垫边缘前方。
4. 坐下，将一条腿抵住靠垫，双手握住身体两侧的把手，肩部后收并吸气。
5. 完全伸直腿并呼气。
6. 吸气时屈腿。
7. 一侧训练完成后，换另一条小腿抵住靠垫，做相同的次数。

exercises.title: Single Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.how_to:
1. Place an exercise mat and lie down with your arms to your sides and hands flat on the floor.
2. Bend your knees and place your feet flat on the floor.
3. Raise one leg in the air.
4. Take a breath and press through the heel of your planted foot, engaging your posterior chain to drive your hips toward the ceiling.
5. Extend your hips until they align with your knee and shoulders, and exhale at the top.
6. Lower your buttocks to the floor, breathing in on the way down.
7. Switch feet position and do the same number of reps for your opposite side.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 铺好瑜伽垫，仰卧，双臂置于体侧，手掌平贴地面。
2. 屈膝，双脚平放在地面上。
3. 将一条腿抬起悬空。
4. 吸气，通过支撑脚的脚跟发力，收紧后侧链，将髋部向上顶向天花板。
5. 伸展髋部直至与膝盖和肩部成一直线，在顶端呼气。
6. 将臀部放回地面，下落时吸气。
7. 交换双腿位置，另一侧做相同的次数。

exercises.title: Single Leg Hip Thrust
exercises.how_to:
1. Sit on the floor with your back against a flat gym bench.
2. Bring your arms to your sides and place them flat on the gym bench.
3. Bend your knees and have your feet flat on the floor.
4. Lift one foot off the floor, take a breath, and engage your abs.
5. Press through your other foot and extend your hips until they align with your torso. Breathe out.
6. Lower your buttocks to the floor as you breathe in.
7. Once finished, plant the opposite foot on the floor and do the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 坐在地面上，上背靠住平板凳。
2. 双臂置于体侧，平放在平板凳上。
3. 屈膝，双脚平放在地面上。
4. 将一只脚抬离地面，吸气，收紧腹部。
5. 通过另一只脚发力，伸展髋部直至与躯干成一直线。呼气。
6. 吸气时将臀部放回地面。
7. 完成后换另一只脚踩地，做相同的次数。

exercises.title: Single Leg Hip Thrust (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Place a dumbbell next to a flat gym bench.
2. Sit on the floor, position your upper back against the bench's edge, grab the weight, and place it over your hips.
3. Bend your right knee and plant the foot on the floor. Keep your left leg straight.
4. Take a deep breath, engage your abs, and push through your right heel to drive your hips toward the ceiling. Hold the dumbbell with both hands for safety.
5. Pause briefly at the top as you exhale.
6. Lower your buttocks to the floor as you breathe in.
7. Repeat.
8. Once finished training your right side, plant your left foot on the floor and extend your right leg. Repeat for the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将一只哑铃放在平板凳旁。
2. 坐在地面上，上背抵住凳子边缘，拿起哑铃并置于髋部上方。
3. 屈右膝，右脚踩地。左腿保持伸直。
4. 深吸气，收紧腹部，通过右脚跟发力将髋部顶向天花板。为安全起见，双手握住哑铃。
5. 在顶端短暂停留并呼气。
6. 吸气时将臀部放回地面。
7. 重复。
8. 右侧训练完成后，左脚踩地并伸直右腿。做相同的次数。

exercises.title: Single Leg Press (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the appropriate load on the machine and sit down.
2. Place one foot flat on the platform and grab the handles to your sides. Keep your other foot on the floor.
3. Engage your abs and take a breath.
4. Extend your leg and remove the safety.
5. Slowly bend your knee, bringing yourself close to the platform as you breathe in.
6. Press through your heel and extend your leg as you exhale.
7. Once finished training one leg, place the opposite foot on the platform and do the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在器械上设置合适的重量并坐下。
2. 一只脚平踩在踏板上，双手握住身体两侧的把手。另一只脚放在地面上。
3. 收紧腹部并吸气。
4. 伸直腿并取下安全锁。
5. 缓慢屈膝，吸气时将身体靠近踏板。
6. 通过脚跟发力，呼气时伸直腿。
7. 一条腿训练完成后，换另一只脚踩上踏板，做相同的次数。

exercises.title: Single Leg Romanian Deadlift (Barbell)
exercises.title_zh: 杠铃单腿罗马尼亚硬拉
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a barbell with a double overhand grip (palms facing back). Your hands should be shoulder-width apart.
2. Stand tall with your feet close, back straight, shoulders back, and abs engaged.
3. Take a breath and lean forward by hinging at the hip. Simultaneously raise your right foot off the floor, bringing the right leg back for balance.
4. Lean forward until you feel a stretch in your left hamstring. Lower the barbell in a straight line, keeping it close to your body.
5. Straighten your body and bring your right leg forward as you exhale.
6. Take another breath and repeat.
7. Once finished training one side, do the same number of reps by raising your left foot and extending the leg back.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 用双手正握握住杠铃（掌心朝后）。双手与肩同宽。
2. 站直，双脚并拢，背部挺直，肩部后收，收紧腹部。
3. 吸气，以髋部为轴向前俯身。同时将右脚抬离地面，右腿向后伸展以保持平衡。
4. 向前俯身直至感觉左腿腘绳肌被拉伸。杠铃沿直线下降，始终贴近身体。
5. 呼气时挺直身体，将右腿收回前方。
6. 再次吸气并重复。
7. 一侧训练完成后，抬起左脚并将腿向后伸展，做相同的次数。

exercises.title: Single Leg Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
exercises.title_zh: 哑铃单腿罗马尼亚硬拉
exercises.how_to:
1. Hold a dumbbell in one hand and position it in front of your upper thigh.
2. Raise your right foot off the floor and support yourself on the left.
3. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and breathe in.
4. Slowly lean your torso forward by hinging at the hips. Allow your right leg to move behind your body for balance.
5. Lean forward until you feel a stretch at the back of your left thigh.
6. Straighten your body, squeeze your glutes, and exhale.
7. Once finished, plant your right foot on the floor, lift your left one in the air, and do the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 一只手握住哑铃，置于大腿前侧。
2. 将右脚抬离地面，用左脚支撑身体。
3. 肩部后收，收紧腹部并吸气。
4. 以髋部为轴缓慢向前俯身。让右腿向后移动以保持平衡。
5. 向前俯身直至感觉左大腿后侧被拉伸。
6. 挺直身体，收紧臀部并呼气。
7. 完成后右脚踩地，抬起左脚，做相同的次数。

exercises.title: Single Leg Standing Calf Raise
exercises.how_to:
1. Place the ball of your right foot on an elevated platform and grab onto something for balance.
2. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and straighten your right leg.
3. Take a breath and lower your heel to the floor by flexing your ankle.
4. Move down until you feel a stretch in your calve and press through your heel to extend your ankle.
5. Squeeze your calf at the top and exhale.
6. Once finished, place the ball of your opposite foot on the platform and do the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将右脚前脚掌踩在垫高的平台上，并抓住固定物保持平衡。
2. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，伸直右腿。
3. 吸气，屈踝将脚跟向下放至地面。
4. 下放至感觉小腿被拉伸，再通过脚跟发力伸展踝关节。
5. 在顶端挤压小腿并呼气。
6. 完成后换另一只脚的前脚掌踩上平台，做相同的次数。

exercises.title: Single Leg Standing Calf Raise (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Place a loaded barbell on your back, similar to how you would for the squat.
2. Position the ball of one foot on an elevated platform. Keep your other foot on the platform for balance.
3. Bring your shoulders back, flex your abs, and take a breath.
4. Extend your ankle, squeezing your calve muscle at the top. Breathe out.
5. Flex your ankle to lower yourself to the starting position as you breathe in.
6. Once finished, position the ball of your other foot on the platform and repeat for the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将负重的杠铃置于上背，方式与深蹲相同。
2. 将一只脚的前脚掌踩在垫高的平台上，另一只脚留在平台上以保持平衡。
3. 肩部后收，收紧腹部并吸气。
4. 伸展踝关节，在顶端挤压小腿肌肉。呼气。
5. 吸气时屈踝下放回起始位置。
6. 完成后换另一只脚的前脚掌踩上平台，重复做相同的次数。

exercises.title: Single Leg Standing Calf Raise (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Hold a dumbbell in your left hand and place the ball of your right foot on an elevated platform. Keep your left foot in the air.
2. Grab onto something for balance with your right hand.
3. Engage your abs, take a breath, and straighten your right leg.
4. Press through the ball of your foot to elevate yourself and squeeze your calf as you breathe out.
5. Slowly lower your body by flexing your ankle and breathe in. You should feel a stretch in your calves.
6. Repeat.
7. Once finished, place the ball of your left foot on the platform and do the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 左手握住一只哑铃，将右脚前脚掌踩在垫高的平台上。左脚保持悬空。
2. 右手抓住固定物保持平衡。
3. 收紧腹部，吸气，伸直右腿。
4. 通过前脚掌发力将身体抬起，呼气时挤压小腿。
5. 屈踝缓慢下放身体并吸气。应感觉小腿被拉伸。
6. 重复。
7. 完成后换左脚前脚掌踩上平台，做相同的次数。

exercises.title: Single Leg Standing Calf Raise (Machine)
exercises.title_zh: 单腿站姿固定器械提踵
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load on the machine.
2. Place the ball of your right foot on the platform and position your shoulders against the pads. Keep your leg straight.
3. Grab the handles for support, engage your abs, and take a breath.
4. Push through the ball of your foot to extend your ankle and squeeze your calve muscle as you breathe out.
5. Slowly lower your ankle to the floor, stretching your calf. Breathe in on the way down.
6. Once finished training your right calve, place your left foot on the platform and repeat for the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在器械上选择合适的重量。
2. 将右脚前脚掌踩在踏板上，肩部抵住靠垫。保持腿伸直。
3. 握住把手支撑，收紧腹部并吸气。
4. 通过前脚掌发力伸展踝关节，呼气时挤压小腿肌肉。
5. 缓慢下放踝关节，拉伸小腿。下落时吸气。
6. 右小腿训练完成后，换左脚踩上踏板，重复做相同的次数。

exercises.title: Sissy Squat (Weighted)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a weight plate, lift it in front of your chest, and hold it with one arm.
2. Stand before a gym bench or another object you can hold onto for balance.
3. Grab the object for support.
4. Have your feet a few inches apart, engage your abs, and take a breath.
5. Descend into a squat while simultaneously leaning your torso back.
6. As you move down, allow your heels to lift off the floor and support yourself on the balls of your feet.
7. Go down as much as possible, feeling your quadriceps stretch.
8. Engage your quadriceps to straighten your legs and stand tall. Exhale near the top.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿起一片杠铃片，举至胸前，用单臂托住。
2. 站在健身凳或其他可扶持的物体前。
3. 抓住物体以保持支撑。
4. 双脚间距几英寸，收紧腹部并吸气。
5. 下蹲的同时将躯干向后倾。
6. 下蹲过程中让脚跟抬离地面，用前脚掌支撑身体。
7. 尽可能下蹲，感受股四头肌被拉伸。
8. 收紧股四头肌伸直双腿并站起。在接近顶端时呼气。

exercises.title: Sit Up
exercises.how_to:
1. Place an exercise mat on the floor and lie on it.
2. Bend your knees and plant your feet flat on the floor.
3. Position your hands in front of your face or behind your head.
4. Take a breath and crunch your torso by engaging your abs, lifting your upper body to an upright position.
5. Breathe out at the top position and slowly lower your torso as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在地面上铺好瑜伽垫并仰卧其上。
2. 屈膝，双脚平放在地面上。
3. 双手置于面部前方或头后。
4. 吸气，收紧腹部卷起躯干，将上身抬至坐直位置。
5. 在顶端呼气，并在吸气时缓慢放下躯干。

exercises.title: Sit Up (Weighted)
exercises.how_to:
1. Place a dumbbell or weight plate on the floor and lie next to it.
2. Bend your knees and plant your feet flat on the floor.
3. Grab the weight and position it over your chest.
4. Take a breath and crunch your torso by engaging your abs, lifting your torso to an upright position. Exhale.
5. Hold for a moment and lower your torso slowly as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将一只哑铃或杠铃片放在地面上，躺在旁边。
2. 屈膝，双脚平放在地面上。
3. 拿起重量并置于胸前。
4. 吸气，收紧腹部卷起躯干，将上身抬至坐直位置。呼气。
5. 短暂停留，并在吸气时缓慢放下躯干。

exercises.title: Ski Erg
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate resistance, preferably 50-60% of the maximum.
2. Reach up, grab the two handles, and step back slightly to clear enough room for pulling.
3. Position your feet shoulder-width apart or slightly wider.
4. With your elbows bent, breathe in, and initiate the pull by engaging your core and pushing your buttocks back.
5. As you pull on the cables, use the initial momentum by continuing to hinge at the hips, driving the handles down by fully extending your arms, and breathing out.
6. Allow the cables to return to the starting position as you stand up and breathe in for the next rep.
7. Continue breathing, pulling, hinging at the hips, and standing up in a controlled, rhythmic manner.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的阻力，最好为最大阻力的 50-60%。
2. 向上伸展，双手握住两个把手，稍微后退以留出足够的拉动空间。
3. 双脚与肩同宽或略宽。
4. 屈肘，吸气，收紧核心并向后顶髋，开始拉动。
5. 拉动绳索时利用初始惯性，继续以髋部为轴俯身，双臂完全伸展将把手向下压，并呼气。
6. 站立起身时让绳索回到起始位置，并吸气准备下一次动作。
7. 保持呼吸、拉动、俯身和站起的节奏，以可控且有韵律的方式进行。

exercises.title: Skullcrusher (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Load a straight bar, lift it off the floor, and support it in front of your chest.
2. Carefully sit on a flat gym bench and lie back while keeping the bar close to your torso.
3. Extend your arms and bring your shoulders back. Plant your feet on the floor.
4. Take a breath and lower the barbell to your forehead or behind your head.
5. Pause for a moment and extend your arms while keeping your elbows in position. Exhale near the top.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 装上直杆杠铃，将其从地面提起，支撑在胸前。
2. 小心坐到平板凳上，保持杠铃贴近躯干并躺下。
3. 伸直手臂，肩部后收。双脚踩实地面。
4. 吸气，将杠铃下放至额头或头后。
5. 短暂停留，保持肘部位置不变伸直手臂。在接近顶端时呼气。

exercises.title: Skullcrusher (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells and lie on a flat gym bench.
2. Straighten your arms and position the dumbbells over your chest with your wrists neutral (hands facing one another).
3. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and plant your feet flat on the floor.
4. Take a breath and slowly bend your elbows to bring the dumbbells to the sides of your head.
5. Hold the position momentarily and extend your arms by squeezing your triceps. Exhale near the top.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿起一对哑铃，仰卧在平板凳上。
2. 伸直手臂，将哑铃置于胸部上方，手腕保持中立（双手相对）。
3. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，双脚平踩在地面上。
4. 吸气，缓慢屈肘将哑铃下放至头部两侧。
5. 短暂停留，收紧肱三头肌伸直手臂。在接近顶端时呼气。

exercises.title: Sled Pull
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab the rope attached to the sled with both hands.
2. Stand up with your feet hip-width apart.
3. Push your buttocks back and lean slightly forward to maintain a neutral spine position.
4. Pull the rope with your right hand.
5. As your elbow gets to the side of your torso, immediately pull with your left hand and place your right hand further down on the rope, ready for the next pull. To breathe effectively, inhale while switching hands, just before initiating each pull, and exhale as you pull.
6. Keep alternating steadily, switching hands as you pull, and maintain a consistent tempo.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双手握住连接雪橇的绳索。
2. 站直，双脚与髋同宽。
3. 臀部向后顶，身体略微前倾，保持脊柱中立。
4. 用右手拉绳索。
5. 当肘部到达躯干侧面时，立即换左手拉绳，同时右手沿绳索向前下方移动，准备下一次拉动。为有效呼吸，换手时吸气，就在开始每次拉动之前，拉动时呼气。
6. 持续有节奏地交替拉动并换手，保持稳定的节奏。

exercises.title: Sled Push
exercises.how_to:
1. Load a sled with the appropriate amount of weight.
2. Lean forward, grab the two handles, and straighten your arms.
3. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and have the balls of your feet on the ground.
4. Take a breath and press through the balls of your feet to move forward.
5. Move forward slowly, pressing through your feet. Breathe steadily and go for as long as possible.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在雪橇上装载合适重量的配重。
2. 身体前倾，双手握住两个把手并伸直手臂。
3. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，前脚掌着地。
4. 吸气，通过前脚掌发力向前推动。
5. 缓慢向前推进，用脚掌发力。保持平稳呼吸，尽可能坚持更长时间。

exercises.title: Snatch
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand in front of a loaded barbell. Your feet should be underneath the bar, and your shins should be a couple of inches away.
2. Lean forward and grab the bar with a wide snatch grip.
3. Lower your hips, bring your shoulders back to straighten your back, and adjust yourself to the bar. Your knees should extend over the bar.
4. Engage your abs and take a breath.
5. Powerfully drive through your heels as if trying to squat the weight.
6. As the barbell glides close to your body and reaches your hips, press through your heels for a second time, powerfully extending your knees and hips. Simultaneously, pull the bar up in a vertical line.
7. Drop by bending your knees and receive the barbell overhead with your arms straight.
8. Press through your heels to perform an overhead squat and exhale at the top.
9. Lower the barbell to the floor, keeping it close to your body.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站在装好杠铃片的杠铃前。双脚位于杠铃下方，小腿距杠铃约几英寸。
2. 向前俯身，用宽握抓举握法握住杠铃。
3. 降低髋部，肩部后收使背部挺直，身体贴向杠铃。膝盖应位于杠铃上方。
4. 收紧腹部并吸气。
5. 像做深蹲一样，用力通过脚跟向上发力。
6. 当杠铃贴近身体滑行至髋部时，再次通过脚跟发力，有力伸展膝和髋。同时将杠铃沿垂直线向上拉起。
7. 屈膝下蹲，手臂伸直接住过顶的杠铃。
8. 通过脚跟发力完成过头深蹲，在顶端呼气。
9. 将杠铃放回地面，始终贴近身体。

exercises.title: Spider Curl (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the incline of a gym bench at roughly 45 degrees.
2. Position yourself on the bench with your stomach and chest flat against the back support.
3. Reach down and grab the barbell with an even underhand grip (palms facing forward). Alternatively, have someone hand you the bar.
4. Engage your abs and take a breath.
5. Curl the barbell while keeping your elbows stationary.
6. Bend your arms until your wrists are higher than your elbows. Squeeze your biceps and breathe out.
7. Slowly lower the barbell and fully extend your arms as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将健身凳调至约 45 度的上斜角度。
2. 俯卧在凳上，腹部和胸部贴紧靠垫。
3. 向下伸手，用均匀的反握握住杠铃（掌心朝前）。也可以请他人把杠铃递给你。
4. 收紧腹部并吸气。
5. 保持肘部不动，弯举杠铃。
6. 屈臂直至手腕高于肘部。收紧肱二头肌并呼气。
7. 缓慢放下杠铃，吸气时完全伸直手臂。

exercises.title: Spider Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set a gym bench at a 45 to 60-degree incline.
2. Grab a pair of dumbbells and sit on the bench with your chest and stomach against the back support. Your arms should hang down with your palms facing forward.
3. Take a deep breath and curl both dumbbells, not moving your elbows forward. Exhale at the top.
4. Extend your arms as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将健身凳调至 45 至 60 度的上斜角度。
2. 拿起一对哑铃，坐在凳上，胸部和腹部贴紧靠垫。手臂自然下垂，掌心朝前。
3. 深吸气，同时弯举两只哑铃，肘部不要前移。在顶端呼气。
4. 吸气时伸直手臂。

exercises.title: Spiderman
exercises.how_to:
1. Get down on all fours and extend your body in an elbow plank position.
2. Have your forearms flat on the floor, supporting your upper body, and your legs extended with your toes supporting your lower body.
3. Keep your buttocks slightly elevated, back neutral, and abs engaged for support.
4. Take a breath, tuck your right knee to your right elbow, and exhale.
5. Bring your knee back to the starting position as you breathe in.
6. Tuck your left knee to your left elbow.
7. Continue alternating between left and right until you finish the set.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 俯身四点支撑，进入肘撑平板支撑姿势。
2. 前臂平贴地面支撑上半身，双腿伸展，脚尖支撑下半身。
3. 臀部略微抬高，背部保持中立，收紧腹部以支撑。
4. 吸气，将右膝收向右侧肘部，呼气。
5. 吸气时将膝盖收回起始位置。
6. 将左膝收向左侧肘部。
7. 持续左右交替，直至完成该组。

exercises.title: Spinning
exercises.how_to:
1. Adjust the seat height and get on top of the cardio machine.
2. Select the appropriate program and grab the handles.
3. Place your feet flat on the pedals, bring your shoulders back, and direct your gaze forward.
4. Cycle steadily and maintain a steady breath.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 调整座椅高度并坐上动感单车。
2. 选择合适的程序并握住把手。
3. 双脚平踩在踏板上，肩部后收，目光平视前方。
4. 稳定骑行，保持均匀呼吸。

exercises.title: Split Jerk
exercises.how_to:
1. Hold a barbell at neck level with your arms wide.
2. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and have your feet in a comfortable stance.
3. Take a breath and descend a few inches by bending your knees.
4. Push through your heels and immediately thrust the barbell overhead.
5. Immediately split your stance, bringing your dominant leg forward and the non-dominant one back to receive the barbell.
6. Position your feet in line and slowly lower the barbell to neck level as you exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双臂宽握，将杠铃置于颈前锁骨高度。
2. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，双脚处于舒适站距。
3. 吸气，屈膝下蹲几英寸。
4. 通过脚跟发力，随即将杠铃向上推举过头。
5. 立即分腿，将惯用腿向前、非惯用腿向后，接住杠铃。
6. 双脚调整成一条直线，呼气时缓慢将杠铃放回颈前高度。

exercises.title: Split Squat (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells and stand tall.
2. Retract your shoulder blades, engage your abs, and bring your right leg forward, planting the foot flat on the ground.
3. Take a breath and bend your right knee to descend into a split squat.
4. Descend until your back knee taps the floor and press through your front heel to straighten your right leg. Exhale near the top.
5. Once finished training your right leg, bring your left leg forward and do the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿起一对哑铃并站直。
2. 肩胛骨后收，收紧腹部，右脚向前迈出，脚掌平踩地面。
3. 吸气，屈右膝下蹲进入分腿蹲。
4. 下蹲至后膝触地，通过前脚跟发力伸直右腿。在接近顶端时呼气。
5. 右腿训练完成后，换左腿向前，做相同的次数。

exercises.title: Sprints
exercises.how_to: (Hevy provides no How-to steps for this entry.)
exercises.how_to_zh: （Hevy 未提供此动作的分步说明。）

exercises.title: Squat (Band)
exercises.how_to:
1. Take a large looped resistance band and step over it with both feet.
2. Have your feet in a comfortable stance for squatting.
3. Grab the opposite side of the band, raise it overhead, and place it behind your neck.
4. Stand tall, bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and breathe in.
5. Descend until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
6. Hold for a moment and press through your heels to bring yourself to the top. Exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 取一条环状弹力带，双脚踩上去。
2. 双脚调整为舒适的深蹲站距。
3. 握住弹力带的另一端，举过头顶并置于颈后。
4. 站直，肩部后收，收紧腹部并吸气。
5. 下蹲直至大腿与地面平行。
6. 短暂停留，通过脚跟发力回到站姿。呼气。

exercises.title: Squat (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Position the barbell at collarbone height.
2. Grab the bar with an even overhand grip (palms facing down).
3. Tuck yourself underneath the bar and place it on top of your trapezius (upper back).
4. Align your feet, engage your abs, take a breath, and unrack the bar by straightening your legs.
5. Take a couple of careful steps back and bring your feet shoulder-width apart.
6. Bring your shoulders back, inhale, and squat until your thighs are parallel to the floor. Keep your heels in contact with the floor.
7. Hold for a moment and press through your heels to bring yourself back to the top. Exhale near the top.
8. Once finished, move forward and rack the barbell carefully before relaxing your body.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将杠铃设置在锁骨高度。
2. 用均匀的正握握住杠铃（掌心朝下）。
3. 钻到杠铃下方，将杠铃置于斜方肌（上背）上。
4. 调整双脚位置，收紧腹部，吸气，伸直双腿将杠铃从架上取下。
5. 小心后退几步，双脚与肩同宽。
6. 肩部后收，吸气，下蹲直至大腿与地面平行。保持脚跟贴地。
7. 短暂停留，通过脚跟发力回到站姿。在接近顶端时呼气。
8. 完成后向前走，小心将杠铃放回架上，再放松身体。

exercises.title: Squat (Bodyweight)
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand tall with your feet in a comfortable stance, shoulders back, and gaze directed forward.
2. Lift your arms in front of you for balance and take a breath.
3. Squat and keep your heels in contact with the floor.
4. Move down until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
5. Push through your heels to bring yourself to the top and exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站直，双脚自然分开，肩向后收，目视前方。
2. 双臂向前抬起以保持平衡，吸气。
3. 下蹲，保持脚跟贴地。
4. 下蹲至大腿与地面平行。
5. 脚跟发力站起，呼气。

exercises.title: Squat (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells and stand tall with your arms straight and to your sides.
2. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and have your feet in a comfortable stance.
3. Take a breath and descend by bending your knees.
4. Move down until your thighs are parallel to the floor, and keep your heels in contact with the ground.
5. Press through your heels to move up and exhale near the top.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双手各持一只哑铃，站直，手臂自然垂于体侧。
2. 肩向后收，收紧腹部，双脚自然分开。
3. 吸气，屈膝下蹲。
4. 下蹲至大腿与地面平行，脚跟保持贴地。
5. 脚跟发力站起，接近顶端时呼气。

exercises.title: Squat (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Position your back and shoulders against the pad.
2. Have your feet hip-width apart with your toes pointing slightly out.
3. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and take a breath.
4. Pull the safety lever away to unrack the weight.
5. Bend your knees to descend into a squat and keep your heels in contact with the floor.
6. Squat until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
7. Press through your heels to bring yourself to the top and exhale.
8. Once finished, bring the safety lever back and rack the weight.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 背部与肩部贴紧靠垫。
2. 双脚与髋同宽，脚尖略微外展。
3. 肩向后收，收紧腹部，吸气。
4. 拨开安全杆，解锁重量。
5. 屈膝下蹲，脚跟保持贴地。
6. 下蹲至大腿与地面平行。
7. 脚跟发力站起，呼气。
8. 完成后放回安全杆，将重量归位。

exercises.title: Squat (Smith Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Position the Smith machine bar at just below collarbone height.
2. Grab the bar with an overhand grip, tuck your head underneath, and position your upper back against the bar.
3. Walk your feet out a bit and have them hip-width apart.
4. Extend your knees to unrack the bar.
5. Engage your abs, breathe in, and squat by bending your knees.
6. Descend until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
7. Press through your heels to move back to the top and exhale.
8. Once finished, rack the bar and relax your body.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将史密斯机的杠铃杆调至略低于锁骨的高度。
2. 正握杠铃杆，低头钻到杆下，上背贴紧杠铃杆。
3. 双脚稍向前迈出，与髋同宽。
4. 伸膝解锁杠铃杆。
5. 收紧腹部，吸气，屈膝下蹲。
6. 下蹲至大腿与地面平行。
7. 脚跟发力站起，呼气。
8. 完成后将杠铃杆归位，放松身体。

exercises.title: Squat (Suspension)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab the handles of a suspension kit and bend your arms at a 90-degree angle.
2. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and have your feet in a comfortable squatting stance.
3. Inhale and squat while keeping your heels in contact with the floor.
4. Continue until your thighs become parallel to the floor, and pause for a moment.
5. Press through your heels and bring yourself to the top as you exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 抓住悬吊带把手，手臂弯曲成 90 度角。
2. 肩向后收，收紧腹部，双脚自然分开站成下蹲姿势。
3. 吸气下蹲，脚跟保持贴地。
4. 下蹲至大腿与地面平行，稍作停顿。
5. 脚跟发力站起，同时呼气。

exercises.title: Squat Row
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load on a cable machine.
2. Set the pulley at hip height and attach a rope or handle.
3. Grab the cable attachment, take a step back to lift the weight off its stack, and bring your shoulders back.
4. With your arms straight, descend into a squat.
5. Go down until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
6. Press through your heels to move up and immediately row the weight to your stomach as you breathe out.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在绳索器械上选择合适重量。
2. 将滑轮调至髋部高度，装上绳索或把手。
3. 抓住绳索配件，后退一步把重量拉起，肩向后收。
4. 手臂伸直，下蹲。
5. 下蹲至大腿与地面平行。
6. 脚跟发力站起，起身的同时立刻将重量划向腹部并呼气。

exercises.title: Stair Machine (Floors)
exercises.how_to:
1. Climb on top of the machine and turn it on.
2. Select a low speed and grab the handrails for support.
3. Climb the moving stairs while keeping your shoulders back and abs engaged.
4. Maintain a steady breath.
5. Increase the speed to a sustainable pace once you’re familiar with the machine.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 登上器械并开机。
2. 选择低速，握住扶手支撑。
3. 踩踏移动的台阶，保持肩向后收、腹部收紧。
4. 保持均匀呼吸。
5. 熟悉器械后，将速度提高到可持续的节奏。

exercises.title: Stair Machine (Steps)
exercises.how_to:
1. Climb on top of the machine and turn it on.
2. Select a low speed and grab the handrails for support.
3. Climb the moving stairs while keeping your shoulders back and abs engaged.
4. Maintain a steady breath.
5. Increase the speed to a sustainable pace once you’re familiar with the machine.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 登上器械并开机。
2. 选择低速，握住扶手支撑。
3. 踩踏移动的台阶，保持肩向后收、腹部收紧。
4. 保持均匀呼吸。
5. 熟悉器械后，将速度提高到可持续的节奏。

exercises.title: Standing Cable Glute Kickbacks
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the pulley to the lowest position and select the appropriate weight.
2. Attach an ankle strap to the pulley.
3. Face the cable machine and wrap the strap around your right ankle, just above the foot.
4. Bend forward, grab the cable machine’s pillars for balance, and engage your abs.
5. Take a breath and bring your right leg back in one fluid motion, squeezing your glute at the top and exhaling.
6. Slowly bring the leg to the starting position and breathe in.
7. Once finished, wrap the strap over your other ankle, lean forward, and do the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将滑轮调至最低位置，选择合适重量。
2. 将脚踝绑带连接到滑轮上。
3. 面向绳索器械，把绑带套在右脚踝上，位于脚踝上方。
4. 身体前倾，抓住绳索器械的立柱保持平衡，收紧腹部。
5. 吸气，右腿向后一次流畅地踢出，顶端夹紧臀部并呼气。
6. 缓慢将腿放回起始位置，吸气。
7. 完成后把绑带套到另一侧脚踝，前倾，做相同次数。

exercises.title: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand tall with your feet together, knees extended, shoulders back, and arms to your sides.
2. Take a breath.
3. Press through the balls of your feet to extend your ankles, raising yourself a couple of inches. Exhale.
4. Lower yourself to the starting position as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站直，双脚并拢，膝盖伸直，肩部后收，双臂自然垂于体侧。
2. 吸气。
3. 以前脚掌发力伸展脚踝，将身体抬起几英寸。呼气。
4. 吸气，回到起始位置。

exercises.title: Standing Calf Raise (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Position a barbell on your upper back muscles behind your neck and hold it with both hands.
2. Place the balls of your feet on an elevated platform and have your heels on the floor.
3. Bring your shoulders back and engage your abs.
4. Take a breath and extend your ankles, lifting your heels and squeezing your calves as you exhale.
5. Lower your heels without resting them on the floor as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将杠铃置于颈后上背肌群上，双手扶住杠铃。
2. 前脚掌踩在垫高的平台上，脚跟落在地面。
3. 肩向后收，收紧腹部。
4. 吸气，踝关节伸展，抬起脚跟，同时夹紧小腿并呼气。
5. 脚跟缓慢下放，但不要落到地面，同时吸气。

exercises.title: Standing Calf Raise (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Hold a dumbbell in one hand.
2. Place the balls of your feet on an elevated platform.
3. Use your free hand to grab onto something for balance.
4. Extend your knees, squeeze your glutes, engage your abs, and retract your shoulders.
5. Take a breath and flex your ankles, bringing your heels to the floor.
6. Go down as much as possible, feeling your calves stretch.
7. Hold for a moment and extend your ankles to raise yourself, squeezing your calves at the top as you exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 单手握住一只哑铃。
2. 前脚掌踩在垫高的平台上。
3. 另一只手扶住固定物保持平衡。
4. 伸直膝盖，夹紧臀部，收紧腹部，肩胛骨后收。
5. 吸气，踝关节屈曲，脚跟放向地面。
6. 尽量下放，感受小腿拉伸。
7. 稍作停顿，踝关节伸展将自己抬起，顶端夹紧小腿并呼气。

exercises.title: Standing Calf Raise (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load.
2. Put your shoulders and upper back against the machine’s pad.
3. Position the balls of your feet on the platform and extend your knees.
4. Grab the handles by the machine’s pad for extra support.
5. Take a breath and extend your ankles, squeezing your calves at the top, and exhale.
6. Lower yourself slowly, feeling your calves stretch at the bottom. Breathe in on the way down.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的重量。
2. 肩部与上背贴紧器械靠垫。
3. 前脚掌踩在踏板上，伸直膝盖。
4. 抓住靠垫旁的手把以增加支撑。
5. 吸气，踝关节伸展，顶端夹紧小腿，呼气。
6. 缓慢下放，感受小腿在底端拉伸。下放时吸气。

exercises.title: Standing Calf Raise (Smith)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the bar at the appropriate height, where you can unrack it as you fully extend your knees.
2. Add the appropriate weight and position a calf raise block under the bar.
3. Position your trapezius against the bar, grab it with both hands, and place the balls of your feet on the platform.
4. Engage your entire body and straighten your knees to unrack the bar.
5. Inhale and slowly lower yourself by allowing your ankles to flex. Keep your knees extended.
6. Pause briefly at the bottom and push through the balls of your feet to extend your ankles. Squeeze your calves and pause briefly as you exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将杠铃杆调至合适高度，使你在完全伸膝时能够解锁杠铃杆。
2. 加上合适的重量，并在杠铃杆下方放一块提踵踏板。
3. 斜方肌顶住杠铃杆，双手扶住杠铃，前脚掌踩在踏板上。
4. 收紧全身，伸直膝盖解锁杠铃杆。
5. 吸气，踝关节缓慢屈曲将身体下放。保持膝盖伸直。
6. 在底端稍作停顿，前脚掌发力伸展踝关节。夹紧小腿，停顿片刻并呼气。

exercises.title: Standing Leg Curls
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate weight on the machine.
2. Stand tall, grab the handles for support, and position your right Achilles heel against the machine’s pad.
3. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and take a breath.
4. Slowly bend your leg until your ankle is slightly higher than your knee.
5. Squeeze your hamstring muscle at the top and exhale.
6. Slowly extend your leg as you breathe in.
7. Once finished training one side, position your opposite Achilles heel against the pad and do the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在器械上选择合适的重量。
2. 站直，握住手把支撑，将右脚跟腱贴住器械靠垫。
3. 肩向后收，收紧腹部，吸气。
4. 缓慢屈腿，直到脚踝略高于膝盖。
5. 顶端夹紧腘绳肌并呼气。
6. 缓慢伸腿，同时吸气。
7. 一侧练完后，将另一侧脚跟腱贴住靠垫，做相同次数。

exercises.title: Standing Military Press (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Position the barbell at collarbone height on a rack or stand.
2. Stand a few inches from the bar and grab it with an overhand grip. Have your hands shoulder-width apart.
3. With your hands gripping the bar, tuck yourself underneath and retract your shoulders.
4. Take a breath, engage your glutes, and push through your legs to unrack the bar.
5. With your elbows tucked in, back straight, and gaze forward, take a couple of steps back and have your feet at hip-width distance.
6. Take a deep breath, engage your abs, and push through your elbows in a vertical line.
7. Push until your elbows lock out and exhale.
8. Slowly lower the bar to neck level as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将杠铃放在架上约锁骨高度。
2. 站在杠铃前几英寸处，正握杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
3. 双手握杆，低头钻到杆下，肩胛骨后收。
4. 吸气，收紧臀部，双腿发力解锁杠铃杆。
5. 肘部内收，背部挺直，目视前方，后退几步，双脚与髋同宽。
6. 深吸气，收紧腹部，肘部沿垂直线向上推。
7. 推至肘部锁死，呼气。
8. 缓慢将杠铃下放至颈部高度，同时吸气。

exercises.title: Standing Y Raise (Cable)
exercises.title_zh: 站姿绳索 Y 字举
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the pulleys to hip height, attach handles, and select the same weight on both stacks.
2. Facing the machine, grab the handle to your left with your right hand, and the handle to your right with your left.
3. Take a step or two back to lift the weights off of their stacks.
4. Stand tall with your arms extended in front of your chest and hands crossed.
5. Bring your shoulders back, breathe in, and engage your abs.
6. Pull both handles upward and out, exhaling at the top.
7. Slowly lower the handles to the starting position in front of your chest as you breathe in.
8. Repeat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将滑轮调至髋部高度，装上把手，两侧配重选择相同重量。
2. 面向器械，右手抓左侧把手，左手抓右侧把手。
3. 后退一两步，把配重拉起。
4. 站直，双臂在胸前伸直，双手交叉。
5. 肩向后收，吸气，收紧腹部。
6. 将两个把手向上向外拉，顶端呼气。
7. 缓慢将把手放回胸前起始位置，同时吸气。
8. 重复。

exercises.title: Step Up
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand in front of a flat gym bench or plyometric box. Have your feet hip-width apart with your toes pointing slightly out.
2. Bring your shoulders back and engage your abs.
3. Take a breath, lift your right leg, and plant the foot on the elevated platform.
4. Push through the heel to extend your body and bring yourself on top of the elevated object. Exhale.
5. Step off the platform, take another breath and extend your opposite leg.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站在平凳或跳箱前。双脚与髋同宽，脚尖略微外展。
2. 肩向后收，收紧腹部。
3. 吸气，抬起右腿，将脚踩在平台上。
4. 脚跟发力伸展身体，站上平台，呼气。
5. 走下平台，再次吸气，换另一条腿伸展。

exercises.title: Sternum Pull up (Gironda)
exercises.how_to:
1. Reach up and grab the pull-up bar with an even overhand grip (palms facing forward). Have your hands shoulder-width apart or slightly wider.
2. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and squeeze your glutes.
3. Bring your shoulder blades as far back as your strength and mobility allow. Keep your midsection engaged and lean your torso back.
4. Take a breath and pull yourself up until your lower chest touches the bar, then exhale.
5. Lower yourself with control and breathe in as you descend.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 向上抓住引体向上杆，正握（掌心朝前），双手与肩同宽或略宽。
2. 肩向后收，收紧腹部，夹紧臀部。
3. 在力量和活动度允许的范围内尽量后收肩胛骨。保持核心收紧，躯干后倾。
4. 吸气，向上拉起身体，直到下胸触到横杆，然后呼气。
5. 控制身体缓慢下放，下放时吸气。

exercises.title: Straight Arm Lat Pulldown (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load.
2. Set the pulley to the highest position and attach a straight bar.
3. Grab the bar with an overhand grip (palms facing down).
4. Step back to raise the weight from its stack.
5. Engage your abs, retract your shoulder blades, and squeeze your glutes. You can stagger your stance (bring one foot forward and the other back) for balance.
6. Take a breath and bring the bar to your hips in one fluid motion. Keep your arms straight and exhale.
7. Slowly let the bar travel forward and up as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的重量。
2. 将滑轮调至最高位置，装上直杆。
3. 正握横杆（掌心朝下）。
4. 后退一步，将重量从配重块中拉起。
5. 收紧腹部，后收肩胛骨，夹紧臀部。为保持平衡，可以前后错开站姿（一只脚前、一只脚后）。
6. 吸气，将横杆一次流畅地拉向髋部。保持手臂伸直，呼气。
7. 缓慢让横杆向前向上移动，同时吸气。

exercises.title: Straight Leg Deadlift
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand in front of a loaded barbell.
2. Position your feet underneath and have your shins a couple of inches from the bar.
3. Lean forward by hinging at the hips.
4. Grab the bar with a double overhand grip (palms facing back).
5. Bring your shoulders back and engage your abs. Keep your legs straight.
6. Take a breath and pull the bar in a straight vertical line while pushing through your heels.
7. Squeeze your glutes at the top and exhale.
8. Slowly lower the bar in the same straight line and breathe in on the way down or before initiating the next rep.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站在装有杠铃片的杠铃前。
2. 双脚位于杠铃下方，小腿距杠铃几英寸。
3. 以髋部为轴前倾。
4. 双手正握杠铃（掌心朝向身体后方）。
5. 肩向后收，收紧腹部。保持双腿伸直。
6. 吸气，沿垂直直线拉起杠铃，同时脚跟发力。
7. 顶端夹紧臀部并呼气。
8. 沿同一直线缓慢下放杠铃，下放途中或下一次动作开始前吸气。

exercises.title: Stretching
exercises.how_to: (Hevy provides no How-to steps for this entry.)
exercises.how_to_zh: （Hevy 未提供此动作的分步说明。）

exercises.title: Suitcase Carry (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a single dumbbell and stand tall.
2. Bring your shoulders back and engage your abs.
3. Walk forward steadily, looking several steps in front of you. Breathe steadily.
4. Once you complete the distance, grab the weight with your other hand, and repeat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 单手握住一只哑铃，站直。
2. 肩向后收，收紧腹部。
3. 稳步向前行走，目光看向身前几步远的地方。保持均匀呼吸。
4. 走完既定距离后，换另一只手握铃，重复。

exercises.title: Sumo Deadlift
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand before a loaded barbell with your feet spread wide and your toes pointing out. Your shins should be close to the bar but not in contact.
2. Bend forward and grab the barbell with a double overhand grip (palms facing back). Your hands should be shoulder-width apart, with your elbows a few inches from your inner thighs.
3. Bring your shoulders back and lift your chest. Doing so will straighten your back, position your hips at the correct height, and bring your shins against the barbell.
4. With your body tense and arms straight, breathe into your belly.
5. Pull the barbell forcefully as you dig your heels into the floor.
6. Extend your knees and hips as the barbell travels in a straight vertical line and close to your body.
7. Squeeze your glutes at the top to complete the repetition and exhale, but don’t hyperextend your back.
8. Lower the barbell in the same vertical line. Breathe in on the way down or before initiating the next rep.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站在装有杠铃片的杠铃前，双脚大幅分开，脚尖外展。小腿贴近杠铃但不要接触。
2. 俯身，双手正握杠铃（掌心朝向身体后方）。双手与肩同宽，肘部距大腿内侧几英寸。
3. 肩向后收，挺起胸部。这样能挺直背部，使髋部处于正确高度，并让小腿贴住杠铃。
4. 身体绷紧，手臂伸直，向腹部吸气。
5. 脚跟踩实地面，用力拉起杠铃。
6. 杠铃沿垂直直线贴近身体移动的同时，伸膝伸髋。
7. 顶端夹紧臀部完成一次动作并呼气，但不要过度后仰背部。
8. 沿同一直线缓慢下放杠铃。下放途中或下一次动作开始前吸气。

exercises.title: Sumo Squat
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand tall and assume a wider-than-shoulder-level stance with your toes pointing out.
2. Retract your shoulder blades and raise your arms in front of your body for balance.
3. Take a deep breath, engage your abs, and squat.
4. Move down until your thighs are parallel to the floor, and press through your heels to return to the top as you exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站直，双脚宽于肩，脚尖外展。
2. 后收肩胛骨，双臂在身前抬起以保持平衡。
3. 深吸气，收紧腹部，下蹲。
4. 下蹲至大腿与地面平行，脚跟发力回到顶端，同时呼气。

exercises.title: Sumo Squat (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the barbell at collarbone height.
2. Place your hands evenly over the bar, slightly wider than shoulder level apart.
3. Tuck your head under the bar, placing it on your upper back.
4. Plant your feet on the floor, take a breath, and unrack the bar.
5. Take a couple of steps back.
6. Widen your stance as much as possible with your toes pointing out.
7. Bring your chest out and take a breath.
8. Squat slowly, keeping your heels in contact with the floor.
9. Descend until your thighs are parallel to the floor, hold for a moment, and press through your heels, exhaling near the top.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将杠铃调至锁骨高度。
2. 双手对称地握在横杆上，略宽于肩。
3. 低头钻到杠铃下，将其置于上背。
4. 双脚踩实地面，吸气，解锁杠铃杆。
5. 后退几步。
6. 尽量加宽站距，脚尖外展。
7. 挺起胸部，吸气。
8. 缓慢下蹲，脚跟保持贴地。
9. 下蹲至大腿与地面平行，稍作停顿，脚跟发力站起，接近顶端时呼气。

exercises.title: Sumo Squat (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Place a dumbbell in a vertical position on the floor and stand before it.
2. Squat down and grab the top weight plate with both hands.
3. Stand tall and assume a comfortable squatting stance. A wide (sumo) stand would give you more room to squat comfortably.
4. Take a deep breath and engage your abs.
5. Slowly descend into a squat until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
6. Push through your heels to move back to the top as you exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将一只哑铃竖直放在地上，站在其前。
2. 下蹲，双手抓住最上方的铃片。
3. 站直，站成自然的下蹲姿势。宽站距（相扑站法）能提供更舒适的下蹲空间。
4. 深吸气，收紧腹部。
5. 缓慢下蹲至大腿与地面平行。
6. 脚跟发力回到顶端，同时呼气。

exercises.title: Sumo Squat (Kettlebell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a kettlebell by the handle and stand tall with your arms straight and the weight in front of your body.
2. Assume a wider-than-shoulder-level stance, with your toes pointing out.
3. Retract your shoulder blades, take a deep breath, and engage your abs.
4. Descend until your thighs are parallel to the floor, and pause for a moment.
5. Press through your heels to move back to the top and exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 握住壶铃把手，站直，手臂伸直，重量置于身前。
2. 双脚宽于肩，脚尖外展。
3. 后收肩胛骨，深吸气，收紧腹部。
4. 下蹲至大腿与地面平行，稍作停顿。
5. 脚跟发力回到顶端，呼气。

exercises.title: Superman
exercises.how_to:
1. Lie face down on the floor with your legs straight and arms extended to the sides of your head.
2. Have your toes, knees, thighs, stomach, and chest in contact with the floor.
3. Take a breath and extend your arms and legs toward the ceiling as high as possible. Breathe out.
4. Hold the arched position for a couple of seconds, and relax your body as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 俯卧在地面上，双腿伸直，双臂向头顶两侧伸展。
2. 脚趾、膝盖、大腿、腹部和胸部贴地。
3. 吸气，双臂和双腿尽量向天花板方向抬起。呼气。
4. 保持拱起姿势几秒，然后吸气并放松身体。

exercises.title: Swimming
exercises.how_to: (Hevy provides no How-to steps for this entry.)
exercises.how_to_zh: （Hevy 未提供此动作的分步说明。）

exercises.title: T Bar Row
exercises.how_to:
1. Add some weight to the T-bar station.
2. Step on the platform, lean forward and grab the handles with an overhand grip.
3. Retract your shoulder blades, engage your abs, and inhale.
4. With your back neutral, push through your heels and extend your hips a bit to lift the weight off the floor.
5. Keep your torso almost parallel with the floor and have your arms straight.
6. Inhale again and pull the weight until the handles get close to your torso. Breathe out at the top.
7. Extend your arms as you breathe in. Don’t set the weight on the floor.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在 T 杠器械上加一些重量。
2. 站上踏板，俯身，正握住把手。
3. 后收肩胛骨，收紧腹部，吸气。
4. 保持背部中立，脚跟发力并略微伸髋，将重量从地面拉起。
5. 保持躯干几乎与地面平行，手臂伸直。
6. 再次吸气，拉起重量，直到把手靠近躯干。顶端呼气。
7. 吸气并伸直手臂。不要把重量放回地面。

exercises.title: Thruster (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Have the barbell in a front rack position: resting on your shoulders with your elbows bent and fingertips supporting.
2. Position your feet in a comfortable squatting stance.
3. Engage your abs and take a breath.
4. Descend into a squat and keep your heels in contact with the floor.
5. Move down until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
6. Press through your heels to move up.
7. As your legs straighten, immediately transition into an overhead press, thrusting the barbell overhead and breathing out.
8. Lower the barbell to the front rack position as you breathe in.
9. Descend into another squat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将杠铃置于前架位：扛在肩上，肘部弯曲，指尖托住杠铃。
2. 双脚站成自然的下蹲姿势。
3. 收紧腹部，吸气。
4. 下蹲，脚跟保持贴地。
5. 下蹲至大腿与地面平行。
6. 脚跟发力站起。
7. 双腿伸直的同时立刻过渡到过头推举，将杠铃向上推起并呼气。
8. 吸气，将杠铃放回前架位。
9. 再次下蹲。

exercises.title: Thruster (Kettlebell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of kettlebells, stand tall, and lift them to shoulder level. Keep your elbow bent and the kettlebells on the outer side, resting against your forearms and biceps (rack position).
2. Have your feet at a hip-width distance with your toes pointing slightly out.
3. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, take a breath, and squat.
4. Descend until your thighs are parallel to the floor and move up, pushing through your heels.
5. As you reach the top of the squat, press the kettlebells overhead, extending your elbows fully and exhaling.
6. Lower the kettlebells to the sides of your shoulder, take another breath, and squat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双手各持一只壶铃，站直，将其提至肩部高度。保持肘部弯曲，壶铃置于外侧，贴靠前臂和肱二头肌（架位）。
2. 双脚与髋同宽，脚尖略微外展。
3. 肩向后收，收紧腹部，吸气，下蹲。
4. 下蹲至大腿与地面平行，脚跟发力站起。
5. 到达深蹲顶端时，将壶铃向上推起，完全伸直肘部并呼气。
6. 将壶铃下放至肩部两侧，再次吸气，下蹲。

exercises.title: Toe Touch
exercises.how_to:
1. Lie on the floor, straighten your legs, and raise them toward the ceiling.
2. Engage your abs and raise your arms over your chest with your fingers pointing up.
3. Take a breath and crunch your abs to lift your shoulder blades several inches off the floor.
4. Touch your toes with your fingers (or crunch as high as possible in one fluid motion) and exhale.
5. Lower your upper back to the floor as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 仰卧在地面上，双腿伸直，向天花板方向抬起。
2. 收紧腹部，双臂举于胸上方，手指向上。
3. 吸气，卷腹发力，将肩胛骨抬离地面几英寸。
4. 用手指触碰脚趾（或在一次流畅的动作中尽量卷起），并呼气。
5. 吸气，将上背放回地面。

exercises.title: Toes to Bar
exercises.how_to:
1. Reach up and grab a pull-up bar with an overhand grip (palms facing forward).
2. Bring your feet together and lift them off the floor to suspend yourself in the air.
3. Retract your shoulder blades and engage your abs.
4. Take a breath and lift your legs in one fluid motion.
5. Go up as high as possible––ideally, until your toes are close to the pull-up bar you’re holding. Breathe out at the top.
6. Slowly lower your legs to the starting position as you breathe in. Do repetitions slowly and keep your abs engaged to prevent your body from swinging back and forth.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 向上抓住引体向上杆，正握（掌心朝前）。
2. 双脚并拢，抬离地面，让身体悬空。
3. 后收肩胛骨，收紧腹部。
4. 吸气，一次流畅地将双腿抬起。
5. 尽量抬高——理想情况下，直到脚趾接近所握的引体向上杆。顶端呼气。
6. 吸气，缓慢将双腿放回起始位置。缓慢完成动作，并保持腹部收紧，防止身体来回摆动。

exercises.title: Torso Rotation
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate weight.
2. Adjust the seat height so that you can comfortably place your forearms on the pads at your sides and grab the handles.
3. With your knees bent, position your shins against the bottom pads and push forward to create whole-body rigidity.
4. Breathe in and twist your lower body to the right as you exhale. It should be a fluid motion.
5. Slowly return your lower body to the starting position as you breathe in.
6. Rotate your legs to the left and breathe out again.
7. Continue alternating from left to right, breathing steadily as you do reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的重量。
2. 调整座椅高度，使你能够舒适地将前臂放在身体两侧的靠垫上并握住手把。
3. 屈膝，将小腿抵住下方靠垫并向前推，使全身紧绷。
4. 吸气，然后呼气时将下半身向右侧扭转。动作应流畅。
5. 吸气，缓慢将下半身转回起始位置。
6. 再呼气，将双腿转向左侧。
7. 继续左右交替，完成次数时保持均匀呼吸。

exercises.title: Treadmill
exercises.how_to:
1. Stand on the treadmill and clip the safety key to your tank top or T-shirt.
2. Start the treadmill and gradually increase the speed from slow walking to a jog.
3. Maintain an upright posture, direct your gaze forward, and maintain a steady breath.
4. Keep your arms bent and move them in sync with your strides.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 站上跑步机，将安全夹夹在背心或 T 恤上。
2. 启动跑步机，从慢走逐渐加速到慢跑。
3. 保持身体挺直，目视前方，保持均匀呼吸。
4. 手臂保持弯曲，随步伐摆动。

exercises.title: Triceps Dip
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of parallel bars and suspend yourself in the air.
2. Maintain an upright body, bring your shoulders back, and engage your abs.
3. Take a breath and lower yourself by bending your elbows.
4. Move down until your elbows are at a 90-degree angle.
5. Hold the position for a moment and press yourself back to the top as you exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双手抓住双杠，让身体悬空。
2. 保持身体挺直，肩向后收，收紧腹部。
3. 吸气，屈肘下放身体。
4. 下放至肘部呈 90 度角。
5. 保持姿势片刻，用力撑回顶端，同时呼气。

exercises.title: Triceps Dip (Assisted)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load on the machine.
2. Grab the parallel bars, place your knees on the platform, and bring your legs together.
3. Retract your shoulder blades, straighten your arms, and engage your abs.
4. Take a breath and lower yourself by bending your arms.
5. Descend until your elbows are at a 90-degree angle, hold for a moment, and press back to the top as you breathe out.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在器械上选择合适的重量。
2. 抓住双杠，双膝跪在平台上，双腿并拢。
3. 后收肩胛骨，伸直手臂，收紧腹部。
4. 吸气，屈臂下放身体。
5. 下放至肘部呈 90 度角，稍作停顿，呼气并撑回顶端。

exercises.title: Triceps Dip (Weighted)
exercises.how_to:
1. Attach a weight plate to yourself via a special belt.
2. Grab a pair of parallel bars and suspend yourself in the air.
3. Maintain an upright body, bring your shoulders back, and engage your abs.
4. Take a breath and lower yourself by bending your elbows.
5. Move down until your elbows are at a 90-degree angle.
6. Hold the position for a moment and press yourself back to the top as you exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 用专用腰带把铃片挂在身上。
2. 双手抓住双杠，让身体悬空。
3. 保持身体挺直，肩向后收，收紧腹部。
4. 吸气，屈肘下放身体。
5. 下放至肘部呈 90 度角。
6. 保持姿势片刻，用力撑回顶端，同时呼气。

exercises.title: Triceps Extension (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Load a barbell.
2. Grab the bar with an even overhand grip (palms facing back).
3. Bring your shoulders back and engage your abs.
4. Lift the bar to chest level.
5. Sit down on a flat gym bench.
6. Raise the barbell overhead and extend your arms.
7. Take a breath and lower the bar behind your head, feeling your triceps stretch.
8. Hold the bottom for a moment and extend your arms as you exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 给杠铃装上杠铃片。
2. 双手正握横杆（掌心朝向身体后方）。
3. 肩向后收，收紧腹部。
4. 将杠铃提至胸部高度。
5. 坐在平凳上。
6. 将杠铃举过头顶，伸直手臂。
7. 吸气，将杠铃下放至头后，感受肱三头肌拉伸。
8. 在底端停顿片刻，伸直手臂并呼气。

exercises.title: Triceps Extension (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set a cable pulley in a low position and attach a handle.
2. Select a light load with a pin.
3. Reach down and grab the handle with one hand.
4. Turn your body away from the cable machine and extend your arm toward the ceiling.
5. Place your opposite hand on your elbow for support, retract your shoulder blades, and engage your abs.
6. Take a breath and slowly bend your elbow until you feel a stretch in your tricep.
7. Flex your tricep to extend your arm and exhale near the top.
8. Once finished training one tricep, grab the handle with your opposite hand and do the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将绳索滑轮调至低位并安装把手。
2. 用插销选择较轻的重量。
3. 俯身单手握住把手。
4. 身体转离绳索器械，将手臂向天花板方向伸直。
5. 另一只手扶住肘部支撑，肩胛后收，收紧腹部。
6. 吸气，缓慢屈肘，直到肱三头肌有拉伸感。
7. 收缩肱三头肌伸直手臂，在接近顶端时呼气。
8. 一侧肱三头肌练完后，换另一只手握住把手，完成相同次数。

exercises.title: Triceps Extension (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a dumbbell and stand tall.
2. Lift the weight overhead and place your hands flat against the top weight plate with your palms facing the ceiling.
3. Bring your shoulders back and engage your abs.
4. Take a breath and lower the dumbbell behind your head while keeping your elbows to the sides of your head.
5. Bend your arms until you feel a stretch, and extend your elbows as you breathe out.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿起一只哑铃，站直。
2. 将重量举过头顶，双手平贴在最上方铃片的下方，掌心朝向天花板。
3. 肩部后收，收紧腹部。
4. 吸气，将哑铃下放至头后，保持肘部靠近头部两侧。
5. 屈臂直到有拉伸感，呼气时伸直肘部。

exercises.title: Triceps Extension (Machine)
exercises.title_zh: 固定器械肱三头肌屈伸
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the appropriate load and sit down.
2. Grab the handles to your sides, bring your shoulders back into the pad, and plant your feet on the floor.
3. Take a breath and push the handles down by extending your elbows.
4. Straighten your arms fully and hold the position momentarily as you exhale.
5. Bend your arms slowly and breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 设置合适的重量并坐下。
2. 双手握住身体两侧的把手，肩部后靠贴紧靠垫，双脚踩实地面。
3. 吸气，通过伸直肘部将把手向下推。
4. 手臂完全伸直，呼气的同时短暂保持该姿势。
5. 缓慢屈臂并吸气。

exercises.title: Triceps Extension (Suspension)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab the handles of the suspension kit and turn away from the anchor point.
2. Extend your arms in front of your body, bring your feet together, and flex your abs.
3. Retract your shoulders and take a breath.
4. Lean your body forward by bending your elbows.
5. Descend until you feel a stretch in your triceps.
6. Flex your arm muscles to extend your body and exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 握住悬吊带的把手，背对固定点。
2. 手臂在身体前方伸直，双脚并拢，收紧腹部。
3. 肩部后收，吸气。
4. 通过屈肘使身体前倾。
5. 下降直到肱三头肌有拉伸感。
6. 收缩手臂肌肉将身体撑起，呼气。

exercises.title: Triceps Kickback (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the cable pulley in a low position and select the appropriate load. Don’t add an attachment.
2. Grab the plastic piece at the rope’s end with your right hand and take a step back.
3. Lean your torso forward and keep your back straight.
4. Raise your elbow to the side of your torso and inhale.
5. Extend your arm fully and pause briefly as you exhale.
6. Slowly bend your arm as you breathe in.
7. Repeat.
8. Once finished, grab the rope with your left hand and repeat for the same number of reps.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将绳索滑轮调至低位并选择合适的重量。不要安装任何配件。
2. 右手握住绳索末端的塑料头，向后迈一步。
3. 躯干前倾，保持背部挺直。
4. 将肘部抬至躯干侧方并吸气。
5. 手臂完全伸直，呼气时短暂停顿。
6. 吸气的同时缓慢屈臂。
7. 重复。
8. 完成后换左手握住绳索，重复相同的次数。

exercises.title: Triceps Kickback (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a light dumbbell and hold it to your side with your palm facing your thigh.
2. Lean your torso forward as you push your butt back to maintain a neutral back.
3. Lift your elbow to your side, inhale, and extend your arm by engaging your tricep. Breathe out.
4. Hold the contraction for a second and slowly bring the dumbbell back down as you breathe in.
5. Keep your shoulder and elbow in a stationary position throughout each repetition.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿起一只轻哑铃，置于体侧，掌心朝向大腿。
2. 臀部后推、躯干前倾，保持背部中立。
3. 将肘部抬至体侧，吸气，收缩肱三头肌伸直手臂。呼气。
4. 顶峰收缩保持一秒，吸气的同时缓慢放下哑铃。
5. 每次重复过程中保持肩部和肘部位置固定。

exercises.title: Triceps Pressdown
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the appropriate weight on a cable machine.
2. Put the pulley in the highest position and attach a straight or V-shaped bar.
3. Grab the bar with an even overhand grip (palms facing down).
4. Bring your elbows to your sides, take a step back, and retract your shoulder blades.
5. Engage your abs and take a breath.
6. Extend your arms fully and hold the bottom position for a moment as you breathe out.
7. Slowly bend your arms until your wrists are slightly higher than your elbows, breathing in along the way.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 在绳索器械上设置合适的重量。
2. 将滑轮调至最高位，安装直杆或 V 形杆。
3. 用正握（掌心向下）等距握住横杆。
4. 肘部贴近体侧，向后迈一步，肩胛后收。
5. 收紧腹部并吸气。
6. 手臂完全伸直，呼气时在最低位短暂保持。
7. 缓慢屈臂，直到手腕略高于肘部，同时吸气。

exercises.title: Triceps Pushdown
exercises.how_to:
1. Pick the appropriate load, set the pulley in the highest position, and attach a bar.
2. Grab the bar with an even overhand grip and bring your elbows to your sides.
3. Take a couple of steps back and lean your torso slightly forward.
4. Engage your abs, retract your shoulder blades, and take a breath.
5. Extend your arms while keeping your elbows to your sides and hold for a moment. Exhale.
6. Slowly bend your arms until your wrists are slightly higher than your elbows. Breathe in as your arms bend.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的重量，将滑轮调到最高位置，并装上横杆。
2. 以正握均匀握住横杆，手肘贴近体侧。
3. 后退几步，躯干略微前倾。
4. 收紧腹部，肩胛骨后收，吸气。
5. 保持手肘贴近体侧伸展手臂，稍作停留。呼气。
6. 缓慢弯曲手臂，直到手腕略高于手肘。弯曲时吸气。

exercises.title: Triceps Rope Pushdown
exercises.how_to:
1. Pick the appropriate weight, set the pulley to the highest position, and attach a rope.
2. Grab the rope with both hands and bring your elbows to your sides.
3. Take a step back and lean your torso forward slightly.
4. Take a breath and extend your arms while keeping your elbows in position. Breathe out.
5. Bend your arms slowly and breathe in. Stop when your wrists end up slightly higher than your elbows.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适重量，将滑轮调至最高位，安装绳索。
2. 双手握住绳索，肘部贴近体侧。
3. 向后迈一步，躯干略微前倾。
4. 吸气，保持肘部位置不变伸直手臂。呼气。
5. 缓慢屈臂并吸气。当手腕略高于肘部时停止。

exercises.title: Upright Row (Barbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a barbell with an overhand grip (palms facing back). Your hands should be shoulder-width apart.
2. Stand tall, retract your shoulder blades, flex your abs, and take a breath.
3. Row the barbell in a straight line from your hips to your chest and breathe out. Squeeze your upper back and biceps at the top.
4. Extend your arms slowly and breathe in on the way down.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 用正握（掌心朝后）握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
2. 站直，肩胛后收，收紧腹部，吸气。
3. 将杠铃沿直线从髋部拉至胸部并呼气。在顶端挤压上背和肱二头肌。
4. 缓慢放下手臂，下放过程中吸气。

exercises.title: Upright Row (Cable)
exercises.how_to:
1. Set the pulley to the lowest position and attach a straight bar.
2. Select the appropriate weight.
3. Lean forward and grab the bar with an overhand grip (palms facing down).
4. Stand up and step back to lift the weight off its stack.
5. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and put one foot slightly forward for support.
6. Take a breath and row the bar to your upper chest in one fluid motion. Exhale at the top.
7. Slowly extend your arms as you breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将滑轮调至最低位，安装直杆。
2. 选择合适的重量。
3. 俯身用正握（掌心向下）握住横杆。
4. 站起并后退，将重量从配重片上提起。
5. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，一只脚略微向前支撑。
6. 吸气，用流畅的动作将横杆拉至上胸。在顶端呼气。
7. 缓慢放下手臂，同时吸气。

exercises.title: Upright Row (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells and stand tall. Have your feet in a comfortable stance, shoulders retracted, and arms straight.
2. Position the dumbbells in front of your body and engage your abs.
3. Inhale and pull the dumbbells in a straight vertical line toward your upper chest. Exhale at the top.
4. Extend your arms, breathing in on the way down.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿起一对哑铃，站直。双脚以舒适的站距分开，肩部后收，手臂伸直。
2. 将哑铃置于身体前方，收紧腹部。
3. 吸气，沿垂直直线将哑铃拉向上胸。在顶端呼气。
4. 放下手臂，下放过程中吸气。

exercises.title: V Up
exercises.how_to:
1. Lie on the floor with your legs straight, feet together, and arms stretched behind your head.
2. Engage your abs and take a breath.
3. Simultaneously raise your legs and upper body in one fluid motion, folding your body into a V shape and breathing out.
4. Hold the top position for a moment and slowly lower your torso and legs as you breathe in. Don’t rest your feet on the floor between repetitions.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 仰卧在地面上，双腿伸直，双脚并拢，双臂向头后伸展。
2. 收紧腹部并吸气。
3. 用流畅的动作同时抬起双腿和上身，使身体折成 V 字形并呼气。
4. 在顶端短暂保持，吸气的同时缓慢放下躯干和双腿。两次重复之间不要让双脚落地。

exercises.title: Vertical Traction (Machine)
exercises.how_to:
1. Select the appropriate load.
2. Face away from the machine with your backside close to the back pad with the handles overhead.
3. Grab the handles with a neutral (palms facing one another) or overhand (palms facing forward) grip and sit down.
4. Bring your chest out, engage your abs, and breathe in.
5. Pull the handles down and to your sides with your elbows traveling in a semi-arc toward your lats. Exhale.
6. Slowly extend your arms and breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 选择合适的重量。
2. 背对器械，臀部靠近靠背垫，把手位于头顶上方。
3. 用对握（掌心相对）或正握（掌心向前）握住把手并坐下。
4. 挺胸，收紧腹部，吸气。
5. 将把手向下拉向身体两侧，肘部沿半弧线朝背阔肌方向移动。呼气。
6. 缓慢伸直手臂并吸气。

exercises.title: Waiter Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Hold a dumbbell vertically and place your hands flat against the underside of the top weight plate with your thumbs on top for grip support.
2. Stand tall, spread your feet slightly wider than your hips, and lean forward slightly.
3. Bring your chest out, engage your abs, and breathe in.
4. Curl the dumbbell until your wrists are slightly higher than your elbows and pause for a moment as you exhale.
5. Slowly lower the weight until your arms are fully extended. Breathe in on the way down.
6. Repeat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 竖直握住一只哑铃，双手平贴在最上方铃片的下方，拇指搭在上方辅助握持。
2. 站直，双脚略宽于髋部，身体略微前倾。
3. 挺胸，收紧腹部，吸气。
4. 弯举哑铃直到手腕略高于肘部，呼气时短暂停顿。
5. 缓慢下放重量，直到手臂完全伸直。下放过程中吸气。
6. 重复。

exercises.title: Walking
exercises.how_to: (Hevy provides no How-to steps for this entry.)
exercises.how_to_zh: （Hevy 未提供此动作的分步说明。）

exercises.title: Walking Lunge
exercises.how_to:
1. Retract your shoulder blades and engage your abs.
2. Take a breath and extend your right leg forward, planting the foot on the floor.
3. Immediately sink into a lunge until your back knee is almost in contact with the ground.
4. Press through your front foot to extend the leg as you exhale.
5. Breathe in as you lift your back foot off the floor and extend the back leg forward, planting the foot in front of your body and descending into another lunge.
6. Continue moving forward until youâ€™re done.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 肩胛骨后收，收紧腹部。
2. 吸气，右腿向前迈出，脚掌踩实地面。
3. 立即下蹲成弓步，直到后侧膝盖几乎接触地面。
4. 呼气，以前脚发力伸直腿部。
5. 吸气，将后脚抬离地面并向前迈出，脚掌落在身体前方，再次下蹲成弓步。
6. 持续向前行进直至完成。

exercises.title: Walking Lunge (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells and stand tall.
2. Retract your shoulder blades and engage your abs.
3. Take a breath and extend your right leg forward, planting the foot on the floor.
4. Immediately sink into a lunge until your back knee is almost in contact with the ground.
5. Press through your front foot to extend the leg as you exhale.
6. Breathe in as you lift your back foot off the floor and extend the back leg forward, planting the foot in front of your body and descending into another lunge.
7. Continue moving forward until you’re done.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿起一对哑铃，站直。
2. 肩胛后收，收紧腹部。
3. 吸气，右腿向前迈出，脚掌踩实地面。
4. 随即下蹲成弓步，直到后侧膝盖几乎接触地面。
5. 呼气时用前脚发力蹬起，伸直前腿。
6. 吸气，后脚离地向前迈出，在身体前方踩实并再次下蹲成弓步。
7. 持续向前移动到完成。

exercises.title: Walking Lunge (Sandbag)
exercises.how_to:
1. Lean forward and grab the sandbag by the handles.
2. Lift the bag to chest level, press it overhead, and position it behind your neck.
3. Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart. Breathe in and engage your abs.
4. Extend your right leg forward, plant the foot, and sink into a lunge, descending until your back knee is close to or taps the ground.
5. Push through your front foot to extend the knee and stand up as you breathe out. Immediately bring your left leg forward to align your feet.
6. Breathe in, bring your left leg forward, plant the foot on the floor, and perform the next lunge.
7. Continue alternating as you move forward.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 俯身抓住沙袋的提手。
2. 将沙袋提至胸前，向上推举过头，然后置于颈后。
3. 站直，双脚与髋同宽。吸气并收紧腹部。
4. 右腿向前迈出并踩实，下蹲成弓步，直到后侧膝盖接近或轻触地面。
5. 呼气时用前脚发力蹬伸膝盖站起。随即左腿向前迈出，使双脚并齐。
6. 吸气，左腿向前迈出踩实地面，进行下一次弓步。
7. 交替进行并持续向前移动。

exercises.title: Wall Ball
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a medium-sized medicine ball and stand in front of a wall.
2. Lift the ball in front of your chest and keep your elbows bent.
3. Have your feet in a comfortable stance for squats, with your toes pointing slightly out.
4. Engage your abs and take a breath.
5. Descend into a squat, keeping your heels in contact with the floor.
6. Move down until your thighs are parallel to the floor, and press through your heels to move up.
7. As your legs straighten, throw the ball up and against the wall and exhale.
8. Immediately grab the ball, take another breath, and descend into another squat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿起一个中等大小的药球，站在墙前。
2. 将球举于胸前，保持肘部弯曲。
3. 双脚以适合深蹲的舒适站距分开，脚尖略微外展。
4. 收紧腹部并吸气。
5. 下蹲，保持脚跟贴地。
6. 下蹲至大腿与地面平行，然后脚跟发力起身。
7. 在双腿伸直的同时，将球向上抛向墙面并呼气。
8. 立即接住球，再次吸气，下蹲进入下一次动作。

exercises.title: Wall Sit
exercises.how_to:
1. Face away from a wall and stand a few inches away.
2. Carefully lean back and position your upper back and buttocks against the wall.
3. Engage your abs and slowly bend your knees to descend into a squat.
4. Adjust your foot position and have your ankles underneath your knees. Your thighs should be roughly parallel to the floor.
5. Bring your arms in front of your body or have them to your sides.
6. Hold the position for 30 to 60 seconds, breathing steadily as you do.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 背对墙面站立，距离墙壁几英寸。
2. 小心向后靠，使上背和臀部贴住墙面。
3. 收紧腹部，缓慢屈膝下蹲。
4. 调整脚的位置，使脚踝位于膝盖正下方。大腿约与地面平行。
5. 双臂可置于身前或身体两侧。
6. 保持该姿势 30 到 60 秒，同时平稳呼吸。

exercises.title: Warm Up
exercises.how_to: (Hevy provides no How-to steps for this entry.)
exercises.how_to_zh: （Hevy 未提供此动作的分步说明。）

exercises.title: Wide Pull Up
exercises.how_to:
1. Reach up and grab a pull-up bar with a wide overhand grip (palms facing forward). Your hands should be more than shoulder-width apart but not too wide.
2. Bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and lift your feet off the floor to suspend yourself in the air. Keep your feet together or bend your knees and interlock your lower legs.
3. Take a breath and pull yourself up in one fluid motion. Go up until your chin is over the bar and hold for a moment as you exhale.
4. Slowly lower yourself and breathe in.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 向上伸手，用宽正握（掌心向前）握住引体向上杆。双手间距应大于肩宽但不要过宽。
2. 肩部后收，收紧腹部，双脚离地悬垂于空中。双脚并拢，或屈膝并交叉小腿。
3. 吸气，用流畅的动作将身体拉起。拉至下巴超过横杆，呼气时短暂保持。
4. 缓慢下放身体并吸气。

exercises.title: Wide-Elbow Triceps Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.title_zh: 哑铃宽肘肱三头肌推举
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells and sit on a flat gym bench.
2. Place the weights on top of your thighs and hold them steady.
3. Lie back with your elbows bent and the weights close to your body.
4. Press the dumbbells to extend your arms. Your palms should face forward (toward your lower body).
5. Plant your feet on the floor, bring your shoulders back, engage your abs, and breathe in.
6. Slowly bend your elbows to bring the dumbbells inward and toward your chest. This will force your elbows to flare out to some degree.
7. Carefully lower the weights on your chest and extend your arms as you exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 拿起一对哑铃，坐在平板健身凳上。
2. 将哑铃放在大腿上并稳稳握住。
3. 向后躺下，屈肘，哑铃靠近身体。
4. 推起哑铃伸直手臂。掌心应朝前（朝向身体下方）。
5. 双脚踩实地面，肩部后收，收紧腹部，吸气。
6. 缓慢屈肘，将哑铃向内朝胸部下放。这会使肘部一定程度向外张开。
7. 小心将哑铃下放到胸部，呼气时伸直手臂。

exercises.title: Wrist Roller
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a wrist roller and attach a weight plate to it.
2. Stand tall and lift your arms in front of your body with your palms facing down.
3. Bring your shoulders back and engage your abs.
4. Inhale and begin rolling the plate up.
5. Once the plate reaches your hands, roll in the opposite direction to lower the weight to the floor.
6. Breathe steadily and roll for as long as possible.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 握住卷腕器，在其上挂一片杠铃片。
2. 站直，双臂在身体前方抬起，掌心向下。
3. 肩部后收，收紧腹部。
4. 吸气，开始将铃片卷起。
5. 铃片到达手部后，向相反方向旋转，将重量放回地面。
6. 保持平稳呼吸，尽可能坚持旋转。

exercises.title: Yoga
exercises.how_to: (Hevy provides no How-to steps for this entry.)
exercises.how_to_zh: （Hevy 未提供此动作的分步说明。）

exercises.title: Zercher Squat
exercises.how_to:
1. Position the barbell at roughly belly button height.
2. Walk up to the bar and press the crease of your elbows against it.
3. Bend your arms to create a shelf and press the barbell against your stomach.
4. Take a couple of steps back, bring your chest out, and take a deep breath into your belly.
5. Squat by imagining that you’re sitting down in an invisible chair. Keep your heels on the floor and maintain an upright torso.
6. Go down as comfortably as you can and push through your heels to move to the top position. Exhale.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 将杠铃置于大约肚脐的高度。
2. 走近杠铃，将肘窝抵住杠铃。
3. 屈臂形成托架，将杠铃抵在腹部。
4. 向后退几步，挺胸，深吸气至腹部。
5. 想象坐在一把看不见的椅子上完成深蹲。保持脚跟贴地，躯干直立。
6. 在舒适的范围内尽量下蹲，然后脚跟发力回到顶端。呼气。

exercises.title: Zottman Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.how_to:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells, stand tall, and position your arms to your sides.
2. Have the weights in front of your upper thighs with your palms facing forward.
3. Engage your abs and take a breath.
4. Curl the dumbbells up until your wrists are slightly higher than your elbows, and breathe out.
5. As you reach the top position, rotate your wrists 180 degrees and lower the dumbbells to the starting position with your palms facing down. Breathe in on the way down.
6. Rotate your wrists again and repeat.
exercises.how_to_zh:
1. 双手各持一只哑铃站直，手臂自然垂于身体两侧。
2. 哑铃置于大腿前侧，掌心朝前。
3. 收紧腹部，吸气。
4. 弯举哑铃，直到手腕略高于肘部，呼气。
5. 到达最高点后，手腕旋转 180 度，掌心朝下将哑铃放回起始位置，下放过程吸气。
6. 再次旋转手腕，重复动作。
